This story is recorded in the Asoka Vuong Son Chi. In the 21st year of Quang Tu (1895), Quang came to the relic ceremony for several dozen days and read [this story].

People who understand reason encounter any situation, never suspecting that cause and effect are wrong, or that Buddha's words are false! People who do not understand reason are rigidly attached to rules and do not know the complexity of cause and effect, leading to confusion and doubt and discussion; In general, it is because the mind does not have right view. As it is said that the person reciting Buddha's name has the Three Jewels and the protection of the dragon and heaven, that is a certain truth, absolutely not false. Just because we don't clearly understand the principle of "transforming heavy news in the next life into light news in this life", we can't help but discuss such unreasonable doubts. Once upon a time, the Gioi Hien commentator26 lived in the Western Regions, his virtue was high throughout his life, and his teachings were illustrious in the Four Trucs (four lands of Thien Truc27). Because of good karma, one is close

Gioi Hien (Śīlabhadra) lived around the 6th or 7th century, was a famous commentator of Mahayana Buddhism Yogācāra Hanh (Only Consciousness), abbot of Na Lan Da temple in Magadha, India. He belonged to the Samatata royal family in East India, was studious since childhood, and studied with all wise men. When he arrived at Na Lan Da, he met Dharma Protector Bodhisattva, listened to him preach the Dharma, believed, became enlightened, and then became a monk. At the age of 30, he wrote an essay that made pagan monks across the entire South India region surrender. The monk was the abbot of Na Lan Da pagoda for a long time, specializing in propagating Duy Thuc ideology. The monk based on the Deep Secret Sutras, Yogācāra Master's Dialogue, etc., divided Buddhism into three periods: Being, Emptiness, and Middle, establishing the theory of the Five Natures. When Venerable Huyen Trang came to study, the Master was over a hundred years old. Due to the Master's virtue and knowledge, the masses no longer called him directly by his Dharma name, but instead called him by his beautiful name Dharma Store.

Thien Truc is India. Due to ancient times, the sounds of Bamboo and Doc are pronounced the same. Therefore, ancient books also refer to Thien Truc as Thien Doc, Thien Doc, and Than Doc. According to researchers, these are all mispronunciations of the Hindustani word. In the Great Tang Western Records, volume 85, shaman Huyen Trang wrote: "The name Thien Truc has many different opinions. In ancient times it was called Than Doc, or called Hien Dau. Now according to the correct pronunciation, it should be read as India... India, Chinese translation is Nguyet (moon). The moon has many names, this is one name!" India was divided into five lands suffering from evil diseases, suffering extremely, could not bear it, wanted to commit suicide, suddenly saw the three Bodhisattvas Manjushri, Pho Hien, and Avalokiteśvara descending, saying: "You in a long ago life, as a king, many times caused harm to sentient beings. You should have fallen into the evil realm long ago. Because you propagated the Buddha Dharma, you had to endure this small suffering in the human world to eliminate the suffering of hell for a long life. You should try to endure, the land of Dai Tang has A monk named Huyen Trang will come here to study the Dharma in three years' time." After listening, the monk Gioi Hien tried to endure the pain and repent, and over time he recovered. Three years later, Mr. Huyen Trang came there, Mr. Gioi Hien asked his disciples to describe the suffering of the disease. The person recounting the suffering was choked up and brought to tears, enough to see that the suffering was very great. If one does not clearly understand the causes of one's previous life, one will say that Gioi Hien is not a noble monk who has attained enlightenment, or one will say that even though such a great practitioner still suffers from such a tragic illness, where is the benefit of the Buddha Dharma's inspiration? What you know in your mind is too small, so when you see some strange appearance, doubt arises. People who do not have good roots lose their minds. If [seeing] that the person who has created evil is currently receiving blessings, he will also give rise to such wrong views; I don't know that they are all causes and effects, and turning heavy retribution in the next life into light retribution in the present life, as well as turning light retribution in this life into heavy retribution in the next life, etc... all kinds of complicated reasons!

tieu_de: 10. Letter responding to layperson Duc Suong
tom_tat: Receiving your letter and Master Minh Dao's letter, knowing that his third child, only twenty years old, had suddenly died prematurely, he couldn't help but lament. What's more, he raised me for so many years, wasted so much spirit and money, how can I not feel pity in my heart!...
noi_dung:
10. Letter responding to layperson Duc Suong

(Year of the Republic 23 - 1934)

Receiving your letter and Master Minh Dao's letter, knowing that his third child, only twenty years old, had suddenly died prematurely, he couldn't help but lament. What's more, he raised me for so many years, wasted so much spirit and money, how can I not feel pity in my heart! However, don't think that if you are enthusiastic about doing public good and taking refuge in Buddha's Dharma, why don't you receive Buddha's protection? Then you become resentful! You must know: From countless lifetimes up to now, we have created limitless and boundless negative karma, either we owe others, or others owe us, or we owe others' lives, or others owe our lives. Because both sides owe each other, they give birth to all kinds of different children. Some repay debt, some collect debt, some repay virtue, and some repay hatred. In this life, although you have the mind to handle everything very well, how can there be so many lifetimes?

(Ngu Truc), except for the Central part, the four areas East, West, South, North, are collectively called Tu Truc.

Are all lives completely free of any sins? Therefore, when encountering undesirable circumstances, people should only develop a mind to repent for their sins, and should not give rise to the idea of ​​resenting heaven and blaming others. If you can develop a mind to repent and not give birth to resentment, that means "if you face adversity and endure it, future blessings are hard to measure." This child of yours probably came from debt collection. After claiming all the debt, he left this world. The creditor has already left, why don't you have the idea of ​​freeing yourself from the karmic bondage, but instead you feel resentful towards heaven and blame Buddha, becoming crazy?

In the eighth year of the Republic of China (1919), Mr. Vuong Chi Tuong in Bac Thong Chau, whose full name was Thiet San, had a very intelligent and filial son. The older child has a mental illness. Mr. Thiet San's heart hopes that this child will inherit the family's reputation. When he was twenty-one or twenty-two years old, he got married, gave birth to a daughter, and one day he became seriously ill and was about to die. Thiet San was extremely miserable, screaming: "X... oh! You have come to be my son, why do you want to leave at this moment?" The child glared and spoke with a Cantonese accent: "I'm not your child, I'm the fourteenth!" Having said that, he died immediately. Previously, when Mr. Thiet San held the military position

Guangxi, made a plan to kill thirteen bandit leaders who surrendered, first using a very pampering and warm treatment to appease them and invite them to dinner. He also invited famous people to come and accompany him, and rewarded each of them with twenty-four coins, telling them: "I'm very busy during the day, I can't talk to you in detail. Come in the evening and I'll arrange a position for each of you!" Those thirteen people did not know that he wanted to kill them, but he dragged a close friend along, thinking that [Mr. Thiet San] would respect him and also ask for that person to get a good position. That night they arrived, every time they passed a door they immediately locked it and placed ambushes in the flower hall. When they arrived, Thiet San pulled out the knife he was wearing and slashed it. The soldiers ambushed him and rushed out to kill, chopping off fourteen skulls, without even knowing their names. Who knew that person was this child? In vain more than twenty years of hard upbringing, when he died, he glared and shouted, not recognizing Thiet San as his father!

In general, the person who becomes a child in this world has no more than four meanings: "claiming debt, repaying debt, repaying kindness, and repaying resentment". This child owes him money in his previous life, so the debt will be cleared immediately. If you repay your debt and repay your kindness, you will be filial and well-cared for. Furthermore, he has taken refuge in Buddhism and must understand that everything in the world is impermanent. If we do not diligently recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, we will follow the karmic cycle of reincarnation in the three paths and six paths, and how can we stop it? With the death of this child, it is even more important to know that everything cannot be relied on, only Amitabha Buddha in the West is a great refuge for all of us sentient beings. From there, develop a heart of gratitude, develop a mind of diligence, and dedicate the merits we have done and the merits of reciting Buddha's name to rebirth in the West. If you can do that, then this child's death will be a reminder and encouragement to you, preventing you from being so confused by worldly blessings [that] you will not be bored with Sa Ba, nor will you be desirous of the Ultimate Bliss. Therefore, giving him a sharp blow to the head, it turned out that he did not observe and understand himself, and instead gave rise to all kinds of foolish views and resentment against heaven and Buddha, becoming "obsessed with the roots and following the roots", not knowing how to self-reflect!

People often brag and are arrogant because of the merits they have created, and are easy-going about the sins they have committed. Who is not guilty? Don't talk about the past, if you only talk about this life, you will kill all kinds of living beings to your heart's content! Are they like wood or stone, don't know suffering, don't want to live, just want people to kill and eat? You killed it, and in the future it will definitely want to kill you too. During a lifetime, people don't know how many living beings they have eaten, so should they loudly say "I am innocent, I was punished by heaven"? Therefore, in general, ordinary people do not see themselves as having faults, and in general, saints do not see themselves as virtuous. If you don't feel guilty, your sins will pile up like a mountain. If you don't see virtue, virtue is as high as heaven. Don't talk like a foolish person, do your best to do good, try to recite the Buddha's name, all the merits and virtues that benefit others should be dedicated to rebirth in the West, then your mental conduct in this present life will be in harmony with the mental conduct of the saints, and when you die, you will surely be guided to rebirth by Amitabha Buddha. That is the time to reap the rewards and results. If one were not born in the West, the good deeds done would sooner or later receive retribution, but the retribution for killing and eating living beings would be hard to avoid, it is very scary!

tieu_de: 11. Letter responding to layperson Hua Hy Duong
tom_tat: Lac Hue Bin came with his letter and a list of other people asking for refuge. Knowing that the layperson was sixty-five years old, one child and one grandchild both died prematurely. Judging by the world's situation, it's truly heartbreaking. If we discuss according to the dharma...
noi_dung:
11. Letter responding to layperson Hua Hy Duong

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Lac Hue Bin came with his letter and a list of other people asking for refuge. Knowing that the layperson was sixty-five years old, one child and one grandchild both died prematurely. Judging by the world's situation, it's truly heartbreaking. If discussed according to the Pure Land dharma of birth and death, it is truly the ultimate cause and condition to become a saint! People in this world are born without knowing where they came from, and when they die, they don't know where they will go. This is truly an important event in human life; Just because we value our children and grandchildren, we end up disregarding and ignoring the great matter of our own life and death. If the descendants of lay people live long and become mandarins, they will surely be fascinated by wealth and blessings, afraid that it will be difficult to develop the mind of "taking refuge in the Three Jewels, please receive the Five Precepts", but just hoping for "blessings, longevity, and a good death" is the end, for the Dharmakaya's wisdom and life, they still do not listen or believe! If everything is satisfactory, is it possible to go beyond living in vain and dying in vain?

The current situation is not good, we know that human life is nothing but suffering, and we have thoroughly read Pure Land books, knowing that we already have our old hometown of An Lac to settle down in peace, all day long we only think of Buddha, only pray for Pure Land, until the time of our death, Buddha takes us to be reborn in the sublime West and enter the sainthood, will escape birth and death until the end of the future life to enjoy wonderful and sublime bliss. Therefore, I said, "That child, he has indeed accomplished a great thing that will end life and death for you, that's why he passed away first!" You should feel great gratitude and vow to use your own merit and virtue of reciting Buddha's name to eliminate their sins and increase their good roots, so that they can also rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to be reborn in the West, so that your child or grandchild will not die early in vain! Those who are skillful in achieving benefits have nothing that is not beneficial; If a person is willing to be harmed, there is nothing that is not a harm, depending on each person's understanding!

He has developed the mind to take refuge, now I give him the Dharma name Duc Hy, which means: Using the great Bodhi mind, I hope that whether we or others will be bathed in Buddha's light and be born in Buddha's Pure Land. All the meanings of the Three Refuges, the Five Precepts, and the Ten Virtues have been briefly explained in the Van Sao, so they are not recorded anymore. As for self-ordaining, the letter sent to Ms. Tu in Van Sao28 was also mentioned, so there is no need to repeat it. It is worth mentioning that we must be attentive and take practice seriously. If a student of Buddhism does not focus on dedicated practice, it is no different from singing in real life! On stage, suffering - happiness, sadness - happiness act exactly the same, but in reality it has nothing to do with us. In this way, you will become an ignorant person who is greedy for fame and hates the truth, with a mind that wants to deceive people and lie to Buddha, which really only makes the mistake of deceiving others and lying to Buddha. People shouldn't even cheat,

That is, the letter sent to Ms. Tu Phuoc Hien, numbered 33 in the series An Quang Van Sao Tang Quang Chanh Bien, volume 1.

What about Buddha? We must really pay attention to implementation.

As for religious practice, you should focus on the Pure Land, because you are almost at the age of Co Hy (seventy years old), and your days are short. If you want to read widely the Mahayana sutras, you will not have enough spirit, not enough knowledge, and not enough time! Only one method of giving birth to faith and vowing to uphold the Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West is the most supreme and wonderful method. You should die from your anxious mind, shoulder the burden, and decide in this life to say goodbye to the Five Defilements and ascend to the nine ranks. You should also develop great compassion for all the people you know about the benefits of this method, so that if they all practice together, your own merit will become even greater. If that's the case with outsiders, what more can you do with your own wife, daughter-in-law, and granddaughter-in-law, if you can't let them enjoy the benefits of the Dharma? One is to comfort his wife in her old age, the other is to comfort the sadness of his daughter-in-law and granddaughter-in-law, making them also become saints through this method, and to escape birth and death, it is truly effective in benefiting people.

In addition, if a person recites Buddha's name and has attained enlightenment, then at the time of death, even if they are cut by knives or smeared with incense, there will be no thought at all, so there is no so-called harm or benefit. If you only have the strength to practice and have not yet reached the state of dedicated karma, when you are about to die, someone else will help you remember, and you will be able to be reborn. If you encounter an inanimate relative, even before death you wash and change clothes, causing the [person about to die] to be moved and suffer. Even though there is no suffering, as soon as the mind is moved, the mind cannot be unified in the Buddha (because the body is passive, the mind cannot be completely pure and unified). If you still cry in front of [the person who is about to die], then that person [about to die] will also have attachment, so it is not compatible with Buddha, there is no way to be reborn! Therefore, in everyday life, we must make them aware of the benefits and harms, and must often tell them so that when we die, they are the assistants, not only useful to us but also of great benefit to them. If you only know how to practice by yourself, without telling them about the benefits and harms, when you die, they will definitely be the ones who destroy your mindfulness, and certainly will not help you calm your mind to be reborn.

He trusted Quang, Quang could not help but because he planned. Do Quang has fifty-two years of experience and knows very well where the advantages and disadvantages lie. If I don't tell him, I won't be able to fulfill my destiny! Your younger brother, Tiep Khanh, is also sixty years old, so he should show you this letter. Must know

Buddha Dharma, immeasurable Dharma methods; If we wanted ordinary people with karma to fill their bodies to be free from birth and death right in this life, but left this method of believing in the Buddha's name and praying to be reborn in the West, then the Buddha would not have been able to say any other second method! All other dharmas must be practiced to the point of "karma is exhausted, love is empty" to have the end of birth and death. If there's still a little bit left over, then life and death will still be the same, unresolved! If we talk about "karma ends, love is empty", then I'm afraid that in the whole world it will be difficult to find one or two people. If through faith and vow to recite the Buddha's name to seek rebirth, ten thousand people will not miss anyone!

If you recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, you must maintain moral integrity, fulfill all duties, put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, do good things, be merciful to all, love the lives of animals, abstain from killing, be vegetarian, and practice expedient means, so that this mind often corresponds to the Buddha's mind. If you pretend to be a monk on the outside but don't have a true heart inside, that's a fake person. How can a fake person achieve real benefits? In addition, Mrs. Dam of the Lac family (Mr. Ban Chuong's great-grandmother) is eighty-one years old, and Bang Tai Phuong lives in Ai Nhan alley, East gate. These two people also pray for the Three Refuges and Five Precepts. Please pass this idea on to them. Other things have been discussed in detail in the Van Sao series and will not be repeated here.

Nowadays, the current world has become extremely chaotic, the principles of humanity and morality have almost been completely abandoned, returning to a time when humans were no different from animals! Considering the root cause of this problem, it is all due to not considering cause and effect, retribution, and reincarnation as real principles and truths. Therefore, good things are not encouraged, evil things are not punished, leaving the mind without a place to rely on, so it is blown by a Western wind, from there the original changes violently, eventually becoming the current phenomenon. Now, if we want to push back the wave of madness, if we don't take the promotion of cause and effect as the standard, then even if we have a good method, it won't be truly effective!

tieu_de: 12. Letter replying to Venerable Quang Dieu
tom_tat: The picture of the Three Saints was drawn very skillfully by [Truong] Mien Duong. Unfortunately, it was drawn with fingernails, so there were meticulous areas that could not be drawn. If you use a pen [to draw], it will be more dignified. As for the praise as mentioned, it is calculated to be composed of more than a hundred words...
noi_dung:
12. Letter replying to Venerable Quang Dieu

(20th year of the Republic - 1931)

The picture of the Three Saints was drawn very skillfully by [Truong] Mien Duong. Unfortunately, it was drawn with fingernails, so there were meticulous areas that could not be drawn. If you use a pen [to draw], it will be more dignified. As for the praise as mentioned, I planned to compose more than a hundred words, but because I never practiced writing, I couldn't write it. Therefore, just copy the manuscript, please write, then either write your name, or use An Quang's name, whatever is fine. The mountains and clouds are far away, but fortunately we can talk; Now I send Van Sao, Gia Ngon Luc, An Si Toan Thu, Quan Am Chant, Monk Tu Hien Ky, two parts of each, one part please keep for yourself, one part pass to Mr. Truong [Mien Duong]. Quang is old and his spirit is not strong enough. From now on, please do not rely on writing and ink. Even if you ask about things in the Dharma, please inquire with other high-ranking Dharma builders, so that each thing will be reasonable (Mr. Truong's praise for his good deeds, please see in the Praise chapter).

tieu_de: 13. Letter responding to layperson Duong Duc Quan
tom_tat: The phenomenon of Queen Enlightenment is of great benefit to those who study Buddhism. Regardless of whether he was reborn or fell into hell, let's not discuss it! If the person reciting Buddha's name knew the phenomenon of his death, it would certainly not...
noi_dung:
13. Letter responding to layperson Duong Duc Quan

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

The phenomenon of Queen Enlightenment is of great benefit to those who study Buddhism. Regardless of whether he was reborn or fell into hell, let's not discuss it! If the person reciting Buddha's name knew the phenomenon of his death, he would certainly not dare to pursue the dharma of ending birth and death in a superficial way anymore! Looking at his behavior and gestures, it seems to be very sincere, but considering the scenes shown when he was dying, in everyday life, he never made any effort to put effort into his mind, as well as perhaps in the past he had karma such as being stingy with money causing others to lose their lives, or being stingy with words causing others to lose their lives, etc., which turned out like that ("Being stingy with words causes others to lose their lives" is like knowing where there are robbers and knowing where there are robbers). You can't avoid it, but because your mind is not compassionate and likes to see others in trouble, you don't want to talk about it. This makes the heavens and the earth very angry. Therefore, at the time of death, you can't say anything, just like there are things like hating hearing the sound of Buddha's name, etc.) There is a situation where you don't die while there is someone reciting Buddha's name to help you chant. This is completely similar to being stingy with money and stingy with words, causing others to lose their lives. Although he did not fall as a hungry ghost, his temperament was that of a hungry ghost.

Some people say he was reborn thanks to Mr. Dich Tu Tuan's magical power. The power of mantra is of course inconceivable, but for people with heavy karma, it is not easy to enjoy the benefits! Therefore, if we know [for sure that he] has been reborn in the West, then luckily that will happen. Since there is no evidence, don't speculate. Some people say: [He] has fallen into the path of hungry ghosts; Based on what was said and the manifestations, it seems that [that guess] is well-founded. But perhaps because he repented in his heart, or because everyone and his children were sincere, he was relieved and did not fall directly into the realm of hungry ghosts. The current solution is for all children and relatives to think of his suffering, to develop the mind to benefit and forgive him, and to pray to Buddha to be kind enough to lead him to rebirth. If he is truly sincere, [his] rebirth is predictable. Because father and son have a natural relationship, the Buddha's mind responds to it. If your relatives and relatives act indifferently and negligently, it will be difficult to eliminate karmic obstacles and be guided by the Buddha! Thousands of pounds hang by a thread, relationships are extremely heavy!

Everyone who recites the Buddha's name should really focus on treating their own habits and creating convenience for others. Whatever needs to be said, even if people are hostile towards us, we must say it, making people happy, moving towards goodness, avoiding evil, and leaving suffering. Always speak frankly and clearly to others about cause and effect, the cycle of birth and death, and reciting Buddha's teachings to be free from birth and death, teach your children to establish a foundation of peace, your mind is like a straight string, your words are not ambiguous, your thoughts can be expressed frankly to ghosts and spirits, and you are determined not to do anything contrary to the principles of heaven, then at the time of death, those pitiful and pitiful phenomena will certainly not occur. Thus, Hoang Hau Giac is the one who guides everyone's teacher; Thanks to him everyone will benefit greatly in the future. He will also rely on everyone's mental strength to eliminate sins and attain rebirth. What Quang said here was not an even-handed statement29 but a decisive discussion that could not be lied about. If you don't think it's right, please ask wise masters and saints with great supernatural powers!

tieu_de: 14. Letter responding to layperson Ngo Hue Te
tom_tat: No one wants to give birth to good children, but eight or nine out of ten people teach their good children to become bad ones, later ruining the family's reputation, destroying the family's karma, becoming ordinary and stubborn.
noi_dung:
14. Letter responding to layperson Ngo Hue Te

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

No one wants to give birth to good children, but eight or nine out of ten people teach their good children to become bad ones, later ruining the family's reputation, destroying their ancestral karma, becoming mediocre, stubborn, or

The original text is "thu try bi phu" which is an idiom that means hesitation, undecided, catching the wind, any way is fine. We roughly translate it as "talking even".

turned into a bandit and bandit town, terrible. Making a fundamental mistake, in general, is due to not knowing how to love your child. From a young age, no matter how much he gets used to it, when he grows up he does everything on his own, doesn't listen to instructions, and mostly hangs out with and gets close to bad people, causing harm to society. Current natural disasters are mostly caused by people who don't know how to be parents! If those who are not taught, from the beginning are taught well by their parents, then those who do harm [to society] will all be those who bring benefits [to the country], those who only draw evil will become those who promote good, the world does not expect peace but peace itself. That is the fundamental and important path for husbands and wives to participate in fostering a peaceful world. When you promote Buddhism, for all predestined people, you should add this meaning to it more clearly, so that everyone can perfect their own way of being parents, which will be of great benefit! A daughter's relationship is even bigger, she is not raised at all and is not taught, causing problems for her family today ("not being taught" means that brothers and sisters do not follow the rules and are free to indulge), and in the future, they will cause trouble for their husband's family. Later, if you teach your children badly, they will be infected with that bad habit. Many people disregard this meaning and do not consider it. If you want a good family and good children, you must find a place to teach your children well!

tieu_de: 15. Letter responding to layperson Ly Trong Hoa
tom_tat: Having a daughter married helps lighten the burden a lot. Please advise her: "You should fulfill all the dharma of being a wife, be filial to your parents-in-law, respect your husband, get along with your sisters-in-law, be generous with your servants, still keep the Buddha's name, don't get married...
noi_dung:
15. Letter responding to layperson Ly Trong Hoa

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Having a daughter married helps lighten the burden a lot. Please advise her: "You should fulfill all the dharma of being a wife, be filial to your parents-in-law, respect your husband, be at peace with your sisters-in-law, be generous with your servants, still keep the religion of reciting the Buddha's name, don't get married and then leave [without reciting]. You must also gently advise your husband to recite the Buddha's name and Avalokiteśvara as a refuge for the future. By doing so, people who respect you, the god who protects you, who does not encounter evil, and good and bad things will all gather together. Not only you yourself will be glorious, but other people will also gather together because of you. Respect even the parents who gave birth to you; even though that family was well-educated, that girl had taken refuge in Buddhism, fasted, and recited Buddha's name, and now she is so good. It's not only her parents who are worthy of honor, but also the teacher who is filial and filial If you are kind and not filial, your parents will often be insulted by others, and the teacher you took refuge in will also be criticized for not being able to teach you how to be filial and respectful. I hope they are now good daughters, marry others and be good wives, and in the future become other people's good mothers!

Please consider wisely and tell them thoroughly: Earth Mother Sutra30, Sun Sutra, Tai Am Sutra, Kitchen God Sutra, Eye Light Sutra, Tho Sanh Sutra, Blood Tank Sutra, Dieu Sa Sutra, Fen Chau Sutra, etc. are all fake. Unfortunately, women's understanding is shallow, so they often believe in worship, so we should only teach them to recite Buddha's name. If you want to recite the sutra, you should recite the Heart Sutra, its text is small, its meaning is rich, and its merits are immeasurable and boundless. Those fake sutras, in terms of logic, reciting them is still a sin; It's just that they use their hearts and minds to recite, so it can't be said that they have absolutely no merit, they only have merit due to their sincerity but it's very small; Why is reciting the Buddha's name better than reciting the Heart Sutra? Reciting the Buddha's name and reciting the Heart Sutra's merits are like the ocean. Reciting fake sutras only yields one drop, or not even one drop!

tieu_de: 16. Letter responding to layperson Vuong Tho Banh (two letters)
tom_tat: All those who asked for refuge wrote their Dharma names on the return form. Because there are so many people, it is not possible to tell the reason [for each dharma name] for each person. I just hope he tells them to pay attention to maintaining moral integrity, taking full advantage of…
noi_dung:
16. Letter responding to layperson Vuong Tho Banh (two letters)

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

All those who asked for refuge wrote their Dharma names on the return form. Because there are so many people, it is not possible to tell the reason [for each dharma name] for each person. I just hope he tells them that they should pay attention to maintaining moral integrity, exhaust all duties, put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, do good things, and decide to recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, then they will not be ashamed to become Buddhist disciples. Nowadays, there are no water disasters in any country, or if we don't have this disaster, we will have that disaster. In general, it is due to people's hearts being too poor. We are Buddhist disciples, so we should take it as our duty to correct our current bad habits and not give in to them

The Earth Mother Sutra's full name is the Supreme Void Earth Mother Mysterious Transformation Nurturing Life Precious Life Sutra, with content praising Mother Earth, calling on people to respect Earth Mother because Earth Mother gives birth to all things, all images, even the golden bodies of Buddhas are created by Earth Mother (sic!). Mother Earth is highly revered in China. Ancient Chaos Phoenix Palace (temple worshiping Mother Earth in Yuli Town, Hualien District, Taiwan) even considers Earth Mother to correspond to the Creator God in Western mythology, and considers the titles Hongmeng Old To, Chaos Old To, Supreme Supreme Wuji, Old Mother Wuji to be nicknames of Mother Earth.

following the trend, causing [the world] to become even more degraded beyond measure!

His three children are all intelligent, and if taught well, they will become virtuous (people with good, upright nature). Otherwise, the more intelligent you are, the easier it is to make mistakes and mislead others. Therefore, I gave Kien Quoc the dharma name Hue Lap, which means: If you can establish your body, all things can be established. The body is the basis of the nation and the Bodhi path. If you cannot establish yourself, you will not be able to achieve anything in morality! The second child is Hue Tuyen, talented and intelligent, enlightened, both happy and worrying. Therefore, the dharma name was given as Hue Thao. If you can keep your talents secret, be modest, and not show off your talents, you can become righteous and have great achievements. If you lack nourishment and act arrogantly and show off, you will not enjoy blessings or achieve great achievements! The youngest daughter, Thuy Na, was also very capable and gave her Dharma name Hue Dieu. Dieu means reasonable and appropriate. If you use intelligence for useless and harmful things, it will become a vile wisdom, not called Dieu Hue. If that wisdom is applied properly, it is called Dieu Hue. Smart people today often use their own intelligence to [write] novels that suggest theft, lewdness, unreasonableness, and contempt for morality to show off their literary talent, not knowing: If one exhales without being able to inhale, after many lifetimes, I don't know if I will ever hear the words "heaven and earth, father and mother" or not? If those people don't have that vile wisdom, why are they in such extreme misery? Therefore, you should cultivate her so that every move and every move is in accordance with the right path. Her position as a mother in the royal palace or as a teacher who sets an example for women in the future can all be predicted from here. That's what Hue Dieu means.

Quang is already old and won't have time to see their achievements, but he hopes they will be like that. You should also often tell them those words so that when they look at the name and think of the meaning, it all meets their expectations!

Phan Mau Xuan wanted to take refuge and wrote a letter asking for refuge, why was there not a single word of supplication, nor a single word of humility? If you say he doesn't know, then you don't know either? In this world, when you want to ask people for directions while walking, you have to clasp your hands together to show respect, not to mention taking refuge in the Three Jewels, wanting to rely on them to escape birth and death, but in the end, considering it as a matter of dealing with ordinary people, it's really too much to not understand things! Quang said this not because he hoped to be respected by others, but because logically it should be like that. If he doesn't say anything, he'll just be a person who doesn't understand things all his life.

Emperor Thuan Tri of the Qing Dynasty honored Zen master Ngoc Lam as his teacher, and was given the Buddhist name Hanh Si. The king wrote a letter to Ngoc Lam's disciple, Hanh Sam, and signed it as "dharma disciple Hanh Si Hoan-nam". Hoa-nam (vandana) is the head. The emperor is still like that towards his fellow students, let alone towards his teacher? Should we not know these fragrant rules? The ancients said: "If you don't humble yourself deeply before others, you won't reach the truth); rather than saying: "My people, I will teach you with all my heart" (Humble yourself deeply before me, I will teach you with all my heart). Because we ourselves cannot have a respectful mind, even if people are willing to teach us, but in our own hearts there are arrogant things that cause obstacles and do not benefit us! For example, on the top of a high mountain there is not a single drop of water, so [trees] cannot grow luxuriantly! Not only studying Buddhism must be like that, but even learning a talent or profession in the world must be like that. [Occupation] in the world is just a way to make a living by body or mouth, but Buddhism is the source of the Path. The relationship between heavy and light is of course completely different. Please show this to him.

But now I only care about the mind, not the appearance, and give him the Dharma name Hue Mau. It means using wisdom to strive for yourself, encourage others, make everyone maintain moral integrity, fulfill all duties, abandon evil hearts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, obey good deeds, be faithful and make vows, recite the Buddha's holy name, and pray to be born in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss. If you can do that, you are a true Buddhist. Otherwise, just the name, no real benefit. Other things have been discussed in detail in Gia Ngon Luc, but are not written in detail here. Please tell him to always do his best.

tieu_de: 17. Letter responding to layperson Du Hue Uc
tom_tat: As it is said, "when faced with a great disaster, due to the lack of merit, there is nothing to hold on to, it is very possible to panic, become distraught, and lose mindfulness", then one should only deeply believe in the power of Buddha, the power of dharma, the power of one's own nature, the power of merit, the power of reciting the will...
noi_dung:
17. Letter responding to layperson Du Hue Uc

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

As it is said, "when faced with a great disaster, due to the lack of merit, there is nothing to hold on to, it is very possible to panic, become distraught, and lose mindfulness", then one should only deeply believe that Buddha's power, Dharma power, self-nature, merit, and recitation power are all inconceivable. Don't say there are no disasters,

(the most difficult mental illness to treat),

Even if you encounter a great disaster, you will not be distraught, because you have these forces to support you! All people should behave according to their status so that they will not be distraught due to bad circumstances. Most of the people who are distraught due to encountering bad circumstances do not have deep faith, and also have thoughts of regretting the previous situation, refusing to let go. Like when you are in trouble, you only think about how to avoid it, and don't worry about other things. Due to lingering concerns that cannot be resolved, they are harmed in vain. Therefore, it is said: "In case of misfortune, act on misfortune, the gentleman does not enter into the child without attaining peace" (Encountering a difficult situation, living according to the hardship; under no circumstances, the gentleman cannot be free) (The word Nhap (入) should be read as Nhu (如), meaning "passed". The Trung Dung book says "enter" so it is still written exactly like that book, but is actually the word Nhu). We rely on a Buddha's name, the more we suffer, the more actively we recite it, so we don't have to worry about "being distraught and unable to do anything!" If you often hold on to that fear, over time it will become sick, you can't help but know [this]!

tieu_de: 18. Letter responding to layperson Tong Hue Tram in Dich Huyen
tom_tat: Buddhism takes Filial piety as its root, and the Mahayana Sutras make [this] very clear. The sutras that speak most thoroughly and clearly are the Buddha's Retribution Sutra31, the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Infinite Life Sutra, the Buddha's Avalokiteshvara Sutra, and the Brahma Net Sutra. One word…
noi_dung:
18. Letter responding to layperson Tong Hue Tram in Dich Huyen

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

Buddhism takes Filial piety as its root, and the Mahayana Sutras make [this] very clear. The sutras that speak most thoroughly and clearly are the Buddha's Retribution Sutra31, the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Infinite Life Sutra, the Buddha's Avalokiteshvara Sutra, and the Brahma Net Sutra. The word "filial piety" [understood] in a limited sense is to worship one's parents; In a broad sense, anything that belongs to the Reason or the Mind but does not contradict it is called Filial piety. Otherwise, it's all filial piety. Students must practice [filial piety] both narrowly and widely in order to be able to call it "full filial piety". All sentient beings who enter the Dharma must see what they are like. Not only stupid people are difficult to educate, even people with great intelligence and great education are often not as good as stupid people [because stupid people] can still plant some good roots and not be slandered! We just rely on our fate to advise them. If you want everyone to follow Buddha's teachings, then absolutely

The Buddha's Retribution for His Grace Sutra's full name is the Great Convenience Buddha's Retribution for His Grace Sutra, which was translated in the Later Han Dynasty, but the translator's name is lost. This sutra is numbered 156 and is classified in the Origin Dependent section, belonging to volume 3 of the Dai Chanh Tan Tu Dai Pitaka. This sutra mainly narrates stories of self-sacrifice and filial piety when the Buddha was still practicing Bodhisattva conduct, such as the story of Prince Tu Dat Noa cutting meat to give to his parents while on a pilgrimage, as well as explaining some issues of precepts. This sutra was translated into Vietnamese by Venerable Quang Do before 1975.

There is no such good fate! You can only depend on fate with all your heart! Precepts are the basis of all good dharmas, you should read the Essentials of the Law of the House of Law32, but the scriptures of precepts are quite numerous, I'm afraid it's difficult to read them thoroughly and remember them thoroughly! Just keep in mind "don't do evil, do good". Whenever a thought arises in the mind, it does not let a single unwholesome thought germinate, then all precepts can be kept completely. If you only explore and consider the appearance of things, even if you don't violate any precepts, you still cannot be called a person who upholds the pure precepts, because in your mind you still have the appearance of breaking the precepts, that's how difficult it is!

At the age of 20, Mr. Cu Ba Ngoc knew that 19 years ago was wrong. At the age of 50, he knew that 49 years ago was wrong. He wanted to reduce his mistakes but still couldn't! At the age of seventy, Confucius hoped that God would give him a few more years to study the I Ching to avoid making a big mistake. These people are all guilty of not being able to completely align their minds with God's will, so it is not their actions or actions that are faulty. "Do not do evil, do good" is an important meaning in the Buddhist precepts. People with good abilities in the next life must devote their efforts here to be able to make good deals. When worshiping the Buddha, you should think that personally bowing to the Buddha will destroy immeasurable sins and increase immeasurable blessings. At a higher level, you should follow the Buddha's worship verse in the book [Pure Land] Ten Essentials to meditate, even better! Bodhi mind is the mind of self-benefit and benefit of others. If you wish to be born in the West, you must take Bodhi mind as the root in order to attain high status. If you only have the mind to pray for rebirth without the mind of Bodhi, then your merit will be low and it will be difficult to reach the highest level!

The full name of At Gia Luat is At Gia Luat Quang Tap, composed by Mr. Nguoi Ich and edited by Nghi Nhuan and Tran Hy Nguyen. This is a collection of sutras related to the precepts of lay Buddhists. This book includes an excerpt from the Four Parts of Discipline, the Upasaka Tathagata Sutra of the Three Refuges and Five Precepts Dharma Assembly (compilation of explanations on how to receive the Three Refuges and Five Precepts), the Three Refuges and Five Precepts of Compassion and Devotion from the Heart, the Empowerment of the Three Refuges and the Five Precepts to Protect the Body Mantra, Sa Mat Nang Dharma of Heavenly Sons and Recipients of the Three Refuges and Elimination of Evil Path Sutra, the Ten Good Karmas Tao Sutra, the Buddha's Precepts of the Elimination of Tai Sutra, the Buddha's Theory of the Upasaka and the Five Precepts The Essential Sutra, the Buddha's Explanation of the Mantra Sutra (commentary on Buddhist scriptures about the male world), the Contemplation of the Mind and the Generating the Bodhi Mind chapter of the Mahayana Bodhisattva Mind and Ground Contemplation Sutra, The Non-Buddhist Question of the Holy Mahayana Dharma of Selflessness, the Upasaka Sutra of the Upasaka Precepts (brief explanation of the important things in the Precepts chapter of the Upasaka Precepts Sutra), Upasaka Bodhisattva Five Precepts Dignity Sutra, summary of the commentary on the Buddha's Pham Doctrine Vong Heart Sutra, Bodhisattva Precepts, Pham Vong Sutra, Repentance, Dharma Practice, etc.

tieu_de: 19. Reply to layman Tran Trong Vi's letter
tom_tat: Only with reverence and sincerity can we fully achieve the true benefits of Buddhism. In addition, depending on whether your sincerity is large or small, you will receive large or small benefits. If it's only showy, colorful and false to please people's eyes and ears...
noi_dung:
19. Reply to layman Tran Trong Vi's letter

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Only with reverence and sincerity can we fully achieve the true benefits of Buddhism. In addition, depending on whether your sincerity is large or small, you will receive large or small benefits. If you only show off, are colorful and false to please the eyes and ears of others, you will most likely be guilty of contempt. He wanted to do meritorious deeds to pray for his parents' lives. It was truly filial, so why bother asking whether it was effective or not? Asking like that shows that your faith is not sincere or earnest! If you sincerely recite the Buddha's name and recite it to the extreme, you will be able to escape from birth and death, become a saint, and eventually become a Buddha. What's more, if you use your filial piety for your deceased parents, will it not be effective? I'm just afraid that if your heart is not very sincere, the benefits your parents will gain will not be very great. Seeing that in order to make merit to pray for his parents, he wrote a letter to ask me, but still did not humble himself, just showing respect and then I know that his concern for his parents is also superficial! You should develop a sincere mind so you can decide to rely on Buddha's power to be reborn in the West!

tieu_de: 20. Letter responding to layperson Tran Dat Hien
tom_tat: In the past, there were many great heroes and heroes. There were also people who carried the Buddha Dharma and devoted themselves to practice it. There were also people who learned a lot and listened a lot but never knew the meaning of the Buddha Dharma all their lives. There were also people who were completely...
noi_dung:
20. Letter responding to layperson Tran Dat Hien

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

In the past, there were many great and heroic heroes, some of whom carried the Buddha Dharma and dedicated themselves to practice it, and there were also people who learned a lot and listened a lot but never knew the meaning of Buddhism all their lives. There were also people who did not understand it at all, but neither praised it nor slandered it. There are people who know absolutely nothing about Buddhism, but arbitrarily criticize it based on their own will. There are also people who have deep admiration for Buddha Dharma and have stolen [Buddhist Dharma] to set up a temple and claim to be a hero, but they intentionally defame it to prevent everyone from learning Buddha Dharma. The knowledge of sentient beings is strangely illusory! Every time I think about it, I can't help but sigh in pain. You should take the story of suffering as a guide to enter the Dharma. If everything goes as expected, I'm afraid I'll be the one standing outside the door for the rest of my life, thinking that I've reached the limit and no one can better me! Misfortunes and blessings in the world arise or are hidden only depending on whether the person uses his mind skillfully or not?

Your wife can say that your previous life had good roots. She only advised you to recite the three holy scriptures33, but did not advise you to recite Buddha's name or Avalokiteśvara's name, which means she did not know the Buddhadharma. If you really knew, would you take refuge in the three holy scriptures during this uncertain time of birth and death? The three holy scriptures of course have great inspiration, but compared to reciting Buddha's name, how can reciting Quan Am's name be the same? When she died, it was as if she had practiced Pure Karma for a long time and knew before her death. If it is not a fabrication, then it is due to the ripening of good roots of pure karma in previous lives. He was warned in prison, and when he was about to die, he told his family, but from beginning to end he never told him to recite Buddha's name, perhaps because of "kindness, kindness, humanity, and filial piety" he would be born in heaven. If you are reborn in the West, you will definitely not be able to recite it to yourself at the time of death and not advise your family members to recite it. Now it is best to recite the Buddha's name for her, praying that she will be reborn before she is reborn. Once she is reborn, her dignity will be improved.

He sent a letter with quite urgent words, but still had the habit of disdaining the Sangha for his dharma. That habit is really an obstacle to studying Dharma. If you personally come to take refuge, [the shaman transmits the precepts] and ascends to the throne [to preach the precepts], he must bow his head about twenty, thirty times or more; Even if it's easy to say, I still have to bow my head a few times. He sent a letter asking for refuge, just saying "put your hands together and pray" and that's it. Clasping hands in greeting is a ritual of a passerby asking for directions. He wanted to take refuge in the Three Jewels to help escape birth and death, and also wanted to repay his wife's kindness and save all sentient beings. Expectations are very high, but conceal very little, a bit of the problem of inappropriate cause and effect! In the past, Emperor Thuan Tri wrote a letter to the disciples of the national teacher Ngoc Lam and also used [the word] "dharma to practice".

"Si hoa-nam" (Hanh Si is the dharma name of Thuan Tri). Comparing here and there, are they not as different as heaven and earth? Quang absolutely did not say that to ask for respect from others.

If based on reason, of course there is no person-self to achieve, let alone from beginningless time until now, we have successively become each other's parents, brothers, etc., in the future we will all become Buddhas to save sentient beings! Therefore, saying: "All sentient beings are parents in the past and Buddhas in the future", we cannot respect them enough, how can we dare to blame our shortcomings?

The Three Holy Scriptures are the most respected good books in China from the Ming - Qing period onwards, including Thai Thuong Touching Thien, Yin Chat Van and Giac The Kinh (according to Dr. Du Tu An of Hong Kong University). Giac The Sutra is the Quan Thanh De Quan Giac The Chan Sutra (legendly said to have been promoted by Quan Cong) with content that promotes goodness and shows cause and effect, so it is also highly respected by Chinese Buddhism.

of others? But maintaining Buddha Dharma without establishing serious rituals cannot make others respect and practice diligently! Therefore, in the Law [it is stipulated] "If you request the Dharma without respectful etiquette, do not speak!" Mr. Thuong Bat Contempt immediately bowed when he saw others. People used whips, sticks, tiles, and stones to hit and throw him, but he still ran away to worship. That was the direct basis of his being to sow seeds, not the way of maintaining the Dharma of ordinary people. I'm just afraid that you're attached to that title and think that Quang's view is narrow-minded, so I presented the general outline to you, which is also a way to eliminate afflictions! Arrogance is the root of afflictions. Studying Buddhism in this way is very helpful in treating afflictions, so I had to tell you.

Now, thanks to the mistakes, the dharma name is given to him as Duc Khiem. Khiêm (謙) means not being satisfied, thinking that everything is enough. The Diamond Sutra says: "Developing the mind to completely save all sentient beings, spiritually enter No Residual Nirvana, even the most unimaginable sentient beings attain nirvana" (developing the mind to completely save all sentient beings causes them to all enter No Residual Nirvana, but not a single living being is seen to be nirvana). For example, heaven protects and protects the earth, only exhausting the duty of being born, not relying on oneself to have the merit of being born. This is truly "there are no signs of self, people, sentient beings, or recipients". This is called a gentleman who is humble and has a good end. If you are humble, you will be able to shoulder everything that should be shouldered. Even though he has reached the status of a sage, he always knows that others are better than him, like the sea that accommodates rivers, like space that contains all images, and never rejects anything that is not tolerated or included. If you understand this meaning well, even though your body is tired, your mind will always be leisurely, you will know that benefit yourself. Other things that should be seen in the Van Sao series and Pure Land books are not fully recorded here.

Van Sao, especially for beginners, is a book that cannot be missed, because the language is shallow, close, and thorough, and there are many places that promote the principle of "living in the world, studying religion, cultivating in the secular world". By studying Buddhism, the basics of sincerity, right heart, sincerity, practice and moderation are all grasped! Buddha's teachings are so positive and charitable, those who do not know them arrogantly consider them negative, selfish, self-interested, considering the Buddha's ultimate method of saving people from suffering as a foolish method, misleading worldly people. Therefore, gradually accumulating up to now, it has become tragedies such as abandoning scriptures, abandoning morality, etc. I can't bear to hear about it! If everyone knows cause and effect and retribution, knows that death and consciousness are immortal, and that depending on sins and blessings, how can such a situation arise?

tieu_de: 21. Reply to the letters of laymen Yuan Xiaogu and Cao Tungqiao
tom_tat: I can't bear to read the letter [you guys] sent me, why are our people facing this great calamity! The flood water had just receded, the dike had not yet been repaired, the water rose again, making it even more disastrous. What's more, the bandits and bandits have not been calmed down, and the disasters of war...
noi_dung:
21. Reply to the letters of laymen Yuan Xiaogu and Cao Tungqiao

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

I can't bear to read the letter [you guys] sent me, why are our people facing this great calamity! The flood water had just receded, the dike had not yet been repaired, the water rose again, making it even more disastrous. What's more, the bandits haven't been calmed down yet, and the scourge of war has arisen again, leaving the common people with no reason to live! Recently, I heard that relief money and clothes have been continuously donated, but who is willing to give up frivolous jewelry to make merit? Recently, there are women who have gold rings or bracelets that they criticize as outdated, but they are told to contribute to the relief effort. Looking at the situation, they still refuse to spend. Yesterday, the Duong Gia of Linh Nham Pagoda, Master Dieu Chan, arrived. The entire community in the pagoda reduced their expenses, and collected two hundred and twenty-eight dong, which today was sent to Cao Phu to help the Giang Bac region.

Last time, after Hankou was hit by a flood, Linh Nham contributed more than one hundred and twenty yuan, sending it to Shanghai to hand over to the Hankou Disaster Relief Association. The almsgiving of the monks can be said to be wholehearted and not lacking. Those who have money in this world still do not feel sorry for the people who have suffered accidents. They are called foolish people who waste their efforts to accumulate money for their children and grandchildren to waste! This is called "throwing away merit to commit sins", making people with clear eyes feel pity. Isn't it sad that if that person encounters an accident in the next life he won't be able to find anyone else to help him? Isn't it pitiful? I only hope that you will be protected by the Buddha family, your body and mind will persevere and work hard, so that people who are suffering from calamities will be protected and not be left without help and nowhere to turn. Ten days ago, due to a broken dike, the orphanage was also flooded with water, leaving more than twenty rooms still unflooded. Later, the water rose even higher, leaving only more than ten compartments. Many walls in the hospital collapsed, and the planted cotton, fruits, and vegetables were all submerged by the water. The loss this time is not too small, what should we do now? The suffering of people suffering from disasters can be said to be extreme. We should teach them to recite Buddha's name and Quan Am's name. Because of that cause and effect, sowing good roots is also a fundamental way of saving people! In this great suffering, seeing you not sparing the spirit of providing relief and teaching them to recite Buddha's name will make them believe

receive easily.

tieu_de: Letter responding to layperson Duong Hue Xuong
tom_tat: Mr. Luu Han Van can be said to have had good roots in the past, but after believing in Buddhism for many years, he should have become a vegetarian soon, so why did he wait until he was in his prime (sixty) to develop his mind? Therefore, we know that: Secular habits are not easy...
noi_dung:
Letter responding to layperson Duong Hue Xuong

(two letters. This man's name was Tu Xuong)

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Mr. Luu Han Van can be said to have had good roots in the past, but after believing in Buddhism for many years, he should have become a vegetarian soon, so why did he wait until he was in his prime (sixty) to develop his mind? Therefore, we know that: Secular habits are not easy to change! Now that I have been able to change it, I can call it strong will. He had often read the Literature of the Stars and naturally his mind clearly understood the method of practice. The most important thing is to decide to pray until the moment of death to be welcomed by Buddha to be reborn in the West. If you want to be born in the West, you must daily devote yourself to deep faith, earnest vows, sincerely recite the Buddha's name, love the purity of the Pure Land, and be tired of the evil depravity of the Saha world. Practicing yourself like that, teaching others is the same. Don't have a thought of wishing that in the next life you will enjoy the blessings of humanity and heaven, that you will be able to touch the Tao and communicate with Buddha, and decide that you can rely on the Buddha's power to be reborn in the West, become a saint, and escape birth and death. Now I have given him the dharma name Hue Van, which means using the cloud of great wisdom to pour out a rain of nectar dharma to saturate both myself and others (that is "hue cloud dharma vu"), that is, "truly for the sake of birth and death, to develop Bodhisattva."

Focus your mind, use deep faith, pray earnestly, recite the Buddha's name, and seek rebirth in the West."

He once had great compassion for the souls who died from hemorrhage during childbirth. But for all women, we should also create a way so that they will forever be free from bleeding during childbirth, so that they can leave suffering and enjoy happiness in this life. How is that? If you are a girl, from a young age you should recite Buddha's name and Avalokiteśvara's name to eliminate karma and increase blessings. If you meditate regularly, you will be able to eliminate this accident during childbirth. As at the time of giving birth, you should still sincerely recite "namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva" and you will definitely have an easy birth and not have to suffer. If during normal times you absolutely do not recite Buddha's name or Quan Yin, but when you are giving birth, you will recite it and you will definitely have a peaceful birth. If someone has difficulty giving birth, teach that person to recite and the surrounding caregivers recite together for that person, and immediately decide to have a peaceful birth.

Don't say, "While giving birth, naked and unclean, reciting [Bodhisattva's name] will be a sin!" You must know: This is the time when life is involved, you cannot use normal morality to make judgments. In normal times, if a person recites Buddha's name, if their clothes and hat are not neat, or if they sleep, bathe, wash, urinate, etc., they should only chant silently in their mind, and should not recite clearly. When giving birth, you should not chant silently in your mind, but must recite clearly, because chanting silently is weak. If you try too hard in your mind, you will most likely get sick. Reciting clearly will make your breathing clear, very useful, don't say "reciting will cause sin!" You must know: Bodhisattvas view all sentient beings as their own children. If a child falls into water or fire, they ask their parents for help. The parents hear and immediately save them. They should not save them because their clothes are not neat or their body is not clean! If in normal times one recites the same as when [because one cannot help but has to] be naked, then the sin is not small. We need to reason according to the facts, don't be stubborn! Some people do not understand the reason, whenever someone in the house gives birth, they hide away for more than a month before daring to return, thinking that if they are attacked by blood, the sutras, mantras, and Buddha's names that have been recited before will become without any merit! Those fools deserve extreme pity! You should spread Quang's words to everyone, surely no one will die from childbirth anymore!

Internal practice (internal practice) is self-cultivation; External merit is to practice generous means, such as: helping those in need, rescuing people in distress, rescuing people from accidents, etc. This is called Assisting Dao. These things should be based on one's own strength and ability [to do]. If you don't have the strength, you can either use words to point out the ignorant, or use words to advise the masses, making everyone achieve their goals. If someone asks you to recite sutras and Buddha's name, you are still a lazy person and have the behavior of relying on Buddha to make a living. Why are you mixed in there, aren't you afraid of losing your own dignity? There was only one thing worth doing, but he had a career, so it wasn't very convenient; [that is] whenever there is a person who recites Buddha's name every day, or that person's descendants believe in Buddha, when that person is about to die, invite lay people to come and help recite the Buddha's name, the benefit is very great. Please read the book General Strength Tan Luong and you will know for yourself.

People who recite Buddha's name should often tell them [the benefits of reciting the Buddha's name] in front of their own parents and other relatives, so that when someone dies and all the relatives in the family recite the Buddha's name, that person [about to die] will rely on the Buddha's power to be born in the West. Even if you are not born in the West, you will still be born in a good path, with great benefits and not the slightest harm! If you don't know this, before you die, you'll have to take a bath and change your clothes. If you feel pain due to being moved, anger will immediately arise. Even though you don't get angry, after a moment of movement, your mind will not be pure. If you are an ordinary person who recites Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, experiencing such a time, you will definitely lose your mindfulness and will not be able to be reborn! If you cry before death and cause that person [about to die] to have attachment, it will also entice that person to fall. A final hurdle is extremely urgent, so you should support your thoughts. The chanting assistant needs to carefully read the book Tan Luong Chung's Strength, and tell the children and relatives in the house to follow the chanting assistant's instructions, so that out of filial piety, their parents will have to suffer and fall! Besides chanting, everything should not be done. If this style (i.e. this way of coping) is circulated, wouldn't the practice of good men and women reciting Buddha's name become a common way of behaving? People who understand reason choose good things to do, people who don't understand reason only see benefits and follow them, people with a career miss out on work, lazy people rely on it to tease, not only causing obstacles for the Sangha but also for the family itself.

23. Reply to layman Thang Van Huyen's letter (two letters)

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Yesterday, Master Minh Dao brought your letter. Reading his words to reveal repentance, one can be called a person with good will, but every day one must expand [that repentant mind], so as not to turn the power of merit and virtue of Buddha nature into a basis to create evil karma and endure extreme suffering. A sin as great as the heavens cannot resist a single word of Repentance. "Saints lose their thoughts and become crazy. When crazy overcomes their thoughts, they become saints." The minds of Yao, Shun, Buddha, Bodhisattva and our mind have the same sense of being; But because we practice against our nature, we are immersed in the suffering of sentient beings. You know you're wrong, so you should try your best to correct it. For everything, you can try your best to change it and reach the point where there are no more mistakes. If you only feel temporary shame, then every time you hesitate to practice, you will still sink into the same ocean of guilt, unable to escape! Please read the books carefully and you will gradually reach a better place, so that you don't end up living in vain and dying, living like wood, stone, or animals in the world, a life that is useless to people, but also harmful to people!

Regarding taking refuge, let's take our time. If you still do not change your old habits, taking refuge will become a sin. Why is that? If you don't take refuge, then when you create karma, you won't commit dharma destruction. After taking refuge, people still create karma. Surely people will rely on the fact that they have taken refuge and still create karma, so they will slander Buddhism as bad. Moreover, you want to take refuge but completely refuse to humble yourself, how can you satisfy your wishes? Passersby turn to others to ask for directions and have to clasp their hands together to show respect. Now, if you want to take refuge in the Three Jewels, you still do not clasp your hands in respect, meaning that your tendency to be arrogant and arrogant has not been conquered at all. How can you take refuge? If you personally come to ask for refuge, [the shaman] goes up to the court to explain the refuge dharma, [the person asking for refuge] must bow his head thirty or forty times, kneeling for about an hour. Even if you say it easily, you still have to kowtow dozens of times! Who dares to commit the crime of disrespecting the Dharma so that he can take refuge? Taking refuge is like worshiping a teacher in the world. Don't those who worship a teacher in this world also follow the ritual of clasping their hands? If we look at it from the root, all sentient beings are parents in the past and Buddhas in the future. We can't even do enough to worship and make offerings, so how dare we blame anyone for lacking respect! If we discuss the concept of maintaining the Dharma, those who do not humble themselves and let them take refuge will themselves commit a very serious sin!

Anyone can be Yao or Shun, anyone can become a Buddha. Those who cannot be Yao, Shun, and cannot become Buddhas are because they do not have the will to do so. If you don't have will, you won't be ashamed, you'll rest in the fate of a foolish mortal, reincarnating in the three paths and six paths for a long lifetime, unable to escape! He felt ashamed and wanted to become a saint, a sage, to study Buddha and the Patriarchs, of course it was created by the good roots of previous lives. You should "do a new thing every day" to completely get rid of all previous inappropriate thoughts and actions. One stroke of the knife cuts it in half, don't "even if you leave your thoughts, there will still be threads of your heart", lingering, hesitant, will soon return to the old path, buried in the same ten types of evil karma, causing the available Buddha nature to "clarify Minh Virtue" to be obscured and unable to manifest, using the status of becoming a saint, becoming a Buddha to lie in Jam La prison, facing good hell34, isn't that sad?

Now the dharma name given to him is Hue Chan, meaning to use wisdom to stir up and stop, so that both oneself and others can become saints, escape birth and death, escape the five impurities of the evil life, and rise to the nine-level lotus realm. The books sent previously can be relied upon to practice, but

Good prison: warden, prison guard. Here are the demons guarding hell.

Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc are the most important. Compared to Van Sao, Gia Ngon Luc is less laborious to read. Please read carefully and the method of cultivating in this world and beyond the world will be fully understood. I will not write in detail here! Quang is old and his spirit is not strong enough, so he doesn't often send letters, and when he does, he doesn't respond. The outline of the Pure Land dharma is the three items of Faith - Prayer - Behavior, the core of practice is "taking care of all six senses, continuing with pure mindfulness", no need to say much. If you practice diligently, you will personally reap the benefits. If you want to be a great family member, you will probably put aside the dharma of birth and death right in this life, which is very pitiful!

24. Letter replying to layperson Ngo Thuong Chau (three letters)

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

The epidemic is spreading, your wife and children are all sick, teach them all to sincerely recite Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. If you can recite the Great Compassion Mantra, then bless them with Great Compassion water for them to drink, and they will be healed on their own, without needing to diligently treat them. What he said seemed to grasp the general idea, but it was just nonsense, completely useless! There are countless methods of Buddhism, but all must be practiced until the karma is exhausted in order to be able to escape birth and death! Otherwise, even if you have it, it will still be the same, there is nothing you can do about birth and death! As at present, I'm afraid that in the whole world it will be difficult for even one or two people to reach the status of dedicated karma! There is only one method of reciting the Buddha's name, if you have full faith, sincere vows, and sincerity in reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West. Even if your whole body is filled with karma, you can still rely on the Buddha's magnetic force to be reborn in the West. That is called "rebirth in the karma zone." Whenever one is born in the West, one will escape birth and death and become a saint. Therefore, most of the good intellectuals of the End of Time focused on the Pure Land; Because Pure Land is easy to perform, highly successful, uses little effort, and achieves quick results.

There are often intelligent people who understand the teachings a bit, or know a little about Zen, so they consider themselves wise people, scorn reciting Buddha's name, and think reciting Buddha's name is something for stupid men and women to do! These are all people who do not know how to self-examine, are crazy people, thinking that "understanding the meaning according to the written word is the truth", they are definitely the type of "saying no, doing yes", using their bodies to defame the Dharma, in the future they will definitely fall into the three evil paths, being pitied by foolish husbands and foolish women reciting Buddha's name to be reborn in the West but unable to be saved!

He vowed to take refuge, and now gave him the Dharma name Hue Thuong, implying: Changing the name does not change the body35, but the word Thuong in the past (i.e. the word Thuong in the real name) meant that both oneself and others were immeasurably immersed, now relying on Buddhist practice, immediately becoming both oneself and others, receive immense benefits. Although the same [meaning] is immense, the difference between the causes [of these two things] is naturally just as immense as [the difference] between the sky and the abyss!

The method of practicing reciting the Buddha's name along with maintaining moral ethics, exhausting all duties, eliminating evil thoughts, maintaining sincerity, not doing evil things, doing good things, etc., Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc have all said in full, this is not written in detail. I've seen his photo, but Quang's photo [of course] doesn't exist! Because Quang does not like to show off. I don't like doing anything like performing or showing off. He said that in the past, at Ham Su Truong's place36, he found Quang's biography, but that statement is not true. Mr. Ham of course believed in Buddha, but never asked Quang any questions, afraid he might hear some questions from Tran Dai Tam, but Quang insisted on not telling others about the past. What he said must have been recent. If it's something before becoming a monk, it's all added up. Recently, due to the diagnosis37 [he] came to my village, the biographies written for him by the village people were not accurate, because Quang left home fifty-two years ago, and those who were born after him only knew one or two stories. He told Quang to complete it. Quang complained that his death was near and he did not want to leave a bad name for the world so he did not supplement it. Later, he wrote a letter asking for additional information. Quang sent him a package of books, but still did not reply to the letter. I tell you this because you said you know Quang's history.

All of your relatives are willing to recite the Buddha's name. It can be said that in the past, you had a predestined relationship with the Buddha, so you can become relatives with each other. He said that soon he would accompany his wife to To land, but the thief said it was not necessary. If you can sincerely recite Buddha's name, then there is nothing lacking! Even if you don't meet An Quang, you won't lose anything! Even if we meet face to face, besides Van Sao, is there any other magical dharma "orally transmitted, secretly transmitted"?

This lay person's name is Thuong Chau. The Patriarch immediately used the word Thuong in his name to name the dharma, so he said: "Changing the name does not change the body."

The Commander-in-Chief here is Mr. Ham Ngoc Con, the leader of the division guarding Tung District in Shaanxi (this army is often referred to as Tran Tung Quan).

Distributing: Providing relief, donating relief goods to victims of natural disasters and war.

Uh? If there really is a wonderful dharma that is "orally transmitted, secretly given", then that person is a demon king, a heretic, so it is too late to stay away, let alone want to seek that dharma from that person? What's more, at this time of famine, if the key people in the house are all away for a few days, it's very possible that petty, bad people will take the opportunity to steal. If that were the case, not only would he and his wife be criticized for being superstitious, but people would also say that Quang's lack of virtue would cause trouble for others! Layman Trieu Van Bang took refuge with shaman Ung Tu38, very good, very good; What is the need to take refuge with Quang anymore? If you insist on taking refuge, is there a name or no name to speak of? In the seventh year of the Republic of Korea (1918), Tu Uy Nhu and Quang had never met before, but in the first year of the Republic of Korea (1911) they saw Phat Hoc Tung.

The newspaper published a few articles by Thuong Tam (this is not my name, just a random name used because I don't want others to know my name). I don't know if he is a monk or a layman, so I often listen. By the fifth year of the Republic of Korea (1916), he had already heard about it, so he relied on his friend to ask him to correspond, but Quang refused and was not satisfied. By the seventh year of the Republic of China (1918), [Mr. Tu] printed more than twenty star astronomy into books. He followed his mother to Putuo and asked for refuge. Quang taught him to take refuge with De Nhan (he left the mountain and invited the Dharma Master De Nhan to go to the capital to preach the sutras). In the 17th year of the Republic of China (1928), he sent a letter saying: "In the past, I wanted to take refuge. You taught me to take refuge with De Nhan. During the past ten years, I still feel unsatisfied. I still ask you to accept me taking refuge." Quang answered him: "You definitely want to take refuge, that's fine, but the dharma name is still the dharma name given by De Nhan39, why is there a need to give another dharma name?'
