Mr. Trieu has taken refuge with monk Ung Tu, if he still wants to worship Quang, do so

Dharma Master Ying Ci (1873-1965), native of Anhui province, Dharma name Hsien Than. In the year Guangxu 24 (1898), he became a monk at Tam Thanh Temple in Nanjing. Four years later, he received Full Precepts at Thien Dong Pagoda in Triet Giang with Venerable Bat Chi Dau Tu as the Venerable Precepts Conferr. After that, he studied with Da Khai at Thien Ninh pagoda. In the year of Quang Tu 34 (1908), together with Nguyet Ha, the shaman was initiated by Venerable Da Khai. Later, Master Nguyet Ha assigned him the task of leading Dharma Realm Academy. In the 12th year of the Republic of China (1923), the monk took charge of the Bo De Pagoda in Hangzhou, and not long after opened the Thanh Luong Academy. Throughout his life, he took the propagation of the Avatamsaka Sutra as his aspiration, took Zen as his sect, and proposed engraving and printing three translations of the Avatamsaka Sutra as well as exegetical works of the Avatamsaka Sutra such as Phap Tang's Five Chapters of the Avatamsaka Sutra, Chengguan's Avatamsaka Great Commentary on the Stars, and commentaries of the Lotus Sutra, Shurangama, Lankavatara, etc. He passed away in the 54th year of the Republic of China (1965) in Shanghai, at the age of 93. When To An Quang wrote this letter, shaman Ung Tu was 58 years old.

Mr. Tu Uy Nhu's real name is Van Uy, Uy Nhu is the dharma name given to him by the magician De Nhan.

grandfather.

Teachers should discuss according to the Quang practice method mentioned, not based on the Dharma name! The dharma spoken by Master Ung is the Mahayana dharma, and the Light dharma mentioned is neither Great nor Small, it is both Great and Small, it is a dharma that up to the Enlightened Bodhisattva, down to ordinary people on the ground all practice together and attain, of course we should pay attention to this dharma. If we superficially consider it the same as all Mahayana dharmas, the story of escaping birth and death will surely take a very long time! He said "throwing everything away to be saved", in the end, it only benefits one person, leaving the three children alone. So, take your time!

Ordinary people have never personally attained Buddha Nature, all the merits of Self Nature are completely undiscovered and unused, so everything must follow karma. The physical body in the present life is called the Sambhogakaya Body, which is the retribution of good or evil deeds done in previous lives. Although people who recite Buddha's name no longer create the karma of birth and death, their karma has not yet ended, so how can they be reborn immediately? If the mind is bored with the world and is passionate, devoted to sincerity, devoted to reverence, single-mindedly reciting Buddha's name, praying to Buddha early to invite him to come and guide him, then there will also be people [who will soon be reborn]! If you destroy your own life hoping to be reborn, you will become a ghost of death in vain (ghost of unjust death)! Because that person's efforts have not been achieved and he destroys his life, while destroying his life, his mind has lost mindfulness. Not to mention the suffering caused by self-destruction cannot be exemplified! If the mind loses mindfulness, how can it correspond to the Buddha and be guided by the Buddha? This wrong view misleads oneself, misleads others, and causes extreme harm! Do not say such words so that the ignorant will not be harmed!

People with power can easily save people and save lives, but it's also easy to harm people and ruin lives! If you use the power you gain from harming people to save lives, then of course it is not as good as devoting yourself to charity and depending on your ability to save people and save lives, it will be beneficial and not harmed! If you admire power and want to have the power to save people and save lives, please consider carefully: Is it possible to achieve such great power without paying the price? If you truly practice with your heart, even if you don't have power, you can still save people and save lives, just not as big as [people] with power! If you have power and can do things to save people and life, and only want to focus on religion and not create bad karma, then there is no such type of person today! Wealth makes people extremely fascinated and terrifying! If ordinary people pass money through their hands, even though it is not yet their own, their thoughts have changed and they do evil things. Let alone how many people have great power but their minds do not change? Don't misunderstand, you are very lucky, but Buddha Dharma

so lucky too!

tieu_de: 25. Letter responding to layperson Ninh Duc Tan
tom_tat: Paying respects to Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, you can recite them silently in your mind or recite them out loud. Reciting the Heart Sutra before or after the Amitabha Sutra is fine. Because at the beginning of the sutra, he recited "Lien Tri Hai Assembly of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas" three times, so reciting the Amitabha Sutra, noting...
noi_dung:
25. Letter responding to layperson Ninh Duc Tan

(In the year of the Republic of Korea 20 - 1931, this man's original name was Chi Vu)

Paying respects to Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, you can recite them silently in your mind or recite them out loud. Reciting the Heart Sutra before or after the Amitabha Sutra is fine. Because at the beginning of the sutra, one recites "Lien Tri Hai Assembly of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas" three times, so after reciting the Amitabha Sutra, the Rebirth mantra, then reciting the Heart Sutra. The word Doa (埵) can be read like the word Doa (朵) or Hoach (獲).

No Birth Forbearance means that for all realms of good - evil, mortal - holy, there is absolutely no thought "to be born with a moving mind that has a form to achieve". The Diamond Sutra teaches: "The three minds that cannot be attained are the Non-Birth-Forbearance" (the three complete minds that cannot be attained are the Non-Birth-Forbearance) is the footnote to the No-Birth-Forbearance. Also don't say "for all the complete realms, without a single thought, the mind will turn into a dry tree and cold ash". ["For all the complete realms, there is not a single thought that gives rise to a single thought"] implies: Quiet and motionless, like a bright mirror that is empty without anything, but when you feel it, you understand it, like a bright mirror, whenever it has an image, its shadow appears. Even when the image appears, the shadow is still empty without anything. Just because "it's empty and has nothing" so "whenever there is a shape, it immediately appears". Vo Sanh Nhan is a bit like that, I hope you understand carefully. Realizing this will enter the position of Great Bodhisattva, this is not something you and I are capable of achieving.

Interference with the Buddha should be like the sun and moon from the East to the South, through the West, to the North, not from the East to the North, through the West, or down to the South, because following the interference (interference in the right direction) has merit, disobeying the Buddha results in sin. The Western Regions attach the most importance to the way of "circumambulation" (circumambulation), they consider circumambulation equivalent to worshiping, meaning to obey the Buddha. When reciting Buddha's name, recite Quan Yin immediately, there is no need to start reciting the Avalokiteśvara chant separately. After reciting Buddha's name, immediately recite Quan Yin and you'll be fine. Dai Si40 is the nickname of Bodhisattva, all Bodhisattvas can be called Maha Bodhisattva, not just Avalokiteshvara.

Mahasattva is the translation of the word Mahasattva. According to the Dharma of Flowers and Owls, because the Bodhisattva benefits himself and others, has great vows and great conduct, he is called a Great Being. Sometimes, according to some sutras, such as in Tap A Ham, volume 48, the word Dai Si is used to translate the word Mahāpurusa

Often taught, it is completely useless! Often, if you can think and understand, a single sentence will have more than enough benefits; If you can't think and understand, then it's useless to write down all the teachings in the Tripitaka! The situation now is not the same as it was before June this year. Giang Nam and Giang Bac are both flooded, it's heartbreaking to hear! Natural disasters and man-made disasters continue to occur, so teach your family members to recite Quan Yin together as a precaution!

tieu_de: 26. Letter responding to lay people Liu Han Van and Duong Huicong
tom_tat: When faced with this great disaster, it will be of great benefit to set up a relief plan according to one's own strength to fulfill one's vocation. Quang always does nothing, but all the money is given as alms by [others]...
noi_dung:
26. Letter responding to lay people Liu Han Van and Duong Huicong

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

When faced with this great disaster, it will be of great benefit to set up a relief plan according to one's own strength to fulfill one's vocation. Quang always did nothing, all the money donated by [others] was printed in books, or used for disaster relief. In June of this year, Hankou had his first water disaster. Master Minh Dao went to Shanghai and donated one hundred yuan on his behalf. Later, when the water rose even higher, he donated another hundred dong. A disciple from the Vu Ho area suffered a water disaster and sent a letter [asking Quang to organize] a collection for relief. Quang answered him: Quang has always refused to donate graves, not to mention during the retreat, he vowed to give me two hundred dong every year as money for expenses, please use that money to help, from now on there will be no need to give me money anymore! It's up to you to donate two hundred, or four hundred, six hundred, eight hundred or one thousand. After that, a disciple, Mr. Cao Tung Kieu, went to Giang Bac to relieve the disaster and sent a telegram to advise Quang to contribute. Quang sent a thousand money to print books for relief. Mr. Cao Hac Nien sent a letter asking for disaster relief. Quang ordered someone to give him two hundred and thirty dong. Having contributed to such disaster relief this year, Quang did not say this to boast about his merits, but rather to let everyone have the same heart, depending on their fate and ability to help. If you have the strength, do your best, if you don't have the strength, use your words to advise those who have the strength, that's also a good thing.

Furthermore, today's women should not wear jewelry on their heads, bracelets, earrings, or rings. If you wear them, you will bring disaster. If you leave it to your children, it will bring disaster to them. If you die and bury it with you, you will definitely face the problem of digging up a grave to reveal your body, which is very humiliating! If you are willing to [bring those jewelry] to disaster relief

(often translated as Supreme Master), meaning the supreme scholar, one of the ten titles of the Buddha.

It means "putting away misfortunes and bringing blessings". Please express this meaning to everyone. If women were willing to give alms like that, the amount of money would be very large. Don't take my words as far-fetched, but these are sincere and sincere words. The rich people in Cao Biao and Thieu Ba41 in the past never thought about their children and grandchildren, and refused to [give alms] any relief. The floodwaters rose, houses, furniture, and family members were all torn apart, and there was not even one left! In each village, dozens of households searched for a pot and an oven but could not find one. Mr. Cao Tung Kieu in Duong Chau bought pots, stoves, rice, firewood, donated a pot to every dozen households, and used a big boat to transport it. In each village, small boats are used to bring people there. Talking about [this] makes people cry. Some houses have not collapsed yet and snakes and centipedes are all over them, so even if people want to enter the house, they don't dare to enter. It's the same on the tree, extremely pitiful! If women still want to keep things that bring disaster and refuse to use them for relief, I am afraid that in their next life they will also encounter this disaster, with no one willing to save them!

tieu_de: 27. Letter responding to layman Liu Duc Ho
tom_tat: Command42 knows that praying to the Sangha and reciting Buddha's name to increase longevity, you should often recite Buddha's name yourself to pray for rebirth. If you only rely on others to pray for a long life, don't know how to pray to Amitabha Buddha so that when your own lifespan ends...
noi_dung:
27. Letter responding to layman Liu Duc Ho

tieu_de: 34. Letter to layperson Ta Duc Hoai
tom_tat: Yesterday, I received a letter from Mr. Phan Trong Thanh saying that he, his mother and his sister all wanted to take refuge. noi_dung:
34. Letter to layperson Ta Duc Hoai

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Yesterday, I received a letter from Mr. Phan Trong Thanh saying that he, his mother and his sister all wanted to take refuge. Once you have made up your mind to take refuge, you should earnestly recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West. Because your mother is old, you should actively advise her to put everything down and single-mindedly recite Buddha's name. When it comes to death, you should not follow the worldly way of doing things. You should read Tan Luong Chung's Strength carefully to avoid ruining your great rebirth. He and his sister should also take the matter of rebirth in the West as important, not just pray for blessings in this life and blessings in the next life! Now giving his mother the dharma name Hue Kinh, with Kinh plus Hue, she can quickly cut off ordinary emotions. If ordinary emotions do not arise, mindfulness will be clear and you will definitely be able to be reborn in the West! Giving him the Dharma name Hue Tinh, meaning using Hue to water and bathe, worldly thoughts will be destroyed and mindfulness will be pure. He gave his sister the dharma name Hue Hinh, implying: The mind is mindful, fragrant and clean, as wonderful as a lotus flower. You should read Gia Ngon Luc carefully, then the method of cultivating and educating children and the morality of "keeping morality intact, fulfilling all duties" will be clearly understood.

Tan Luong's General Health book talks about the benefits of chanting at the time of death. The preface to Dat Sanh Thien54 clearly states the story of reciting Avalokiteshvara during childbirth. Because the two events of birth and death are the biggest events in human life, the suffering of childbirth is truly the greatest suffering of women. Previously, Quang did not mention this matter, but later, because he knew that difficult birth was very pitiful, he promoted it widely (When giving birth, you must recite it out loud.

If you chant silently in your mind, not only will your strength be weak and it will be difficult to sympathize, but you will also be afraid that you may be injured due to exertion.) Everyone who follows and recites will not be able to give birth safely. I pray that those who teach women to recite Buddha's name every day will automatically avoid that suffering. Even if you are a person who does not recite, but when you are giving birth and recite, you will immediately see a strange effect. At that time, you should only be sincere, don't be shy because of being naked and impure, and don't suspect that you have committed a crime but don't dare to recite it, then both mother and child will enjoy no greater benefit!

Dat Sanh Thien is a sacred book about how to cut off desires to nurture pregnancy compiled by layman Can Trai. Please see details in the "Preface to the reprint of the two sacred books Dat Sanh and Phuoc Au" numbered 37 in the Self section of An Quang Dharma Master Van Sao Tuc Bien, volume Lower.

tieu_de: 35. Letter to layperson Quach Vu Tam

Now he knows that over the past fifty-six years, the three karma of body - mouth - mind are not pure, but the karma of mind is the heaviest. That's because the mind karma is the master, because the mind karma gives rise to good or evil thoughts, so the body and mouth speak good and evil words and do good and evil things. Now that you know how to be ashamed, if you want to take refuge in Buddhism as a basis for your future practice, of course you should actively maintain moral integrity, fulfill all duties, put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, do good things, have faith, make a vow to recite the Buddha's name, pray to be born in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, and then you will be able to become a saint, and will be free from birth and death.

After a long time like this, bad thoughts will naturally not arise. If the mind karma is pure, the body and mouth will also be pure. The three pure karma of reciting the Buddha's name, the merit is so vast that it is indescribable! But if the three karmas are not yet pure, you have to be very sincere in reciting Buddha's name to pray for purity. Don't misunderstand and think that if the three karmas are not pure, reciting Buddha's name has no merit at all! tieu_de: 37. Letter to layperson Tran Ngan Thanh

37. Letter to layperson Tran Ngan Thanh

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Recently, his body must have been very healthy. When you are old and frail, you have many children and grandchildren, you should leave the house and shop affairs to your children to take care of, and yourself should be a leisurely person without worrying about anything, day and night with a pure mind reciting "namo Amitabha Buddha" and "namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva", you will definitely have peace of mind and body in the present, and when you die, you will be reborn in the West. The issue of female beauty is still a hindrance to youth, let alone old age? You have taken refuge in the Buddha's teachings, if you want to be sublime, enter the saints, and escape birth and death, you should cut off craving! Regardless of whether the wife is old or young, they are all considered Dharma friends, they do not think like husband and wife, teaching them to accompany him every day in reciting Buddha's name, he is their teacher and guide, and they are also useful friends for him. Both sides help each other, the benefits are huge. In the future, we will be born in the West together, and be close to Amitabha Buddha, Avalokiteshvara, Theravada, Pure Ocean Bodhisattva. Furthermore, we can also attain True Suchness and Miraculous Nature and help all sentient beings in the world. What a blessing!

Furthermore, if your energy is weak, you should tell your first wife, concubine, and children, daughters-in-law, and grandchildren to share the company of Buddha recitation with you whenever they have free time. Each person chants for an hour, it's not difficult at all! If you can recite it, then recite it. If not, listen to their chanting. Not only did he enjoy that benefit, but all of them were also able to eliminate disasters and increase their blessings. What's more, we are currently in a difficult situation. If we use this method to make everyone practice filial piety to sow great good roots, then that is the true morality of loving our children, grandchildren and relatives. That is, although his body is sick, it actually guides the whole family to be healthy and happy! These words are words of reason and sincerity. If you don't believe it, please try it enthusiastically and you'll know for yourself that it's true!

Hanh Sam (1614-1677) was a monk of the Lam Te sect, lived in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, from Bac La district (Guangdong), nicknamed Luu Khe, nickname Tu Ong. His mother was about to give birth. She had a dream and saw a white light shining into her belly. She woke up and gave birth to him. The monk has a majestic and handsome appearance. At the age of seven, he was sick and was lying on his pillow. He suddenly heard the sound of a drum and immediately recognized his sense of self. He decided to become a monk with Mr. Tong Bao and then studied with Mr. Tuyet Kieu Vien Tin of the Van Mon sect. Afterwards, he met Pho Te Neng Nhan, National Master Ngoc Lam Thong Tu, and understood the essence of his heart. Venerable Ngoc Lam often sent the Master to preach the Dharma on his behalf and receive and lead the congregation. The national teacher also bequeathed the inheritance of the dharma system. In the seventeenth year of Thuan Tri (1660), Venerable Ngoc Lam obeyed the scriptures, the Master followed him, and was highly respected by King Thuan Tri, even calling him Great Thong Buddha. The King many times attempted to confer the title, but the Monk always found a way to tactfully refuse. After returning from Wutai Mountain, he asked the king for permission to retreat to Long Khe Am in Hangzhou, Zhejiang province. The king then issued an edict to turn Long Khe into Vien Chieu Tu, the grace was very good. In the year Kangxi 16 (1677), the Master passed away at Hoa Nghiem Pagoda in Ngo Son, at the age of 64. In the year Ung Chanh 11 (1733), the emperor again ordained the Master with the posthumous title Minh Dao Chanh Giac Zen Master. The monk's sayings were collected in the 11th volume of Ngu Tuyen Ngu Luc. This volume was later circulated privately in the world under the name Luu Khe Sam Zen Master Ngu Luc.

Why do you need to ask for guidance from a master? You must know: Buddhism is like the ocean, who can step on it to the bottom with one step and suck it clean with one mouth? Only by relying on Faith - Vows - Behavior in the Buddha's Recitation method, you will definitely be able to rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to overcome karma and be reborn. Whenever he is reborn, he will be able to escape birth and death and become a saint. This Dharma is the supreme Dharma for the Tathagata to save all, whether mortal or holy. If you do not specialize in practicing this method and want to end birth and death through methods such as Zen, or Education, or Secret, or Vinaya, do not say that in this life you will not be able to escape, I am afraid that it will still be difficult to escape for thousands of lifetimes! Because these methods must completely eliminate all afflictions, only then can one attain the end of birth and death.

You said "sending letters back and forth to be clearly taught the right path for all spiritual practices", then didn't Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc already point out the path? Just practice based on that and you'll be fine. Why do you need to use letters to teach again and again? He didn't even follow books like Van Sao, etc., so how could he use letters to ask questions and talk back? It turned out that he was only willing to rely on the merest words! If you practice according to Van Sao, you are guaranteed to be reborn in the West in this life! If, in addition to this method, you want to truly achieve the benefits of being free from birth and death, you cannot even dream of it! If you obey my words, it is no different from taking refuge, and you do not need to give a Dharma name to take refuge. Phham mentioned the name of the person above, because he did not dare to call [the person's full name] directly, so he said "upper X... lower Y...". You call yourself a Dharma name but also say "Upper Thuong, Lower Lac" then it turns out to be talking nonsense and being arrogant, it is impossible not to know [this]! Quang is old now, he can't often reply to his letters, let alone send them anymore! If you want to read scriptures, you should visit Hoang Hoa Xa.

tieu_de: 42. Letter to layperson La The Phuong
tom_tat: In mid-August, Master Lieu Nguyen came from Phuoc Chau and said that lay people are children of rich families, in their early twenties, not concerned about beauty or wealth, and quite like Buddhism. Unfortunately, they have not yet met a true intellectual, please let me...
noi_dung:
42. Letter to layperson La The Phuong

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

In mid-August, Master Lieu Nguyen came from Phuoc Chau and said that lay people are children of rich families, in their early twenties, and don't care about beauty or wealth, and are quite fond of Buddhism. It's a pity that they haven't met a true scholar. Please send me a letter as well as send you all the important books that have been circulated, so that you can understand the path. Quang agreed. Then thinking that they have never written to me, I immediately send them a letter. They will probably think that I am relying on them so I haven't sent them yet. Recently, he came from Shanghai and told him to let him know: Quang had not sent him a letter, and even asked Quang to send him a letter. Therefore, I cannot help but write to him. There were thirty or forty people who took refuge in Phuoc Chau. Quang absolutely did not send letters to them for no reason, nor did he collect their graves as merit. Only La Khanh Doan requested books many times and sent letters back and forth. In addition, it was all [because they] asked for refuge, so Quang sent a letter to reply with instructions.

The virtuous person is prosperous and can establish a career. The clue is whether he has established his will or not when he was young? He was born in a rich family, so he wholeheartedly abandoned his rich habits so that he could study the path of life and death. Otherwise, sound, beauty, wealth, drinking friends, and evil will take the opportunity to interfere. Although I wish to become a saint, become a sage, study Buddha, study the Patriarchs, but I cannot! If you want to study Buddhism, you must first take full advantage of your own responsibilities and duties. [If] you cannot maintain moral morality, fulfill all duties, abandon evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, do good things, even if you study Buddhism, it will be difficult to gain great benefits, because your mind is not yet honest! If you can do [things] as mentioned above, you are called a "good person". Like a solid foundation, if you build a building ten thousand feet high, you will definitely not collapse. The beings of the End of Time have poor inborn abilities and attempt to use their own strength to enlighten and understand their mind-nature, to eliminate all troubles, and to put an end to birth and death. There is not even one in a thousand people! You should follow the Pure Land dharma, believe in reciting the Buddha's name, seek rebirth in the West, and rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to help you achieve rebirth. This is the method of "ten thousand people practice, ten thousand people come" that is quick, stable, and most appropriate!

First of all, we must understand the origin of this method and understand it clearly in our mind. If I have enough strength, I will study all the sutras and teachings that can help this method. If you do not clearly understand the reasons for this method, then you arbitrarily study other sutras and get close to the knowledge of the sects in order to become a great scholar and sow good roots for the future life, then it is indeed like that, but if you want to be able to escape birth and death in this life, you are afraid that even if you dream, you will not be able to dream! Quang always speaks frankly, his heart is clear, hoping to be useful to people, not afraid of others saying I am ignorant and unconscious, only know how to recite Buddha's name! Therefore, people with predestined relationships tell them so. Even though I didn't know him, because Master Lieu Nguyen prayed several times, I told him [so].

Now I ask Hoang Hoa Xa to send you one set of the books that have been circulated. If you're willing to watch it, keep it to see for yourself. If not, it would be good to show it to an educated person who knows how to respect it. Don't force him to see it! If you want to request it to give to others, you can also request it yourself from Hoang Hoa Xa. For the books requested by Hoang Hoa Xa from outside, only paper money and printer's wages are charged, all other costs are not included. If you don't know, ask Khanh Doan and you'll know for yourself.

Recently, disasters have been unimaginable. If you can concentrate on reciting Buddha's name and reciting Quan Yin, you will definitely be able to encounter bad things and turn them into good things. I hope you can tell these words to everyone, it will be of great benefit!

tieu_de: 43. Letter replying to layperson Quach Gioi Mai (two letters)
tom_tat: Receiving the letter and the Department of Bon Tung Dam62, I know that you have a heart for humanity and can't help but be happy and comforted. Speaking of exaggerated stories in the secular world, in general, good roots are shallow and evil karma is deep and heavy.…
noi_dung:
43. Letter replying to layperson Quach Gioi Mai (two letters)

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Receiving the letter and the Department of Bon Tung Dam62, I know that you have a heart for humanity and can't help but be happy and comforted. Speaking of exaggerated stories in the secular world, in general, good roots are shallow and evil karma is deep and heavy. The secular people in the countryside are ignorant, they just want to die and not accept their sins, and have money to spend, to the point that there are secular Sangha who do not understand the teachings and fabricate the Tho Sanh sutra to fit their preferences, thus people who are willing to be cowardly and greedy for money and only seek self-benefit, do not hesitate to spend a lot of money to pay off the debt of Tho Sanh! They even put money in storage to hope that they can enjoy it when they die. They don't know whether life depends on good or bad karma. Can they ask for money to redeem their lives from officials in the underworld? While you are alive and cultivate good deeds, when you die you will receive your own benefits. If you do not cultivate good deeds, even if your descendants burn their clothes and money for that person, they will not be able to enjoy it, and will be robbed by strong and powerful people. This is talking about ordinary people who do not know how to recite Buddha's name.

If you are a person who recites Buddha's name, when you live, you recite Buddha's name with all your heart and pray to be reborn in the West. When you die, you will be guided by Buddha to be reborn in the West. You will escape from birth and death and become a saint. Why don't you pray for rebirth in the West and only hope to die and become a ghost? It's true that he doesn't know self-respect, plans to do lowly things, wants to forever be in the sea of ​​suffering of birth and death, doesn't want to escape, how can he be so extremely stupid?

Furthermore, women often suspect that giving birth is a sin, and poor and ignorant monks fabricate the Blood Tank Sutra and Blood Tank Penance. Hearing that, the women were so happy, everyone wanted to recite the Blood Tank Sutra, bow to the Blood Tank, and break the blood lake. It's true that using children's jokes as a basis to eliminate sins and escape suffering is so pitiful! A woman's sin is [that] she commits the mistake of "not being filial to her parents and husband's parents, not respecting her

The Bon Tung Dam Affair is a book compiled by Mr. Quach Gioi Mai with the content of advising parents to focus on cultivating their own virtues and ethics and then apply them to their children's education, as well as things to avoid to create bad habits in children.

husband, does not treat his servants with kindness, does not use good manners to teach his children, and does not bathe at the right time." If, due to sincerity, reverently reciting Buddha's name to destroy old karma, purify the heart, cleanse the mind, and not create future sins, because Sa Ba was aroused by many sins, he determined to be reborn in the West, that is the right reason. Why do not repent of sins in the heart but rely exclusively on apocryphal scriptures to repent and destroy sins?

Since you believe that Buddha is a savior, why don't you recite the Mahayana sutras spoken by the Buddha such as Diamond Sutra, Amitabha Sutra, Heart Sutra, Great Compassion Mantra, Rebirth Mantra and Dharma Flower Sutra, Shurangama Sutra, etc. to hope to eliminate sins and increase blessings? Diem Khau63 is an important dharma to save lonely souls, yet we are arrogant and do not believe it, gathering together to destroy the blood lake and destroy hell, considering these to be "Buddhist things" that we cannot help but do! You yourself do not get real benefits, causing people who understand worldly principles but do not know Buddha Dharma to think that it is Buddha Dharma. Therefore, all kinds of indiscriminate blasphemous words arise, still claiming to be correct. Blind people follow [those erroneous opinions] as a guideline. As in Ancient Literature, through the essay "written after Liu Yuzhu's The Tale of Filial Piety" by Liu Ba On64, it is enough to see that the person who faked the Blood Tank Sutra committed a great crime!

This is a practice of giving food to a hungry ghost girl based on the teachings in the Sutra Bat Diem Mouth Da La Ni Sutra. According to that sutra, Ananda meditated in the forest, saw a hungry ghost with a fiery face, dry body, messy hair, belly as big as a drum, throat as small as a needle, so he was named Diem Khau. The ghost said that in his previous life, he was stingy and greedy and could not get enough of it, so he fell into the realm of hungry ghosts. The ghost also predicted that Ananda would die in three days and become a hungry ghost. Ananda was frightened and quickly ran to the Buddha for help. Therefore, the Buddha taught how to give food, use compassion, visualization and concentration to give alms to countless hungry ghosts and fairies, with immeasurable merit, increase life span, and escape retribution to hungry ghosts. The main principle is to use a clean container, hold water to eat, a little food with your right hand on top, chant the mantra seven times, proclaim the names of the seven Buddhas (Many Treasures, Dieu Sac Than, etc.) and then spread it in all four directions, snapping your fingers seven times. Pour that food onto clean ground for the hungry ghosts to enjoy. Later, the original science of meditation was compiled based on the Yogācāra Essentials for Saving Ananda, Da La Ni Diem Khau Sutra (translated by Bat Khong) and was heavily influenced by Tibetan Tantra, so it gradually became too complicated and cumbersome. Therefore, to facilitate the practice, monks of all generations pay attention to making adjustments. Currently, the most popular Diem Khau doubt is the Thien Co Diem Khau version (i.e. Yoga Practice Essentials for Food Experiments, which was modified by Thien Co of the Ming Dynasty and the pre-existing Diem Khau doubts). The currently circulating version of Thien Co has been revised by Lien Tri to form Tu Thiet Du Gia, Essentials of Food Giving, Dan Nghi (but still commonly called Thien Co Diem Khau). Next is the Hoa Son Diem Khau version, edited by Venerable Lien Tri's version once again by Mr. Duc Co of Bao Hoa Mountain, naming it Essential Yoga Practice of Diem Khau.

Liu Ba On (1311-1375), real name Liu Co, personal name Ba On, posthumous title Wen Cheng, native of Nam Dien, Van Thanh district, Wen Chau, was a prominent military and politician as well as a famous poet in the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties. He is very good at war and books

For those who recite the Buddha's name, when they are about to die, everyone chants the Buddha's name in unison, making [that person's] mindfulness clear and clear, and they can immediately follow the Buddha and be reborn. What is the need to offer food to the Earth God for three days to expect them to treat the dead mercifully and not punish them harshly? Truly becoming such a fool! Like someone who has been recruited by the Great President, does one still have to turn to the police to beg for generous treatment? Isn't that a ridiculous statement? Living beings have heavy and deeply obstructed karma. Most of the dharmas spoken by Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and wise men do not believe in them, and the dharmas spoken by evil spirits and pagans are like flies swarming on rotten breath, like ants swarming and birds flocking to each other. Considering the results, if you receive a small blessing from heaven and earth, you will be extremely lucky! Most people consider evil religion to be Buddhism, criticize Buddhism as evil religion, even if in this life they are not entangled with the magic of water, if they die, they will forever fall into hell, not one of ten thousand people will be spared, isn't that sad? May you scream loudly so they can wake up from their dream.

I flipped through the book, but haven't been able to read it carefully. [I saw] that there were many mistakes in it, and there were other things I hadn't paid attention to. On page twenty-two, in lines three and four at the bottom of the page, writing the word Tinh (情) of the word "status" as Hinh (形) means leaving the roots and chasing the top! "Emotion" is consciousness, and "state" is form. This is probably because I don't remember clearly. Furthermore, in that page and the next page, the word Hui (迴) in Samsara (輪迴) is mostly written [incorrectly] as Huynh (迥)65 (here it is because the typesetter did not pay attention, and the editor did not review carefully), so if you edit it correctly, the next printing will be more beneficial.

Moreover, in Bach Thoai literature, whenever quoting Buddhist scriptures or Confucian books, one should first quote the original text, and then use Bach Thoai words to explain, so that there is a clear basis and the reader can easily understand. If we immediately use Bach Thoai's text to talk about it, although it is still beneficial, it is difficult for people to accept the strategy and assistant Chau Nguyen Chuong to establish the Ming dynasty. He was praised by posterity as "intelligent beyond Zhuge Liang!" Chau Nguyen Chuong once praised: "You are my Tu Phong (Truong Luong)." Because he was so talented, many legends have been passed down among the people painting Luu Co as a Taoist monk who practiced astronomy and geography, understood mystery, and could foresee the fate of the country several hundred years in advance!

Although the words are quite similar, these two words have very different meanings. Hoi (迴) means to return, and Huynh (迥) means to be far away. Therefore, writing samsara (輪迴) as samsara (輪迥) has both the wrong pronunciation and too much meaning.

receive. That's why it is said: "Speech is without literature, action is impermanent"66 (speech without literary nuance cannot spread far). Lately, Quang has been busy with all sorts of things, and hasn't been able to work hard to follow each line of ink67, but his cunning mind is of course very attentive, so here's a brief overview of one or two things!

tieu_de: 44. Letter responding to layperson Qi Yong Tu
tom_tat: The meaning of Phat Quang Xa's essay seems acceptable, but the writing is a bit clumsy and unpolished. Teacher Dich68 and he both thought it was good, probably because of the love of people, even though the writing was not good, they still thought it was good?...
noi_dung:
44. Letter responding to layperson Qi Yong Tu

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

The meaning of Phat Quang Xa's essay seems acceptable, but the writing is a bit clumsy and unpolished. Teacher Dich68 and he both thought it was good, perhaps because of the love of people, even though the writing was not good, they still thought it was good? As for the matter of taking refuge, he was afraid that he would regret it later, so he did not dare to agree. Now I say again: We can only repay mistakes for mistakes. Until we know thoroughly that we are wrong, then we don't have to worry about treating each other as passers-by, or opposing the teacher we once pursued is okay69!

Now the dharma name given to him is Hue Mau, which means using wisdom to strive for yourself, encourage others to strive, hope to maintain moral integrity, fulfill all duties, end evil hearts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, obey good deeds, have faith, make vows, recite the Buddha's name, and seek rebirth in the West. If you can truly do that, then you will not betray the Buddha's teachings, nor will you betray your own spirituality. To be a guide in a village, to be a guide for future generations, what luckier you could be!

tieu_de: 45. Letter to Mr. Thich Huu Khanh
tom_tat: This is an idiom originally taken from an ancient song called Giac Dieu Khuc with lyrics composed by Yen Ta. The whole sentence is "words are without words, actions are eternal, meanings are not established, effort is not accomplished" (speech has no form...
noi_dung:
45. Letter to Mr. Thich Huu Khanh

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

This is an idiom originally taken from an ancient song called Giac Dieu Khuc with lyrics composed by Yen Ta. The whole sentence is "words are without literature, actions are eternal, meaning is not established, principles are not achieved" (speech without literary nuance cannot spread far, meaning cannot be established, even if one is diligent, it will not succeed). We translate this sentence according to the explanation of the Chinese Dictionary of Idioms.

Meaning: Follow each line to deceive.

That is, layperson Giang Dich Vien, Mr. Qi Dung Tu is a disciple of Giang Dich Vien.

Here, the Patriarch foresaw that Giang Dich Vien's teacher and his disciples would later fall in love with fortune-telling, believe in paganism, and oppose the Patriarch's teachings.

The day before, Tran Du Duong sent a letter saying that he and his son both wanted to take refuge, to give them Dharma names, and to teach them the principles of practice. It is said that he is good at medicine and geography70, and has a kind-hearted nature. His daughter kept her virginity and practice. Now his daughter has welcomed him to her hermitage to practice. You are seventy years old, there are not many days left, so you should earnestly have faith, make vows, recite Buddha's holy name, and pray to be born in the West. All family worries and matters of children and grandchildren should be put aside. If I die at the age of sixty, wouldn't those descendants still live normally? Now I only care about reciting the Buddha's name to end life and death. They cannot end life and death for me. Should I ruin my great event because of them? If you think like that, you will naturally be able to recite Buddha's name single-mindedly. His daughter Mai Cuc, keeping her virginity in practice, welcomed him to her hermitage. Both sides helped each other cultivate Pure Karma so that they could both be born in the West.

You must know: In Buddhism, the methods are immeasurable, but all must reach "the end of karma, the emptiness of love" to be able to escape birth and death. It is as difficult as going to heaven. Currently in the whole world, I'm afraid there are very few people who can do it! If you sincerely recite the Buddha's name and pray to be reborn in the West, no matter who you are, you will definitely be reborn in the West and will be free from birth and death. Only those who do not have faith and do not make vows cannot be reborn! If you have true faith and earnest prayer, no one will be born! This one method is to completely rely on the Buddha's power to guide you. For example, it's like sitting on a big ship crossing the ocean, relying on the ship's power, not your own abilities. If you and your father should obey my advice, this life and this meeting will not be in vain.

Now the dharma name given to him is Duc Khanh. His name is Du Khanh (there is an abundance of joy), that is the joy in the world. Now, reciting Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West means taking Buddha's virtue to rely on. That is a joy that no one other than the Buddha can proclaim. Mai Cuc's dharma name is Duc Tinh, which means using the three pure karma of body - mouth - mind to recite Buddha's name, hoping to be reborn in the Pure Land, forever leaving suffering, only enjoying joy. An Quang Van Sao, Gia Ngon Luc, someone probably gave it to you. You should read it carefully and practice accordingly. If you don't have one, you should send a letter to Hoang Hoa Xa of Bao Quoc Pagoda on [corner of the street].

Geography here is the art of looking at the direction of a grave, choosing a burial ground to hope for glory and wealth for your descendants.

Ho Long and Xuyen Tam to invite. Now I am enclosing a list for you to see for yourself, or for others to see.

Furthermore, Mrs. Thich of the Nguyen71 family, probably also his sister, now gives her the Dharma name Duc Chanh, which means deciding to recite Buddha's name to pray for rebirth in the West, that is the most enlightened and righteous path to escape from birth and death. Don't listen to the deviant knowledge of "practicing pills, luck, praying for eternal life" and "paying the debt for Life, depositing it in the warehouse, praying to become a ghost" of ignorant people and then waste your efforts and lose. real benefits. Please tell her the above words. “People who live to be seventy years old come back hy”72 (People living to be seventy years old are rare in the past) was a saying in the Tang Dynasty more than a thousand years ago. People who are seventy years old should not underestimate or be indifferent about reciting Buddha's name so that they can decide to be reborn.

tieu_de: 46. ​​Letter responding to layperson Tap Hoai Tan
tom_tat: Since you know the benefits of reciting the Buddha's name, from now on you should try harder to achieve one-pointedness of mind. But a method of reciting Buddha's name focuses on the three methods of Faith - Prayer - Behavior, only knowing how to recite but not giving rise to faith and making vows, even though...
noi_dung:
46. ​​Letter responding to layperson Tap Hoai Tan

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Since you know the benefits of reciting the Buddha's name, from now on you should try harder to achieve one-pointedness of mind. But a method of reciting the Buddha's name focuses on the three dharmas of Faith - Prayer - Behavior, only knowing how to recite but not giving birth to faith and making vows, even if one attains one mind, one is not sure to be reborn. If you have full and sincere faith and earnest vows, even if you have not yet achieved a single mind and undisturbed mind, you can still rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to be reborn. Most of those who practice on the fringes seek enlightenment and attain various realms, but do not take the decision to seek rebirth as the main thing, which is called "leaving the roots and chasing the tops"! Why? Because enlightenment is extreme, but if one has not completely cut off all afflictions, one is still reincarnated in the six paths. If one can be reborn, compared to being enlightened to the extreme but not completely freed from troubles, the difference between high and low is like heaven and abyss! He wanted to know as soon as possible that the mysterious cause is also a good mind, but because he did not deeply understand the Pure Land dharma, he talked about practicing on the sidelines. You should die with all your thoughts, and you will gain true benefits. But I was lucky

This is how married women were called in the past. This woman's last name was Thich. When she became a daughter-in-law, her family name was Nguyen, so she was called "Nguyen Mon Thich Thi".

This is a verse taken from the poem Khuc Giang by Du Fu of the Tang Dynasty. "The common fruit of alcohol is the land of existence, the cause of birth is seventy years old and the future is dead" (debts are always common, living to seventy is not easy to find!) Later, this verse became a popular proverb in the people to talk about the rarity of people living over seventy years.

If you are lucky enough to hear this Dharma, how can you not let your parents, brothers, sisters, wives, children, friends, and everyone else listen to it, practice it together, and be reborn together?

Layman Giap Tam, who had wisdom in the past, once heard him talk about the Pure Land and read Van Sao and An Si Toan Thu, he immediately believed and accepted the service, but still regretted not having met Quang. This is still the phenomenon of believing in religion but not yet specializing in it. The Pure Land Dharma is both extremely difficult and extremely easy. To say it is difficult is [because] those with great enlightenment and deep penetration into the sutras cannot believe it. It is said that it is easy [because] the foolish husband and the foolish father will recite sincerely and earnestly, and at the time of death they will be able to appear wholesome and be reborn in the West. Those people who have great enlightenment and profound understanding of the sutras don't even want to be on par with them! That's because on the one hand, they abandon Buddha's power and rely exclusively on self-power; On the one hand, we rely exclusively on Buddha's magnetic power, using Buddha's power to generate self-power. Due to the Buddha's power, Dharma power, and strength available in the mind, the three dharma contracts are combined, so one can reach the supernatural level and enter sainthood, and will be free from birth and death.

The most important Dharma is Faith - Prayer. Having Faith - Prayer will definitely lead to active practice. If you practice and practice, you will immediately gain the benefit of rebirth. Unlike Zen Buddhism, Esoteric Buddhism often requires good knowledge to teach. Otherwise, I'm afraid you'll end up in a demonic path that even the Buddha will find difficult to save! But if you follow what Quang said, you will definitely not be in danger and not worry about not getting real benefits. If [lay practitioner Giap Tam] is young, rich, and has peaceful times, he can go south. Being both old and poor, and in a time of chaos, if you keep going, there will be big obstacles to your practice, that is the real sign of "not behaving according to your status"!

tieu_de: 47. Letter responding to layperson Ho Phung Tran
tom_tat: People who study Buddhism should see far and wide. If you only know what's happening within three meters of your immediate future, you'll be at a dead end. Our country has been killing each other for twenty years. In the end, who is the enemy and who is not? Kill…
noi_dung:
47. Letter responding to layperson Ho Phung Tran

(Year of the Republic of China 20 - 1931. This man is also named Su Vien)

People who study Buddhism should see far and wide. If you only know what's happening within three meters of your immediate future, you'll be at a dead end. Our country has been killing each other for twenty years. In the end, who is the enemy and who is not? Kill people, will people just let you kill them? Sacrificing the lives of people and soldiers on both sides to win the reputation of "for the country, for the people"!

Everyone else is like that, and we are like that, so what value is there in studying Buddhism? Our country slaughters each other, still on the surface [from] the outside, but actually cutting off our own limbs and skulls, and I hope we haven't been able to help them more quickly! The name is resounding, shocking the ears of the world, but the essence is painful and shatters the heart of heaven! Don't join in and help this bustle!

As for saying, "There are as many bandits as feathers, if you are not armed, you cannot live in peace," then you can tell people in the area to form a self-defense group. All brave young people teach them that this is a matter of showing off their power so that the bandits will not dare to come when they hear about it. If you are eager to kill bandits, it will lead to deep hatred; Later, they will massacre our village and dig up the ancestral graves of every house in our village. Regardless of age, young, male, or female, they often chant Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva in hopes of being secretly protected. If everyone knows good and bad and obeys this measure, then preventing robbers is cultivating the Way. How can the merit and benefits be inconceivable? If everyone used anger and cruel tricks to hope for a moment of happiness, even if they wanted to cry, they wouldn't be able to shed tears! Quang has such an opinion, I wonder what lay people think? Don't send letters to discuss this matter in the future, because how can outsiders present plans to others that have different ideas [from us]?

"Unfilial piety has three things, no later and great things" (Unfilial piety has three things, not having children is a great [disfilial thing]. This is talking about people who do not fulfill their human duties. If you get married, but cannot give birth, of course it is not "not fulfilling all human duties". A layperson in my hometown who had no children, prayed in many ways but was not satisfied, so he married a concubine, but the concubine had disagreements, conflicts arose, and still had no children. A friend came up with a plan, planning to go to a far away village to marry another concubine, without bringing her home, she would come back and forth a few times a year hoping to have a child. He told the story to Quang. After hearing it, Quang couldn't help but sigh with emotion. Recently, people's hearts have been corrupted to the extreme, and the free love between men and women has almost become public. A young girl, living alone hundreds of miles away, that girl who doesn't have trouble outside is a great sage. I'm afraid that among hundreds of thousands of people, there are hardly a few! What's more, that girl lives in her own house, but needs to hire servants, which is quite expensive. If you are lucky enough to give birth to a child, there will be people who like to denigrate you and say bad things about you that you are doing something underhanded. If unfortunately she still cannot give birth to a child, then that girl will be lonely and lonely for the rest of her life, and the husband will have to provide for her for the rest of her life. Isn't that sad? That plan is generally devised for the sake of fame, because if you don't have children you lack virtue, and if you have children, people won't say you lack virtue. This reputation causes trouble for people to such an extent!

Tuan Phu is an official position that appeared around 1371 during the Ming Dynasty.
