Noi Dan is practicing with methods of nourishment, breathing to absorb the essence of the sun, moon, heaven and earth (often called "luck" or Qigong), meditation, visualization to combine the "holy fetus" to transform the mortal body into an immortal, etc. Noi Dan is a method of using medicinal herbs and chemicals to refine into elixirs (golden pills) to drink and become immortals. Alchemy can be considered the forerunner of modern chemistry. Combined with the concept of Yin and Yang and the Five Elements as well as the properties assigned by Taoists to heavy metals (for example, mercury is the mother of silver, lead is the mother of metals), alchemists often cook lead, mercury, gold, sulfur... into elixirs of immortality in esoteric ways on a certain day and time, of course, along with chanting mantras, casting spells, and praying for the elixir to be effective. Many types of "fairy pills" contain extremely toxic substances, so people who drink them vomit blood and die!

Must maintain moral morality, fulfill all duties, abandon evil hearts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, obey good deeds, promote cause and effect in three lives, reincarnation of six paths, so that everyone has a good heart, speaks good words, and does good deeds. A person who can recite Buddha's name and do so is a true disciple of Buddha. You're sending a letter from thousands of miles away, but why are you still writing the address in sloppy letters? Not being careful or following proper manners, it could ruin things? Just this one thing is enough to know that most of your work is not serious!

tieu_de: 53. Letter responding to lay people Phung Thien Tay & Trinh Vien Oanh
tom_tat: Three or four days ago I received a letter and a money order for one hundred dong. I received it, don't worry. That day, Hoang Hoa Xa sent more than thirty sets of books to you, and you must have received them. Because I'm busy and have no free time,...
noi_dung:
53. Letter responding to lay people Phung Thien Tay & Trinh Vien Oanh

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Three or four days ago I received a letter and a money order for one hundred dong. I received it, don't worry. That day, Hoang Hoa Xa sent more than thirty sets of books to you, and you must have received them. Due to being busy and having no free time, I have not been able to reply. Them thought: Sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age have very thin and shallow foundations. If they do not rely on Buddha's power, it will be difficult for them to escape. Therefore, one must firmly adhere to the "faith and vow to recite the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the Pure Land" to be able to escape this realm of the Five Defilements and ascend to the nine-level lotus realm. If you mistakenly think of yourself as noble and want to rely on your own strength to practice the methods of Zen, Teachings, and Tantra in order to end birth and death, then most of the time it will be "there is cause, no effect". Why is that? Even though one can fully realize one's own mind and penetrate the scriptures, one cannot completely cut off all troubles, certainly there is no end to birth and death, let alone someone who cannot fully realize one's own mind and cannot penetrate deeply? Tantra recommends that "becoming a Buddha right in this body" is not something everyone can do! People who study Tantra are often influenced by demons, all because they do not know how to be self-aware and are mistaken in wanting to attain magical powers and become Buddhas!

You have enough faith, so follow the Pure Land method that Quang said to practice. You should know: This Dharma is the Dharma propagated by the Buddhas, the Patriarchs, and the great wise men, but it is based on the meaning of the words of the Buddhas, the Patriarchs, and the great wise men that it is passed down. Don't say: "What kind of person are you to dare to tell others to abandon the methods of Zen, Buddhism, and Tantra taught by the Buddha to practice according to what you said?" If you say so, you are not following the Buddha's teachings, because what Quang said is what the Buddhas of the ten directions and three times said together. Should we not trust Quang because he is incompetent? Nowadays, there are countless evil spirits and pagans. They all say that they are truly the best. Don't be fascinated by those little ghosts. If you have ever participated in their household before, you should completely throw it all away. Don't say, "When I entered the sect, I took a vow of celibacy. I was afraid that if I left, I would be in trouble!" You must know: If you abandon evil and follow righteousness, how can you get into trouble? Not only does it not cause disaster, it also has merit. Other things have been said thoroughly in Van Sao, but are not written in detail here.

The books sent there should be given according to the person's ability. Don't necessarily give the books according to the amount they paid. Now I am sending a page of Hoang Hoa Xa's book list. If anyone requests a lot to give to others in order to get married, then just ask based on the price on the list. If you send money, please clearly state on the postal note that Duong Duc Lane Post Office, To Chau will save you a lot of effort. If you just write To Chau, you have to take it to the General Department [post office], about four miles from Bao Quoc Pagoda, so sending it back and forth is quite inconvenient. I'm afraid that the person giving the money won't write the name [of the book] clearly. Please send the list back along with the letter to avoid not being able to request the book and then becoming suspicious!

tieu_de: 54. Reply to the letter of layperson Tram Di Sanh
tom_tat: Speaking of making parallel sentences to hang on both sides of the big word "Buddha", I am now preparing a pair of tureens, not sure if they can be used or not? "Delusion, enlightenment, emptiness of love, realization of self...
noi_dung:
54. Reply to the letter of layperson Tram Di Sanh

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Speaking of making parallel sentences to hang on both sides of the big word "Buddha", I am now preparing a pair of tureens, not sure if they can be used or not? "Delusion and enlightenment do not realize one's self-nature. The Holy Ordinary's View completely reveals idealism" (Delusion, Enlightenment, Emptiness of Emotions, Realization of Self-Nature, Holy Ordinary View84 completely reveals idealism). If written in the eight-word style, it is "delusion and enlightenment of emptiness, enlightenment of self-nature; saintly mortals see completely, completely realize idealism". The meaningful eight-word writing style is also good, you can use it as you like. Ordinary people are confused, although the three vehicles are enlightened, they have not yet reached the state of "both delusion and enlightenment are lost" so they cannot realize ultimate and perfect self-nature. Ordinary people have the views of ordinary people, saints have the views of saints, only the Buddha does not have both of these views. Therefore, [the Buddha] thoroughly revealed the Mind-Only principle.

Chanting the Buddha's name with your eyes closed can easily lead to drowsiness. If you don't use your mind wisely, you may encounter a demon! Just relax your eyelids (like the eyes of Buddha statues) and your mind will calm down, not become excited, nor will fire flare up in your head.

The ant here is Kien Or.

If you recite Buddha's name but on your head it [seems] like something is touching you, or pulling you, etc., it is because thinking while reciting Buddha's name causes the waves of consciousness to rise so much that the fire in your heart rises. If you let down your eyelids and direct your thinking mind downwards, the fire in your mind will not rise and the disease will disappear. Don't mistake that [phenomenon] as your practice [having reached the point], don't be afraid that it's a demonic realm, just meditate with sincerity on your mind, and imagine yourself sitting or standing on a lotus flower, with one mind thinking that you're sitting or standing on a lotus flower, that phenomenon will quickly disappear. (If you don't dare to think that you're sitting or standing on a lotus flower, for fear that you might encounter demonic things, just think about the bottom of your feet, and neither the fire in your heart nor the heat on your head will arise anymore). Nowadays, there are a lot of evil spirits and pagans, so don't be tempted to try and practice! If you have that mind, you will definitely be seduced by them. If you fall into their trap, you will lose your mind and go crazy. It is said that a very famous magician has now eaten meat himself, taught others to eat meat, and even taught others to destroy Buddha statues. He has clearly shown his ghostly appearance!

55. Letter responding to layperson Hoang Ham Chi

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Tu Kien Ong's Western Rules of Recitation consists of one hundred and sixty words, the meaning is almost acceptable, but the writing is clumsy, lacking fluency, just to get things done. 85. Layman [Khuat] Van Luc is a vegetarian, while funerals, sacrifices, and entertaining guests should all use vegetarian food to initiate the local culture. You should absolutely not follow the old customs of ostentatiously drawing, killing, playing music, turning funerals into parties and entertainment, so that it will be beneficial to your parents, to yourself, to guests, and to neighbors. Currently, the country's fortunes are in danger, no matter who they are, they should recite Buddha's name and Quan Am's name as a backup plan. Except for this method, using any method will not change any karma, it will only be a waste of hard work. Please tell this to all predestined people.

tieu_de: 56. Letter responding to layperson Dam Thieu Phu
tom_tat: Tu Kien He is the layman Khuat Tu Kien. In the Litigation section of An Quang Van Sao Tuc Bien, there is an introduction to this Western Quy Tung song by An Quang himself.
noi_dung:
56. Letter responding to layperson Dam Thieu Phu

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Tu Kien He is the layman Khuat Tu Kien. In the Litigation section of An Quang Van Sao Tuc Bien, there is an introduction to this Tay Quy Tung song written by An Quang himself.

Receiving the obituary last time, I planned to tell him the root and end so that it would be beneficial to my parents and not harm myself, but because I was busy and had no free time, I ended up not being able to reply to the letter. This time I received your letter from Vi Nghiem from his brother, it's been almost ten days. You should know: People in the world only pay attention to the body and rituals, but ignore the two aspects of consciousness and benefits. It seems like you want to do something beneficial, but in reality you're just doing something that pleases the ears and eyes of people, not doing it for the souls of the dead. If you have taken refuge in Buddhism, you should devote your heart to reciting the Buddha's name, dedicate it to your parents and teach your family members to suppress the pain and recite the Buddha's name. It will be of great benefit to your parents and to yourself.

At present, life's fortunes are in danger. If you can sincerely recite Buddha's name, you will certainly encounter bad things and turn them into good ones. Otherwise, the current harm will be completely different from before. It is true that we [want] to avoid it but cannot avoid it, [want] to prevent it but cannot prevent it. People's lives at this time are pitiful to the extreme. You should talk in detail with your relatives so that both the living and the deceased will benefit. Temples and pagodas in Guangzhou were all destroyed, and there were no monks who were truly practicing; Lately, I've become more and more paranoid and there's no way I can find a true monk! Only by sincerely reciting Buddha's name with your own heart, compared to inviting monks to eat meat and drink wine to recite sutras and worship, the merit is much greater! Reciting the Buddha's name is the most important thing in a person's life. It's not because one's parents have passed away that one recites the Buddha's name, or when one normally doesn't recite it! Doing a funeral for your parents [at first glance seems to be] just for the sake of your parents, but in fact, it was the death of your parents that led you to witness the great event of "never dying". Be grateful and diligently recite Buddha's name to repay your kindness.

tieu_de: 57. Letter responding to layperson Truong Van Loi
tom_tat: In this chaotic world, everything should be simple for the best. If you add the unnecessary dependency "it's okay to have it but it's okay not to have it" then it will cause a lot of trouble. Quan Am Linh Thiem86
noi_dung:
57. Letter responding to layperson Truong Van Loi

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

In this chaotic world, everything should be simple for the best. If you add the unnecessary dependency "it's okay to have it but it's okay not to have it" then it will cause a lot of trouble. Quan Am Linh Thiem86 very

Quan Am Linh Thiem (often spelled Quan Am Linh Sam, or Quan Am Linh Tattoo) is often known to Vietnamese people as Quan Am Tattoo, consisting of one hundred hexagrams. Every thing is good, but you should pray for yourself. If you are sincere, earnest, and do not lie, you will automatically receive Bodhisattva protection. If the heart of seeking within oneself is not sincere, it will be difficult for the Bodhisattva to overcome it. I told Master Minh Dao to send the book of History according to the [letter of request], and also told him to send two sets of Putuo Chi, a total of four sets. One set he kept himself, one set he gave to Ho Phung Tran, the other two sets he gave as a gift.

Giving birth is not difficult, raising children is very difficult. Many people do not understand things and do not have children, so they pray to the Bodhisattva. When they have children, they only know precious things; Therefore, they are raised to be very spoiled people. For example, when planting rice, you only know how to find good seeds and plant them, then all the things like weeding, fertilizing, watering, etc. are all ignored. Even though that rice variety is good, do you still expect to harvest it? As Quang understands, up to ninety-nine percent of people who are childless and have many children have this type of result. Only Diem Dan So's father (Kinh Minh) was the person who loved his son the most from past to present, so [Mr. Diem] asked his elders to [advise Dan So] to have his son appointed to Han Lam, and then become a high-ranking mandarin. He taught his children in a strict way that was unprecedented in the world. On the one hand, cultivate virtue, and on the other hand, try to teach. The reason is because I truly love my children. The love of others is often worse than killing a child, because by killing a child, only one person dies. A child who does not educate him will not do anything and will forever fall into the three evil paths. Compared to the tragedy of any death, there must be a difference like heaven and abyss! I'm afraid you won't be able to avoid it, so I have to say it out loud in advance just in case!

tieu_de: 58. Letter responding to layperson Tu Thu Dung
tom_tat: Receiving your letter, I know that my moral heart has not retreated, my ambition is still high, I am unstoppably happy and comforted. You should know: Studying saints and studying Buddhism all take hexagrams with the following form: The order of the hexagrams, whether they are good or bad, which of the 12 palaces they belong to...
noi_dung:
58. Letter responding to layperson Tu Thu Dung

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Receiving your letter, I know that my moral heart has not retreated, my ambition is still high, I am unstoppably happy and comforted. You should know: Studying saints and studying Buddhism all take hexagrams with the following form: The order of the hexagrams, good or bad hexagrams, which of the 12 branches it belongs to, a classic in Chinese literature, then discussion. For example: "Second hexagram, Ha Ha tattoo, Rat palace, To Tan broken poetry, poetry says..." then comes the discussion and general comments for the whole hexagram. This is a form of divination by drawing lots created by the Chinese. Almost all immortals and saints have tattoos, such as Quan Thanh De Quan Linh Thiem, Thien Hau Linh Thiem, Dai Tien Linh Thiem, Te Cong Linh Thiem, La To Linh Thiem... Here, based on the popular belief in divination and tattoos of the Chinese, the Patriarch advised "remember Buddha with all your heart and do your best to change your destiny".

“Maintain good morals, fulfill all duties, stop evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, and keep good things” as the root. We also have to remain humble, hide our talents, follow the ancients, and devote ourselves to following a practical path. If you do so, both your education and virtue will surpass those of ordinary people. Usually smart people are arrogant, boastful, show off their talents, sour, mean, and have a completely lacking in nurturing mind. If that person doesn't face hardships throughout his life, he will definitely die at a young age! The previous generations were very lucky and were able to cultivate this good root. You should devote all your efforts to cultivating it so that you can achieve success. Smart people are most likely to commit only sexual desires, so they should always keep their minds free from fear and not let any evil delusions arise. If that idea suddenly arises, immediately think: Every move of us, heaven and earth, ghosts, gods, Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, none of them knows it all, sees it all! You don't even dare to do bad things in front of other people, let alone in front of the Buddha, God is serious and discreet, but you dare to hold bad thoughts and do bad things? Mencius said: "The mastery is great? The body is great. The mastery is great? The body is great" (Worshiping whom is a big matter? Worshiping parents is a big matter. Keeping what is a big matter? Keeping the body is a big matter). If you can't keep your body, even if you take care of your parents, it's only a formality, but in fact you're disregarding the remains received from your parents, which is great filial piety! Therefore, when Tang Tu was about to die, he said: "Relax your mind without worrying." The Book of Poetry says: "Fighting at the edge is like a deep forest, like a silver ice, a metal, a child, a corn of wisdom" (Be cautious, be on guard, like entering a deep abyss, walking on thin ice, now, in the future, we know how to avoid it). Until then, we still have to be cautious. Tang Tu is still like that, let alone us mortals and ordinary people?

Now I send you a set of History, two books Tho Khang Bao Giam, three books Gia Ngon Luc. Thong Ky, he kept to himself to know whether [the world] was peaceful or chaotic, to know the example of cause and effect. If you often watch Tho Khang Bao Giam, you will not commit adultery and masturbation, etc., harming your life, wasting your blessings, and not being disabled or dying. You should give this book to Mr. Ly Hong Nghiep, and Gia Ngon Luc, you, Mr. Co, Mr. Ly, each have a book. According to that practice, both worldly dharma and extra-worldly dharma will know the important principles.

Ancient Ve Sanh and Ly Hong Nghiep wanted to take refuge, so now they gave Ve Sanh the Dharma name Hue Sanh, which means using wisdom to seek rebirth in the West, forever attaining the immortality of birth and death to protect yourself, protect others, and gain immortality. Giving Hong Nghiep the dharma name is Hue Nghiep, which means using wisdom to eliminate evil karma in the world, cultivating Pure karma to be reborn in the West. Such a career is "red karma" (great career). Cultivating yourself and establishing a career until you become a saint or a sage in the world, compared to the career of being reborn in the West and escaping from birth and death, is extremely small! Please copy this letter for them to read, or copy the entire letter for them to see. Even if they have reached the age of maturity (sixty), they will still benefit, not to mention if they are descendants who have just passed their twenties!

tieu_de: 59. Letter responding to layperson Kim Thien Sanh
tom_tat: In a previous life, what karma did a person not create? If you are fortunate enough to hear the Buddha's teachings, you should diligently practice and practice to eliminate bad karma and overcome injustice. All injustices are difficult to remove, but if you are willing to develop Bodhi mind and become...
noi_dung:
59. Letter responding to layperson Kim Thien Sanh

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

In a previous life, what karma did a person not create? If you are fortunate enough to hear the Buddha's teachings, you should diligently practice and practice to eliminate bad karma and overcome injustice. Although all injustices are difficult to resolve, if you develop the mind of Bodhi and are sincere in making salvation, there will be no [resentment bond] that cannot be resolved! When you chant Buddha's name and choke, it's not because your body is weak, but because of karma. You should only chant earnestly and sincerely. If you can't remember, then remember often. If you can recite it, you still need to use your mouth to recite it. If you can't recite it, then your mind will only change, your mind will remember, and over time that karma will disappear. From now on, everyone who starts working must focus on the aspect of living and doing things with warm affection. Living with full gratitude will bring you more blessings, but living ungratefully will not gain any blessings! If you are still harsh, cruel, and cunning, then you will be like a towering mountain top that cannot receive any rain, and no plants or trees can grow!

tieu_de: 60. Letter responding to layman Cat Chi Luong
tom_tat: When I received the letter the other day, I couldn't help but feel happy - I was extremely embarrassed. Happy because it seems like lay people have had a chance to change, no longer relying on their own intelligence like before, speaking nonsense about morality, worshiping science, and disparaging Buddhism. Shame because I…
noi_dung:
60. Letter responding to layman Cat Chi Luong

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

When I received the letter the other day, I couldn't help but feel happy - I was extremely embarrassed. Happy because it seems like lay people have had a chance to change, no longer relying on their own intelligence like before, speaking nonsense about morality, worshiping science, and disparaging Buddhism. I'm ashamed because I'm an ignorant monk, an ordinary monk who only knows how to eat rice and porridge. If anyone learns from me, they will become a stupid husband and a stupid wife. If you want to become a great scholar, you should worship a great Dharma master and set up a high dharma hall to avoid wasting your mind of taking refuge. If you worship Quang as your teacher, later on, because Quang is ignorant and unconscious, he will regret it and leave, turning out to be doing something in vain! But Quang is a straightforward person and speaks plainly. He mistakenly sent a letter to Quang. Of course, Quang did not dare to accept it, but he did not hesitate to exchange a few words to help him establish himself and practice the religion and escape birth and death in the future. Like a legless person giving directions, even though he can't take a single step, he doesn't hesitate to ask so he can get home.

What he said was all based on his own opinion, not based on truth or truth. Now that he knows he was wrong, he must fight with all his might against that habit. If you don't get rid of that habit, every move can harm you and bring disaster. His first question was a slander, not a question at all! [Using the word] "questionable" is just playing with words to cover up. Compared to outright saying not to believe, that mistake is even bigger. If you keep that habit and don't know how to change it, you will one day be driven crazy by ghosts! Medicine often tastes bitter in the mouth, I wonder if lay people will take it or not?

tieu_de: 61. Letter responding to layperson Vuong Tam Thien
tom_tat: Since your mother can recite Buddha's name, you should tell her daughters-in-law to recite Buddha's name with her. We should also advise her to become a vegetarian to help her mother become a virtuous karma, which is filial piety. If you just think "don't recite Buddha's name, you're afraid of tiring your mind and energy;...
noi_dung:
61. Letter responding to layperson Vuong Tam Thien

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Since your mother can recite Buddha's name, you should tell her daughters-in-law to recite Buddha's name with her. We should also advise her to become a vegetarian to help her mother become a virtuous karma, which is filial piety. If you only think "don't recite Buddha's name, for fear of straining your mind and energy; don't eat vegetarian food, for fear that your diet won't be in accordance with the proper nutrition" is filial piety, then that filial piety is like a Rakshasa woman loving people. That filial piety destroyed her mother's karma, causing her, who could have escaped birth and death, to stay forever in birth and death. That filial piety is the filial piety that "was pushed into the well and even thrown stones", causing his mother to not be reborn and fall into hell for the rest of her life. Filial piety is filial, but I don't know that [such filial piety] turns out to be disobedient! He's a civil servant, so physically there's no need to show off his practice, but in his heart, can't he always remember? Just like he misses his mother, who forbids him to always remember and think of her in his mind? He raised these obstacles entirely on the basis of images, not on the ground! Nowadays, the situation is so dangerous. If we still do not recite the Buddha's name in our hearts, we will not know how the future will be resolved. He read Van Sao, Gia Ngon Luc, what was said in them was not enough to resolve [his doubts], he needed a letter of several hundred words to satisfy his expectations, it was all due to not being able to understand and observe on a daily basis. You should use true filial piety to advise your brides, and regularly practice secret mantras (reciting silently) for great benefits!

tieu_de: 62. Letter responding to lay people Ngo Hue Di and La Hue Chu
tom_tat: The Pure Land Dharma focuses on Faith and Prayer. Some people don't know, so they either pray for blessings in the world, or pray to become a Sangha in their next life to propagate Buddha's teachings and save sentient beings. These kinds of thoughts must be completely eliminated...
noi_dung:
62. Letter responding to lay people Ngo Hue Di and La Hue Chu

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

The Pure Land Dharma focuses on Faith and Prayer. Some people don't know, so they either pray for blessings in the world, or pray to become a Sangha in their next life to propagate Buddha's teachings and save sentient beings. These types of thoughts must be completely eliminated; If there is even the slightest bit, you will not be able to be reborn! Rebirth is a supernatural being, entering a saint, and escaping birth and death. Without rebirth, even if one life or two lives are not delusional, it is certainly difficult to be eternally delusional. If you are delusional, you will create very scary karma because you have the blessings of cultivating! Evil karma has been created, evil consequences will automatically follow, there is only a day to escape from the three paths!

Furthermore, the person who recites Buddha's name should advise his family members to have faith in him and recite Buddha's name often to prepare his parents and other relatives in his family to help recite the Buddha's name. Otherwise, not only will it not be possible to help [the dying person] maintain mindfulness, but on the contrary, it will also cause [the person] to give rise to thoughts of anger, attachment, etc. (taking a shower, changing clothes will cause loss of mindfulness. If movement causes [the dying person] to be in pain, anger will arise. Anger can fall into the poisonous insect species. If [the dying person] cries in front of [the dying person], that person will immediately give birth to attachment. [These things] all destroy righteousness. reciting Buddha's name, we will never hope to be reborn, how sad it is!) People who do not recite Buddha's name will not be greatly harmed, but if those who recite Buddha's name are destroyed, their mindfulness will be lost, and it is impossible to fully attain rebirth! From then on, reincarnation in the six paths for a long lifetime was all caused by those relatives.

If they do not have the heart, they should take advice from the dangerous times, if they sincerely chant the Buddha's name, they will surely encounter bad things and turn them into good advice. If you are a woman and recite the Buddha's name, you will certainly not suffer during childbirth. If a woman normally does not know how to recite the Buddha's name, when she gives birth, she is extremely miserable and sincerely recites "Namo Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva", and she will certainly immediately give birth peacefully. This is the ultimate inspiration, you should tell all your friends and acquaintances, so that they can all give birth to good children, and also make both mother and child happy, and sow good roots. Some people with little understanding think that the time of giving birth is naked and impure, and if you recite it, you will be guilty of a crime. They do not know that this is a matter related to life, and we should not discuss the ritual when it is normal. For example, if a child falls in fire or water, and as soon as they call their parents, they will immediately come to help them. Surely they will not save them because their clothes are not neat and their body is not clean! If that's not the case, then you're not worthy of being called a Buddha or Bodhisattva! If it's a normal time, of course you should be sincere and respectful, and don't take things during childbirth as an exception.

There is no human being who does not love their children. If you teach your children to recite Buddha's name and Quan Yin from a young age, they will eliminate karma and grow good roots without even knowing it. What's more, a person who often recites Buddha's name himself should not cause trouble at the time of death, and even more should use Buddha's name to help him so that [he] decides to be reborn in the West. In the present time, reciting Buddha's name, reciting Quan Yin, encountering bad things and turning them into good things is certain. Quang is old, his spirit is not enough, you should only read the Sao Literature carefully, follow the practice and you will immediately benefit, don't send letters often to avoid bothering yourself and others!

tieu_de: 63. Letter responding to layperson Thang Hue Chan
tom_tat: If a teenager doesn't meet a good teacher and good friends, and if he hangs out with friends who drink and drink, he will be in great danger. If it's severe, you'll soon die, if it's mild, you'll become weak or disabled. Consider…
noi_dung:
63. Letter responding to layperson Thang Hue Chan

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

If a teenager doesn't meet a good teacher and good friends, and if he hangs out with friends who drink and drink, he will be in great danger. If it's severe, you'll soon die, if it's mild, you'll become weak or disabled. Looking at the reason, it's all because they think it's fun to find flowers and ask willows, not knowing it's a tragic thing, or like killing someone, or like killing their descendants forever. People who are greedy and playful often have sexual problems. When children are born, they cannot see anything, but when they are twelve or thirteen years old, they will see clearly when they reach puberty. Children pass it on to their children, grandchildren pass it on to their grandchildren. Isn't that sad? Isn't it worth the pain? His father, Chau Tu Quyen, was half paralyzed, afraid that it was also due to greed for lust. Don't be greedy for lust, even if husband and wife live together, don't be greedy. If you are greedy, you will lose your life or get sick!

That person has developed the mind to take refuge, he should sincerely recite the holy names "namo Amitabha Buddha" and "namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva", all impure thoughts in his mind should not arise at once, correct his mistakes towards goodness, abstain from killing, and fast. It is necessary to permanently stop eating and sleeping; If you haven't recovered from your illness for more than a year, you won't be able to get close to women! Otherwise, it will be difficult to heal! He should also teach his wife and children to recite Buddha's name and Quan Yin for him. If you are truly sincere, you will quickly heal. Now the Dharma name given to him is Hue Escape, which means using wisdom to get rid of previous bad habits, and by reciting Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, forever escape the suffering of birth and death, and often enjoy the true joy of impermanence. Because of this severe illness, he will receive great benefits. Thanks to this, his wife and children can also escape suffering and enjoy happiness. How fortunate!

Since he can't move, he can recite Buddha's name with his mind all day long, either loudly, softly, or silently in his mind. If you recite out loud, you can recite six words, but if you recite silently in your mind, too many words will be difficult to recite, so you should recite four words. Regardless of whether you recite loudly or softly, you must think clearly in your mind, recite clearly with your mouth, and listen clearly with your ears. Even though you cannot worship, in your mind you must always maintain reverence as if you were facing the Buddha, like falling into fire or water to ask for help, and not daring to give rise to an inappropriate thought. From morning to night, when you sleep, leave it alone, wake up and recite again. Taking Buddha's name as your original spirit will be able to eliminate karma, grow good roots, and hope to heal in peace. Even after recovering from your illness, you should still not let go, [keep reciting Buddha's name] so that you can become a saint, attain rebirth and escape death, and be reborn in the West.

Right now is a difficult situation, if we are willing to sincerely recite Buddha's name, we can encounter bad things and turn them into good things. If the women in the house are willing to recite Buddha's name, they will definitely not have a difficult birth. Even if a person does not normally recite the Buddha's name, but when they give birth they cannot give birth, if they sincerely recite "Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva" they will definitely immediately give birth peacefully. Don't say "If you're naked and impure, you'll be guilty of a sin!" During normal times, it is necessary to be respectful and clean. If your clothes are not neat, your body is not clean, or you are bathing, urinating, or sleeping, you should recite it silently in your mind, not out loud. Only when giving birth, you should recite it out loud, not silently. Those who care for the person around also chant to help that person, both sides will have merit and benefits. You should show this letter to him and let everyone know, then it will benefit him!

tieu_de: 64. Letter responding to monk Huu Chan and layperson Giac Tam

noi_dung:
64. Letter responding to monk Huu Chan and layperson Giac Tam

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

People who recite Buddha's name should be respectful and sincere, each sentence and word should be clearly and distinctly recited in their mind, and recited clearly and distinctly with their mouth. If you can do that, even though you can't be completely free of false thoughts, it's still not too extreme. There are many people who only hope quickly, expect a lot, and chant loudly, so it's ineffective! If one can capture the mind, then one can be called a true Buddha reciter. Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva gave an example: "like when I miss my mother", in my mind I only think of my mother, other scenes are not in my mind. Therefore, it is possible to induce communication. It is said again: "If you take care of the six senses, pure thoughts follow each other, you will attain Tam Ma Ground87, the first state of mind" (taking all six sense senses, pure thoughts will follow, you will attain Tam Ma Ground (i.e., samādhi), that is the first level). Saying "making the mind, mouth, and ears clear" is the principle of taking care of all six senses (the mind is the mind, the mouth is the mouth). If the mind and mouth recite together with the ears and ears, then the eyes and nose decide not to wander outside, nor the body to be insolent or unruly. Most people in this world recite Buddha's name without making any effort, so it's ineffective.

Furthermore, when not reciting Buddha's name, although there are many false thoughts, there is no way to know, but it is not true that when not reciting Buddha's name, there are no false thoughts! For example, when it comes to emptiness in the house, even with very good eyes, we cannot see dust. If you look into a ray of sunlight from a crack in the window, you will see the dust in the rays moving up and down without stopping. When the light has not yet reached the spot, there is still no dust! Therefore, know that: When reciting Buddha's name and realizing that there are false thoughts, that is still the beauty of reciting Buddha's name. When I'm not reciting Buddha's name, I'm completely buried in delusion so I don't know!

Furthermore, the most important method of reciting the Buddha's name is to have sincere faith and earnest prayer. As long as you have true faith and earnest vows, even if you have not yet reached a single-minded, undisturbed mind, you can still rely on the Buddha's power to help you achieve rebirth. If you don't have faith and vows, even if your mind has no false thoughts, it's still okay

Samādhi, also translated as Samadhi, Samādhi, Samādhi. Translated as Right Tri, Right Concentration, Concentration, Direct Concentration, or Right Mind Conduct, it means to stay away from drowsiness, tossing and turning, to concentrate on one scene. Due to so many meanings, this word is often used as a sound translation, not a literal translation. Normally, Samadhi is understood as contemplation of silence for radiant wisdom, to eliminate all troubles, and to attain the truth.

It's just a blessing from heaven and earth because it doesn't correspond to Buddha. Therefore, of course we must focus on faith - praying for birth in the West. If you truly have faith and aspirations, your hopes will disappear on their own. If in normal times you have excessive delusions, if you want to gain magical powers, gain honor, gain dharma, attain enlightenment, etc., completely take delusions as your own mind, then the more diligent and braver you are, the more those delusions will grow! If we don't get enlightenment to permanently eliminate those delusions, we will still be driven crazy by demons. Is it really just delusions? Therefore, we must diligently cut off those excessive delusions.

When implementing a public course, you should follow the program of the public course. When [walking meditation], after reciting the Buddha's name, return to your seat and recite the [names of] the two Buddhas Shakyamuni and Medicine Master without any hesitation. Theoretically speaking, worshiping Buddha before reciting it is worshiping Shakyamuni Buddha. Most people in the world act according to their emotions, no one wishes to eliminate disasters and increase longevity; Therefore, recite the Medicine Buddha. In fact, Amitabha Buddha's mighty merit and virtue are equal to the mighty merit and virtue of all the Buddhas of the ten directions and three times, not that reciting Amitabha Buddha's name cannot eliminate disasters and increase longevity!

65. Letter responding to layperson Tran Ky Xuong

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Looking at the revised vow text, it can be said to be a "great vow". Before the Buddha makes a vow, you should express it briefly. The [vow] essay that you have composed is a statement in front of others and a proposal and guidance. How can it be called an essay comparable to Venerable Lien Tri's [vow] essay? How useful is it? At present it is clear that an ordinary monk still uses the words "upper - lower"88 when making a vow before the Buddha, which is extremely rude! The public course [that you have] established can still be carried out if there is absolutely nothing wrong, but if there is a father, mother, wife, children, and all diseases must be treated, no one can refuse the invitation; Just this one thing is difficult to cope with, let alone the early, noon, and afternoon classes? Your Excellency and Quang

“Thuong - ha” is a way of honoring the title of a monk. For example, instead of saying rudely, “Dear Venerable Tri Tinh”, we often say “Dear Venerable Tri Tinh Ha Tinh” to show respect. Here, Mr. Tang called himself his Dharma name but also added the words "upper - lower", so the Patriarch criticized him for being rude.

Completely different path, Quang has a simplified appearance, but you always show off, please don't come back!

The Long Book [Pure Land] Literature teaches the recitation of thirty-six thousand billions of eleven thousand nine thousand five hundred with the same name and title of Amitabha Buddha. This matter should be discussed in terms of effort, not in terms of more or less! [If we compare] this one sentence (i.e. the sentence "thirty-six thousand billion, eleventy-nine thousand, five hundred with the same name, Amitabha Buddha") with just reciting the six-word Buddha's name, even though one recites ten thousand sentences a day, reciting for a hundred years, it is still not equal to the number [of Buddhas in] this one sentence. [That is, the number of Buddhas recited by] someone who recites six words throughout a lifetime is not equal to [the number of Buddhas recited [by] this one sentence. But the person who recites this one sentence, even if he has faith in his vow, still cannot be reborn89, and the person who recites [six words] all his life but has faith in his wish, can certainly be reborn! So, according to the regulations established by the Patriarchs, recite the six-word name, without calculating how much or how little! You must know: Amitabha Buddha is the Dharma Realm Bodhisattva, that is, this one name [Amitabha Buddha] includes all the names of all the Buddhas of the ten directions and three worlds. Is there only thirty-six thousand billion, eleventy-nine thousand five hundred? Everyone has a mind, a virtue, and a will [different]. Since I asked, I don't hesitate to speak frankly! Since our paths are different, we shouldn't meet. Quang is an ignorant and unconscious person, who is worthy of being called an idol90 of the Pure Land! Doesn't it make people feel ashamed and have no place to live?

Tong Tuong: Tuong (匠) is a worker. Duc Chanh is your wife. Knowing that lay people have studied Buddhism for many years, their family members have been inspired, which is truly admirable. I don't know if lay people firmly believe in the Pure Land Dharma, which is transcendent or not? Now that I have this predestined relationship, I'm not afraid to express my feelings in general. Throughout his entire life, the Tathagata taught countless and boundless methods of teaching. To find the most direct and quickest method, there is nothing better than practicing Zen. If you are a person of superior ability, you will receive a thousand enlightenments from just one hearing, and you will attain Mahasamadhi91, but that is still enlightenment, not realization! There are very few people who can truly achieve great enlightenment and clearly see their nature in the End of the Ages! Most of the others got the news wrong. That so-called Enlightenment is mostly “enlightenment” (錯誤: confusion), few people are truly enlightened! Even if you are truly enlightened, you are still very far from the end of life and death! Because even though you are enlightened, you still need to use all means to treat the afflictions and habits from many lifetimes until now, until they are completely gone, so that you can escape birth and death and become sublime and enter the saints. If the afflictions have been cut off to a certain extent, but there's still a little bit left to go, then life and death will still be the same, there's no way to escape!

If you only think "understanding your own mind is the way", and do not practice anything, then your misunderstanding is not small! If one understands, [but does not see] any afflictions to gain, then one can be called "enlightened", such a person is able to cut off the basis of birth and death and thus can escape birth and death. If despite understanding, afflictions have not been eliminated, how can one be free from birth and death? Compared to someone who does not recognize, although that person is much higher, but life and death are not clear, they must receive birth, or become confused, extremely scary! That's talking about people who are truly enlightened, but those who mistakenly believe they are enlightened, there's no need to talk about it anymore! That's because the method of Contemplation is a method of relying on Self-Power, so bring it

Total Retention (Dhāranī), also translated as Da Ra Ni, Energy Retention, Energy Protection (capable of blocking), all mean the power of wisdom that has the ability to preserve and remember all immeasurable Buddha Dharma without forgetting it. In a broad sense, Tong Tri means the ability to remember and not forget. From one meaning, one dharma can be thought of, remembering all dharmas, all meanings, without forgetting, without making mistakes. According to the Great Tri Doctrine, the General Knowledge consists of four types: Verbal Knowledge Dharani (the ability to listen without forgetting), Distinguishing Dharani (the ability to distinguish and know all evil - right, good - bad), Sound Entry Dharani (the ability to hear and understand all sounds and languages, but not get absorbed in or get angry), Self-Enterment Dharani (listen to secret mantras and immediately be able to understand the True Form of all dharmas). The Yogācāraṇāṇī also raises four other types: Speech Dharani, Mantra Dharani, Forbearance Dharani and Meaning Dharani. Because there are many types of Aggregates, the sutras often say "infinite Aggregates". Great General Tri is mastery of the four General Tri subjects mentioned above.

Compared to the Buddha's Recitation method, in terms of benefits, it is truly like heaven and earth!

The method of reciting the Buddha's name is a special method among the methods [that have been taught] throughout the life of the Tathagata, suitable for all three senses, including gain and loss. Those with the highest ability, such as the great Bodhisattvas Manjushri and Samantabhadra, cannot go beyond this dharma. Those with lower ability, such as the great sinners of the Five Negatives and Ten Evils, can also participate in it. As long as you have enough sincere faith and earnest prayer, you can rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to overcome your karma and be reborn. If you have attained samadhi and have put an end to all afflictions, once you are reborn you will immediately enter the position of a great Bodhisattva. All dharmas come from this dharma, all dharmas return to this dharma (called "rebirth in the West hoping to attain Buddhahood"). It seems shallow but immeasurably deep, as if small but vast, it covers nothing. In the ten directions and three generations, all the Buddhas above have achieved the Buddha path, and below, there is no one who does not rely on this eternal and eternal path to save sentient beings.

Afraid that lay people have not yet met someone who truly knows the Pure Land, they will probably consider this method short-sighted, so they focus their efforts on the Zen method of enlightening the mind and realizing nature, thinking that "understanding one's own mind is already solved". Therefore, it is impossible to stop talking for a while. If Quang's words are not trustworthy, please read carefully the Pure Land Ten Essentials, the Pure Land Thanh Hien Luc and Quang's Van Sao collection, you will not think that Quang is wrong or fabricated. If you truly know the difference between Buddha's power and your own power, you certainly won't still be attached to only considering your own mind, thinking that "understanding [the mind] is the way, there is no need to recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West." Ancient people like monk Vien Quan92 knew

Yuan Quan (also known as Yuan Ze) was a noble monk of the Tang Dynasty, whose year of birth and hometown are unknown. The monk lives in Lac Duong city, has a lively and simple nature, likes to study Buddhism, but also likes to create worldly possessions. He bought a lot of land and gardens, so his contemporaries called him Khong Mon Nong Muc Phu Nhan (rich farmer raising livestock in the Zen gate). The monk is very good at music. A close friend of the monk, Ly Nguyen, because his father, Ly Trung, was massacred by the enemy, donated all his assets to Hue Lam Pagoda. According to the Hui Lam monks, they only eat one meal per meal. Ly Nguyen was interested in learning the magic of alchemy, so he urgently requested monk Vien Quan to go to Sichuan to worship the Qingcheng, Emei, etc. mountains to pray for the elixir. Vien Quan wanted to go from Truong An to Ta Coc lane, but Ly Nguyen wanted to go from Kinh Chau to Tam Hiep. The two kept arguing for half a year without being able to decide. When Ly Nguyen said he did not want to follow Lac Duong or Truong An route, it was because he did not want to encounter familiar officials in the court. Yuan Quan then agreed to go the Kinh Chau route. When the boat just arrived at Nam Pho, when it encountered a backwater, it was necessary to put the boat down. Seeing a woman wearing a brocade shirt carrying a small jar going to the river to get water, Vien Quan saw it and bowed his head sadly, crying: "The reason I don't want to go down the path of the past - the future still cannot escape. The understanding of Zen of Ngu Patriarch Gioi, Thao Duong Thanh, whether people in this world can be sharp, but they still have to be born again! Therefore, know: Ordinary people decide to practice the special method due to The Buddha taught that no matter what your nature is, you can escape birth and death by relying on Buddha's power. If you rely on Self-Power, you are afraid that even if you dream, you won't be able to dream. I wonder if lay people will believe this or not?

67. Letter responding to layperson Tram Tho Nhan

(Year of the Republic 20 - 1931)

Received your letter three days ago, knowing that Lang93's order was that Ha Sanh had recited Buddha's name and was reborn. Although returning to the World Emperor seems to be a misfortune, being reborn is already extraordinary and has become a saint, which is truly a great blessing. You should reason according to Truth, don't be attached to worldly appearances and then feel compassion. Nowadays, those who are blind and disruptive are all because their parents hope that they will rise up and establish a family and honor their ancestors, but they do not know how to raise them, so they all become evil people who harm themselves, harm others, and harm the world. Therefore, people must open their eyes wide to see, then their mind will be calm and not worried.

Bao Quoc Pagoda has a total of forty-two monks, each of whom has responsibilities and cannot do Buddhist work. [With the] one hundred dong he sent, I told Linh Nham Pagoda to set up a tablet in the Buddha Recitation Hall. Linh Nham Buddha Recitation Pagoda can be considered the best in the Giang - Zhet region. Daily worship is no different from chanting Buddha's name! When entering the meditation room, add three more consecrations: morning, noon, and night. This pagoda belongs to the locality of Venerable Chan Dat of Thai Binh Pagoda, recently changed to the Ten Directions [ashram], specializing in reciting Buddha's name. All these things like reciting sutras and worshiping are afraid of meeting her." Ly Nguyen asked: "Since entering the Three Gorges, women dressing like this is not rare. Why are you crying for this woman alone? The Master replied: "This woman's name is Vuong. She will be the place where I will be born." She was pregnant for three years and still could not give birth, because I refused to enter her mother's womb. Now I can see it and I can't hide it anymore! Wait until I give birth, come visit me three days later, I will smile and believe. Twelve years later, on Mid-Autumn Festival night, we arranged to meet again outside Thien Truc Pagoda in Tien Duong, Hang Chau." After the Master finished speaking, he immediately passed away. The following incident happened exactly as Vien Quan had said. When returning to Hui Lam Pagoda, Ly Nguyen saw that the Master had already written down this matter on a page tucked in a sutra. Then he realized that the Master knew the cause and effect in advance but still could not avoid it.

A title to call someone else's son to show respect.

Repentance, releasing Diem Khau, making the Water Luc instrument, preaching sutras, transmitting precepts, accepting disciples, transmitting the dharma, etc. are all not done. Reciting Buddha's name all year round, and in the summer months, if convenient, he will preach the Pure Land Dharma, without attracting outsiders to listen.

When I received your letter, the next day I told Hoang Hoa Xa to send one of each type of books that had been printed in the past year or two, so you probably received it. In addition, because many people often take advantage of the Tet holidays to visit, they currently have no free time. 68. Letter responding to layperson Ly Duc Minh (two letters)

(In the year of the Republic of Korea 24 - 1935, this man was originally named Binh Nam94)

There is a proverb that says: "The world is peaceful, only the cause of self-harm"

(The world is inherently peaceful, only humans cause trouble). Wise people use intelligence to stir, fools use desire to stir. The danger caused by disturbing desires is fierce, but people still know it. The disturbances of a wise person, if they are not of superior knowledge, will not be known! Not knowing that it was disturbing, he arrogantly considered it virtue. That is the source of great chaos in our country from the beginning of heaven and earth until now! The doctrine that misleads people is deeply terrifying. King Wen's kindness permeated his bones for hundreds of years, but the custom of killing people to be buried95 was widespread throughout the world. Cong Muc, a gentle king of the Qin state, also killed one hundred and seventy-seven people to be buried. The three people named Tu Xa96 are not exempt because they are wise men of the country! As for those who are not gentle, they kill even more, how dare they talk about it!

Since the Buddha Dharma spread to the East, clearly stating the cause and effect of reincarnation, those who "turn their faces to the South call me"

This person is the old layman Ly Binh Nam, the teacher of monk Tinh Khong. According to Tuyet Lu Lao Nhan's Summary in Tuyet Lu Lao Nhan Pure Land Collection, Mr. Ly Binh Nam's real name is Ly Diem, his personal name is Binh Nam, his nickname is Tuyet Lu, his dharma name is Duc Minh, his nickname is Tuyet Tang, or Tuyet Tau, from Jinan district, Shandong province.

Burial: This is an ancient Chinese superstition, burying the living with the dead so that the dead have someone to serve and protect them.

Tu Xa is a very ancient family name of Qin land. During the time of Qin Cong Muc, there were three great doctors who were considered wise men and belonged to the Tu Xa family: Tu Xa Yem Xi, Tu Xa Trong Hanh and Tu Xa Kiem Ho. All three of these were ordered by the Qin royal family to be killed and buried along with Qin Muc Cong.

Even those in later generations would not dare to do it. Even though the cruel king still wanted to do so, he definitely did not dare to consider it glorious or think that the more he killed, the better! If there was no Buddha Dharma in the world, who would be able to live out their entire lifespan? Therefore, I say: "Cause and effect is a great means for saints in this world and beyond to rule the world and save sentient beings." Mr. Chau An Si said: "If cause and effect know cause and effect, great rule is the path. Cause and effect do not know cause and effect, great chaos is the way" (Everyone knows that cause and effect is the way to rule. Everyone does not know that cause and effect is the way of great chaos). The Trinh family, the Chau97 family, have high talents, stealing meanings from Buddhist scriptures to explain Confucian classics, and are afraid of people learning about Buddhism, so they especially promote different meanings, thinking that it is cause and effect retribution, the cycle of birth and death because the Buddha said that, in fact, there is no such thing, Buddha just borrowed those stories to deceive foolish men and foolish women into following Buddhism! Furthermore, when a person dies, his body is lost, his soul also wanders, even if he chops - chops - grinds - pounds, is there anything left to do? Moreover, the soul has scattered, who else is there to be reborn?

That story is the most superficial story in Buddhism, but it is the most important story for the country and society. They have proposed that the cause and effect of reincarnation is an illusion. If there is no cause and effect of reincarnation, then there is nothing to advise, and there is nothing to admonish for the evil. They cling to "right heart and sincere intention" as the basis to teach the people and keep the country peaceful. They do not know that if there is no cause and effect of reincarnation, then there is no difference between right heart and sincere intention and not right heart and sincere intention. It's just an empty name! If it really doesn't exist, then who cares about that vanity? In the world of Physics from then on, there was no one who did not secretly read Buddhist scriptures, but no one who did not refute Buddhism. Because we do not promote cause and effect, we arrogantly consider the basis for governing the country, the people, and the mind to be controversial and nonsense!

Over the past few hundred years, it has still been maintained and still has formal teachings. Until the European wind gradually blows to the East, completely leaning towards the European wind. Because there is no basis for the cause and effect of reincarnation, one becomes licentious, strange, luxurious, evil, and does nothing. The original intention of the Trinh and Chau families at that time was to use the destruction of Buddha to protect Confucianism, but they did not know that destroying Buddha would become destroying Confucianism. As it is now, the Five Classics and the Four Books have become banned books, and schools, big or small, do not allow them to be studied. That is clear evidence! Grape

That is, Trinh Di and Chau Hy, the founders of Song Confucianism, advocated Ly Hoc.

and Thich, from the same source, [the Ly Hoc group] believes that the mind is completely different from the body. They plan to destroy the mind, but the body is destroyed first! If the two of them were sacred, they wouldn't consider what they said to be true, and they would regret it before they could! Those words seem distant but are actually very close. If the reader does not clearly understand this important point, reading Buddhist scriptures will also give rise to faith, reading books that slander Buddha along with Physics will also give rise to faith, Reason and Desire fight in the same mind, self-benefit and benefit of others are greatly hindered! Therefore, I will briefly summarize that problem. I hope you will consider it and all similar things will be understood.

Trang Hau Trach was sixty-five years old and wanted to worship the monk who only knew rice and porridge as a teacher, so he gave him the dharma name Duc Phu, which means: Using cause and effect retribution, believing in praying to Buddha's name to practice dharma to help oneself and others, causing all of his peers to live as saints and sages and be born in the Pure Land. Mr. Phuong Truong Long, whose full name is Han Tuyen, used a pure heart to permeate everything, so he had the dharma name Duc Trach.

The word War has a very deep relationship, the boundary between human desire and heavenly reason, if we do not fight with all our might, the reason will be obscured by desire, causing reason to be hidden, desire to be obvious. Confucius [said] "the forty years [of] no confusion" (the age of forty is not mistaken) is [talking about] the time when reason prevails and desire is subdued. "Seventy desires without wandering" (at the age of seventy, desires are not out of bounds) means the world is peaceful, completely free of war! Confucius said: "If we fight, we will win." Confucius never held military power in his entire life, so how dare he say "If we fight, we will win"? That is Confucius's small intention to teach people to "control their thoughts to become saints"! Therefore, the dharma name was given as Duc Khac. The saint folds his robe and folds his arms to rule the world, the essential thing is just "no desire". If you don't have desire, you don't have to fight. If you have desire, you have to fight for a long time until you and everyone else die, then your heart will cool down. Otherwise, we will wish others to die so that we can live, determined not to think about the tragedy of war to stop it. If Vu Bai Lam knew that "Tathagata's Pure Land dharma is a shower of nectar for sentient beings in the nine worlds", he would be able to keep morality intact, fulfill all duties, put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, obey good deeds, act on his own, teach others one person, hundreds of people in harmony, look at each other [imitate each other] and do good in large numbers. Therefore, giving [him] the dharma name Duc Lam.

He said [himself] was a tenant, afraid of not having an heir. Now these four people are people whose hometowns are there, you should tell them to spread this method forever. For all the large books with deep and concise meanings, the four [of you] each keep a part; Books that ordinary people can read can be freely given to people as well as to prisoners. Please see this story in the article about "respecting books, regretting paper", it is not written in detail here.

69. Letter responding to Mr. Trinh Quan Tinh

(Year of the Republic of China 20 - 1931 - attached original letter of inquiry)

Previously, I read the essay "Respect for paper and words" [by the old magician], the words and meaning were accurate, it was truly a miraculous medicine to cure the bad habits of the time. According to the article Gong Qua Cach of Emperor Wen (Wenchang Dejun), it is said: "Using paper with words to wrap sutras and line the mat, [committing] fifty mistakes." Previously, I sent a letter to ask Mr. Nhiep Van Dai: "If I use newspaper to practice calligraphy and then burn it after writing, is it a crime of contempt? Should I use it to wrap sutras or not?" The Master again taught: "It is inevitable that the bad people will not be able to avoid it, but they do not dare to speak decisively, please ask the great monks" etc. Furthermore, in the past, the layperson Pham Co Nong answered the question of the bad people as follows: "Respect for writing paper seems to be for writing in newspapers, we must distinguish whether it is the scriptures of the saints, whether it is worthy of respect or not, etc...." Papers with letters are often used to cover scriptures and practice books. Is the Dharma good? I respectfully ask the old magician to make a decision.

In addition, in Wenchang Dijun's Gong Guo, it is said: "If you take your child to become a monk, he commits fifty mistakes", but the Buddhist scriptures strongly praise the outstanding merit of becoming a monk. Because Emperor Van Xuong took refuge, believed in the Three Jewels, and received a prediction from the Buddha, why did he say those words that were so contradictory to the meaning in the sutra, I also really wanted the old magician to judge.

Using paper with words to wrap sutras or line mats is not only disrespectful of paper with words but also disrespectful of sutras and disrespectful of the ashram! You're a reader, but how many times do you have to ask others about this? It's not impossible to use newspaper to practice writing, but don't write haphazardly. Writing haphazardly will become a lack of respect. Mr. Co Nong said that considering the value of the words written in the newspaper, it is almost reasonable, but who uses that mentality? There are no special words in the scriptures of the sages that don't use common words! Cong Qua Cach said "bringing children to become a monk makes mistakes" is to prevent the bad habit of "evil people abandoning their children due to malice but still want to gain a good reputation", not the story of father - son, brother - brother developing Bodhi mind and bringing each other to become a monk but also being guilty. His knowledge is limited and does not have comprehensive understanding, so every problem in the world has to be asked many times by others but still cannot be resolved! Why is that? Because there is Ego Clinging. Even though someone else had explained this doubt to him, he still had doubts due to the explanation. If the Self-Clinging does not let go, how can he follow what others say? Those who understand these sentences clearly do not need to bother thinking about them, because they already understand them. If you use that mindset to study Buddhism, you will not be able to overcome the path of discriminatory thoughts for the rest of your life!
