Looking at your questions, most of them are due to not knowing how to think clearly. If we consider more carefully, there will be no need to ask others! The words [Your Majesty] have always praised [Quang], unfortunately, although the literature is good, it is used in the wrong place!

tieu_de: 72. Letter responding to layperson Chau Ba Tu
tom_tat: Received the letter the other day, but recently I've been quite busy with work, so I'm late replying to the letter. Luckily, his whole family still practices the same way, which is really happy and comforting. These past few years, disasters have happened so often, it's sad...
noi_dung:
72. Letter responding to layperson Chau Ba Tu

Received the letter the other day, but recently I've been quite busy with work, so I'm late replying to the letter. Luckily, his whole family still practices the same way, which is really happy and comforting. These past few years, disasters have happened so often that it's worth cold-heartedness. In general, it's because people's hearts are becoming more and more corrupt! Ways to help victims have something to rebuild their lives later are important ways to help in times of hardship, but this way is not often available. Now, to do the usual things, especially to establish a dharma, hoping to spread it often, it will be extremely beneficial. Right now is a time of great tribulation, regardless of whether rich or poor, old or young, male or female, all should recite the holy name "namo Amitabha Buddha" and "namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva" as a basis to prevent disasters. In the face of war, water, fire, pestilence, pests, drought, floods, bandits, bandits, and other unwanted disasters, illnesses caused by grudges, unjust encounters, etc., if one can sincerely recite Buddha's name and Avalokiteśvara's name, they will certainly encounter evil and good. Even if it is caused by fixed karma, it can be mitigated and not be too severe. These disasters do not discriminate between rich and poor. But the rich seem to have more difficulty enduring than the poor; Therefore, you should not ignore it because you are rich, [nor] because you are poor, ignore it and not make a precautionary plan.

Furthermore, the method of reciting the Buddha's name is beneficial to human life and death. The world only knows the benefits of chanting at the time of death, but does not know the benefits of chanting during childbirth, so many mothers and children have to suffer immeasurable suffering, or even lose their lives, with no way to save them! If a woman can regularly recite the holy names of Buddha and Avalokiteśvara from a young age, then in the future she will definitely not suffer from complications during childbirth. Either you immediately recite it as soon as you conceive, or you recite it three or four months before giving birth, or you begin to recite it during childbirth, and you will all be able to give birth peacefully. If your birth is extremely difficult and you are about to lose your life, if you recite namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, you will certainly immediately be able to give birth peacefully. Don't say that at that time you were naked and impure. If you think about it, you will be afraid of committing a sin! You must know that Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara is great and compassionate in his search to save suffering. For example, if you see your children falling into fire, water, or a toilet, and call your parents for help, your parents will not leave you alone and not save them because their clothes are not neat and their bodies are not clean.

The Bodhisattva's heart to save sentient beings is deeper and more passionate than the love of parents for their children in this world, literally hundreds of thousands of millions of millions of times more! Therefore, when women give birth, being able to clearly recite the Bodhisattva's name is the ultimate wonderful Dharma that is extremely effective and powerful. Not only is there no sin, but it also causes both mother and child to be sown with great good roots. This meaning was taught by Shakyamuni Buddha in the Medicine Sutra, not fabricated by Buhui. For everyone who has mindfulness, no one will not be able to give birth safely. Recently, there have been too many people having difficult births, partly due to bad karma in previous lives, partly due to not knowing how to abstain in this life. Bodhisattvas who save suffering, of course, do not consider the cause of that person [in distress], they all help equally.

When normally reciting Buddha's name, although you can recite while walking - standing - lying down - sitting, but when sleeping, you should only recite silently in your mind, not out loud. If when you wake up, your clothes and hat are not yet neat, your hands and face have not been washed or rinsed, and when bathing, urinating, and going to unclean places, you should only recite it silently in your mind, do not recite it out loud. During those times and places, the merit recited silently is the same as the merit recited in normal times. Reciting out loud is not according to etiquette. When giving birth, you must recite clearly out loud, not silently in your mind, because silently reciting has little impact. Also because at that time you have to use force to push the child out, if you recite it silently in your mind, because of the trapped energy, you can become sick! Not only the pregnant woman must recite the sound clearly, but the caregivers nearby must also recite the sound clearly. Even if family members live elsewhere, they can still pray for the pregnant woman. If this Dharma is spread, the world will forever be free from the suffering of childbirth, and the suffering of both mother and child dying from childbirth.

[You must] know that Buddha's Dharma benefits all beings. Buddha is the great compassionate parent, the heaven of gods, the saint of saints, and because of his great Bodhi mind, he benefits all sentient beings, so he achieves complete achievements. In life, there are people who speak in a high-pitched voice, "tired of hearing about cause and effect and the dharma to diligently practice", only taking "all is empty, everything is not attached" as a protective talisman, not knowing that if you accept "all is empty, everything is not attached", then it does not mean "all is empty, everything is not attached"! What's more, that person uses that excuse to cover up the traces of laziness and procrastination, not really concentrating on cultivating, just "talking down, arguing high". When the karma is ripe, old Diem (King of Diem La) will make the ultimate offering to that person who "doesn't accept everything, everything is empty". I wonder if at that time, [that person] can still "all is emptiness, everything is not attached"? We should be very respectful towards those people, so as not to receive Elder Diem's ​​supreme respect and offerings!

tieu_de: 73. Letter responding to layman Duong Nang Thanh
tom_tat: Yesterday I received a letter, knowing the tragedy caused by bandits in Sichuan, I couldn't stop people from lamenting. I often say: "Cause and effect is a great means for saints to rule the world and for Buddha to save sentient beings." From…
noi_dung:
73. Letter responding to layman Duong Nang Thanh

Yesterday I received a letter, knowing the tragedy caused by bandits in Sichuan, I couldn't stop people from lamenting. I often say: "Cause and effect is a great means for saints to rule the world and for Buddha to save sentient beings." From the Song Dynasty, the Trinh and Chau families read the Mahayana Buddhist sutras, were close to the wise men of Zen Buddhism, and knew roughly the meaning of "all things are reason, all are idealistic", so they blindly attached themselves to their own opinions and ignored things to pretend they had superior knowledge. They were so afraid that later generations would know [how] they got that [understanding], so they darkly blasphemed the Buddha, saying cause and effect retribution, the six paths of reincarnation as taught by the Buddha were the same. a basis to deceive foolish men and women into believing in His teachings, but in fact there is no such thing. People are dead, their bodies have rotted, and their souls are scattered; Even if you cut, chop, grind, and pound, what will you do with it? Because the soul has been destroyed, who is there to be reborn? From then on, everyone in the Confucian dynasty, whoever had advanced knowledge, secretly read Buddhist scriptures, but they all strongly blasphemed Buddha; People with low understanding then follow others to raise crazy views. From life to death, they do not benefit from Buddha's teachings. From life to death, they often create karma to defame Buddha.

As soon as the doctrines of the Trinh and Chau families were circulated, the Confucianists followed them like a golden rule, but the fact that the Trinh and Chau families rebelled against the immortals (Confucian saints) no one in the whole world was willing to talk about! In the future, if any Confucianist speaks contrary to Trinh, Chau will not be able to stand firmly in heaven and earth. Therefore, Confucians do not dare to talk about cause and effect reincarnation, because if they say it, they will be attacked. I also want to have achievements in the future, want to participate in Huong Hien Tu (a temple dedicated to talented people in the village) or in the Temple of Literature. If we talk about cause and effect reincarnation, both sides are in despair! From then on, we completely abolished the basis of governing the nation and the world, relying solely on "righteousness and sincerity" to govern [the world]. You must know: If there is cause and effect in reincarnation, people who are not able to have the right mind and sincere intention will still try their best to do it. Without the cause and effect of reincarnation, only the great sages can have the right mind and sincere intention; As for the others, because they have nothing to fear and nothing to hope for, why do they insist on being sincere?

Trinh - Chau proposed that his sincerity was due to learning the wonderful meaning of the Buddha's teachings, but in order to show off his own wisdom, he arrogantly and strongly criticized the Buddha. Thus, they have their right heart and sincere intention in unimportant and urgent places, but have absolutely no right heart and sincere intention in important and urgent places! Use this to create a name for yourself, causing harm to people in the future. Recently, disasters have continuously occurred, people are unable to survive, all due to the poison of the outbreak of Song Confucian doctrine, do you know?

Reciting Buddha's name and chanting sutras is based on sincerity, whether you praise it or not is irrelevant! As for reciting a volume of the Lotus Sutra, it's very good, but for busy and elderly people, you should often recite the Five Pure Land Sutras to understand the general reasons for the Pure Land method. Reciting the Buddha's name must be clearly recited in the mind, recited clearly with the mouth, clearly heard with the ears, recite from morning to night and listen from morning to night, compared to those who meditate a lot, recite quickly but are not clear, the effect is very different! Now send him a package of the Five Pure Land Sutras. Those who have faith and can respect them should give them the remaining books. Don't use the method of reading Confucian books to read Buddhist scriptures to get benefits and avoid sin. Otherwise, the sin of contempt will be greater than the merit of reciting it!

tieu_de: 74. Letter responding to layperson Tinh Chi
tom_tat: I received a letter the night before. Due to my lack of reading power, I couldn't read it. During the past two days, I had to worry about other things and had no free time, so I forgot. In the afternoon, I randomly checked and realized I wanted to request books and...
noi_dung:
74. Letter responding to layperson Tinh Chi

(Year of the Republic 25 - 1936)

I received a letter the night before. Due to my lack of reading power, I couldn't read it. During the past two days, I had to worry about other things and had no free time, so I forgot. In the afternoon, when I randomly checked, I realized that I wanted to request books and sent the cost to Quang. I immediately told Hoang Hoa Xa to send the books in the correct quantity. In addition, [asked them] to send Quang four more packages of books. Quang is old, not strong enough, he still doesn't care about outside things, there is no dharma temple, no matter who says it or not, Quang doesn't want to care about it. He worshiped Quang as his teacher and did not hesitate to tell him how to harmonize the methods. You should use a mind that is just and righteous, and use language that is just and righteous to advise, it will be a blessing for the dharma. If it's done out of your own love, then there's absolutely nothing worth discussing! Making others dissatisfied, completely slandering good knowledge, creating hellish karma, then the dharma that was originally meant to harmonize the dharma, turns out to be a group of people who share the same opinion [with us] to attack those who have different opinions [from us], causing the protection of the dharma to become the destruction of the dharma, a good mind cannot achieve good results! If that's the case, then you see people as pitiable, people also see you as pitiable, even the supreme, highly respected monks who absolutely cannot object to anything will become pitiful! Therefore, Confucius taught that those who have a sincere heart must be knowledgeable (understand thoroughly), [to] be wise, they must be detached from things (eliminate material desires). Not being "away from things" is like wearing blue, red, etc. glasses, but the colors seen are not their true colors. Because the mind is dominated by desires, it drowns in one side, not seeing the truth of things, seeing what is right in others becomes wrong! Everyone should take this word as a guideline when it comes to matters of worldly governance and cultivation, don't consider it corrupt and then look down upon it!

tieu_de: 75. Letter responding to layperson Giang Canh Xuan (two letters)
tom_tat: Ouija110 is the effect of ghost spirits. They claim to be this Buddha, that Bodhisattva, that immortal, all impersonating their names. If true immortals happen to descend, I'm afraid there won't be even one in a hundred thousand cases...
noi_dung:
75. Letter responding to layperson Giang Canh Xuan (two letters)

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

Ouija110 is the effect of ghost spirits. They claim to be this Buddha, that Bodhisattva, that immortal, all impersonating their names. If true immortals happen to descend, I'm afraid there won't be even one in a hundred thousand cases, let alone a Buddha or Bodhisattva! Using Ouija board to promote Buddhism may have small benefits, but it is fundamentally wrong! People who truly study Buddhism do not rely on this method to promote Buddhism. Why is that? Because that is the effect of demons. If there is a smart ghost spirit, then luckily it won't be enough to ruin things, but if it's an evil demon descending to earth, it will definitely ruin big things! People say that Buddha Dharma is wrong because of their bad words and big troubles. Proposing that kind of thing is the clue to destroying Buddha Dharma! He said he had lost benefits and asked if he was guilty

The original text is "phu co" (often read as "pho co"), which means the form of "holding the pen". Mechanical pens in China are often made shaped like a basket, beautifully decorated, on the edge of the basket there is a pointed beak carved in the shape of a bird, so it is sometimes called "fu loan". Each time to pray for Ouija board, two "phu co" people (often called "pu" or "dong") will lift both sides of the basket, move the bird's beak to write on the rice tray or sand tray.

Whether or not he is guilty, we know that he completely does not know the true meaning of Buddha Dharma, it is so lamentable!

During the Dao Guang - Ham Phong period (1821-1861) of the Qing Dynasty, in the Quang Tin prefecture, Jiangxi province, there was a Han Lam111 named Tu Khiem, from

Bach Pang. That person lived to be ninety-six years old, and when he died, heavenly music resounded in the air, it was like being born into heaven! He did not know about the Pure Land dharma. He did not make a clear distinction between the status of Buddha, Bodhisattva, god, or immortal! An old monk in Putuo, his youngest disciple, told Quang this story thoroughly. He authored the book Hainan Nhat Chuoc (a drop of water from Hainan), [in that book] considered the fake middle and lower volumes of the Heart Sutra to be the same as the Heart Sutra, and also wrote down the words of the fall to pray for rain in Sichuan, [in which] it said that Avalokitesvara knelt in the Palace of the Jade Emperor112 to pray for rain. It is enough to know that his nonsense and his views are both evil and right without distinction!

He said that "not praying for luck will result in losing benefits", don't you know that the disaster of doing so can lead to the destruction of the Dharma? Tu Khiem is a person who loves good things and believes in Buddhism, but really does not understand Buddhist principles, does not like to be an official, stays at home teaching people to do good, also prays for fortune himself, teaches his own disciples to pray for fortune. Everyone does not know the origin of Ouija board and the origin of Buddha. At that time, a Bachelor in Nanchang (Jiangxi province) also had the same behavior as Tu Khiem. This Bachelor's disciple prayed for a medical examination in the province, which was very flexible. The Tuan Phu official's mother is expensive

The Academy was a structure established in the Tang Dynasty, initially only to select people with literary, artistic, and profound knowledge to be advisors to the court. But from the reign of Emperor Huyen Tong onwards, Han Lam Vien became an important agency specializing in drafting decrees and secret documents for the emperor. People who work in this agency are collectively called Academicians, or Han Lam for short. Actually, there are two types: Academic Scholars who specialize in preparing official documents, drafting, and screening documents. And Han Lam Cung Phung takes care of keeping books and administrative work in the agency. The ancient Chinese word Academy has a completely different meaning from the current word Academy.

The Jade Emperor, fully known as the Jade Emperor, according to folk beliefs, is the supreme deity in charge of the gods and all creatures in the entire universe, often called Hao Thien Thuong by Confucians. However, in Taoism, the Jade Emperor is still lower than the Tam Thanh (Thai Thanh, Thuong Thanh, and Ngoc Thanh), because he is considered a deity born by Tam Thanh to take charge of the universe on their behalf. According to Jade Emperor Ban Hanh Tap, the prince of Quang Minh Dieu Quoc abandoned his throne and followed the teachings of Tam Thanh in Huong Nghiem mountain to become a true immortal. Taoism proclaimed the Jade Emperor's beautiful title "Hao Thien Kim Khue Supreme Supreme Natural Wonderful Friendship Di La Chi Chan Jade Emperor". In Buddhism, the Jade Emperor is Emperor Thich in the Desire Realm. Thus, the status of the Jade Emperor is much lower than that of the Great Brahma King. Could it be that Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva knelt in the Linh Tieu Palace and prayed to God to make a decree to make it rain?

sick, the medicine is ineffective, someone said Mr. Therefore, he was invited to visit the patient. Prescribe and take medicine, the patient dies immediately. I hastily took the prescription to the doctor, and it turned out that there was a medicine in it. Therefore, make him come and ask. He replied: "This was taught by my teacher, Mr. Y...". Therefore, the Tuan Phu official arrested his teacher, said: "You lie to the world and harm people", and killed his teacher. Tu Khiem heard this story and warned his disciples to stop praying for fortune from now on!

He said, "If you don't pray for fortune, the dharma lacks fate." In your heart, you were shocked and seething, not knowing that the disaster of fortune-telling is so great that the merit of advising others cannot be compensated for! A noble man will never step into that altar. At the end of the Ming Dynasty, in Suzhou, there was a seeker who had seven or eight disciples. One day, she spoke Buddha Dharma, advising people to recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West. It was completely different from what she had said before. After that, he repeated the same fate more than twenty more times, and finally said again, "The prayer of fortune is the function of ghosts and gods, I am that X..., from now on I will not come again, you should not pray for fortune anymore!" That story is recorded in Tay Phuong Xac Chi113.

In the first year of the Republic of Korea (1911), in Hong Kong, someone prayed for fortune, saying that the great immortal Hoang Xich Tung [descended] to see the extremely spiritual disease. There are people who have no reason to live anymore and pray to that fairy to teach them a cure. That medicine is also an arbitrary type, it doesn't matter much, but as soon as you take it, you will be cured immediately. Hoang Tieu Vy came to learn with admiration and learned how to [pray for Ouija], but whenever he grabbed the cue, the cue wouldn't run. Others asked, how many times does the body teach how to chant the Diamond Sutra and then rely on the body, and following it is also very flexible. For that reason, he often teaches the method of reciting the Buddha's name. Mr. Vy immediately wanted to set up a Buddhist recitation monastery, and the teacher said: "We should wait another three years before establishing it." Three years later, four or five of them went to Shanghai to ask for scriptures, and the next year they came to take refuge and established the Da Da Buddhist Study Society. They sent me the Buddha recitation program: After reciting the Buddha's name, reciting Quan Am and That Chi.

Tay Phuong Xac Chi is a book recording the words of enlightenment of Bodhisattva Giac Minh Dieu, compiled by Thuong Nhiep. Accordingly, at the end of the Ming Dynasty, Tuong Vo Hu, eight people who liked to practice immortality, often gathered together to pray for luck. One day, a fairy came down and taught them to recite Namo Buddha. They then called Namo Buddha. He said that reciting Buddha is not just reciting with your mouth like that. Then he gradually taught them to practice the Pure Land method, eliminating the desire for immortality, as well as destroying their bad habits. These eight people later became diligent Pure Land practitioners. Bodhisattva's teachings about the Pure Land are completely consistent with the teachings of the Pure Land Patriarchs, strongly attacking the evil of seeking fortune, so they are highly respected by Chinese Buddhism. Western Bodhidharma is also included in the Sutra Pitaka.

After finishing, recite one more person named Da Da Ha Bodhisattva. Quang asked: "How did you get that title?" They then told their background, saying that in the past she called herself the great immortal Hoang Xich Tung114, then taught and practiced the Pure Land dharma, and finally revealed that her origin was Da Da Ha Bodhisattva, and warned her to never seek fortune again.

These two stories were compiled by a disciple of Pure Land Dharma teachings and named Pure Land Essentials 115. Quang told him to include these two stories at the back. Now send me three copies, read them and you will know for yourself (with Da Da Ha Bodhisattva, Quang told them to set up a separate hall to worship, not to add the Buddha Recitation ritual to avoid making other people hear and react).

Participating in inter-communal recitation of Buddha's name means one must be busy, and two is to give up current affairs. Reciting Buddha's name at home depends on your ability, the benefits are great. Once or twice a month, we promote lectures in the inter-commune to make people know the rules and benefits. In normal times, why do we have to go to the inter-commune to recite Buddha's name every day? This has been Quang's main opinion since the establishment of Lam Xa Buddhist Recitation until now.

Should Buddhist disciples celebrate Taoist saints' birthdays? If it is said that worldly [habits] are passed down and are difficult to stop, then we should still take reciting the Buddha's name as the main thing. [Deities in] Taoism belong to heaven, fairies, and demons, one of those three things. Because they recite Buddha's name to increase their good roots in this world and destroy their evil karma from previous lives. Didn't you see in the dedication words of the morning session: "Dedication to protect the dharma, dragons and saints" (dedicate to the gods and dragons to protect the dharma, the saints who preserve and protect the pagoda)? The South [China] is often read as Three Jewels, while the North is often read as "dharma protector", which fits the meaning better. Gods, fairies, and ghosts are all classified as protectors of the dharma. Because

Great Immortal Hoang Xich Tung: In the sacred system of Taoism, this person's name is not listed. According to legend, in the year of Guangxu 23 (1897), in South China, people were miserable and epidemics were widespread, so Ouija boards praying to fairies for medicine were very popular. There was a descendant who called himself the great immortal Hoang Xich Tung, and often gave very effective medicine. From there, the belief in worshiping Hoang Dai Tien was formed. Because this man claimed to be a healer during his lifetime, the altar paintings often depict a middle-aged man wearing the style of a Manchu Qing healer. The first temple was established in Nam Cuong village, Nam Hai district, Guangdong province, named Pho Do Dan, and then gradually spread to Hong Kong and Taiwan.

Loan.

Pure Land Essentials is a work compiled by layperson Kho Hanh, edited by laypeople Phan Hue Thuan and Thieu Hue Vien, and evaluated by Great Master An Quang. It is divided into three parts: The first part explains and defines the Pure Land dharma, the second part quotes the Pure Land Dharma teachings of the Venerable Patriarchs, the last part is the Buddha recitation ritual and excerpts of some of the main scriptures of the Pure Land.

If the dragons and gods protect the Dharma, reciting Buddha's name is in accordance with the righteous principles. If you recite fake sutras such as the Jade Emperor Sutra116, etc., you will become wrong.

The decline of the Buddha Dharma is all due to the secular monks not knowing the Buddha Dharma, using fake sutras such as the Blood Tank Sutra and the Tho Sanh Sutra as important teachings to seek wealth. Since then, "Buddha's deeds" such as destroying the blood lake, destroying hell, returning money to life, sending money to the warehouse, etc. are seen more and more. Although it defrauds fools of their money, it causes educated people who understand worldly reasons but do not know the truth of Buddhism to slander them. Secular monks only seek money, not caring about the destruction and destruction of the profound Dharma of these types of "Buddhist things". If you meet someone with true knowledge and right view who uses the expenses of doing these "Buddhist things" to [use them for] reciting Buddha's name, it will be of great benefit!

After the letter was prepared, the dharma names of twenty-four people were each written down on separate paper. Taking refuge is easy, but you should not still keep the pagan program. Both the power of the eye and the spirit are not enough and cannot reveal much. Now send twenty-four copies of Gia Ngon Luc, one copy for each person, thirty copies of "A Letter to Everywhere", one sheet for each person, the remaining amount can be given as a gift, three copies of Essentials of the Pure Land, three copies of the Universal Strength of Tan Luong, these two types are used to help with the promotion.

You should tell them: Having taken refuge in the Buddha's Dharma to become a Buddhist disciple, one must maintain moral ethics, fulfill all duties, abandon evil hearts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil deeds, obey good deeds, keep a good mind, speak good words, do good deeds, and act like that to be a true Buddhist disciple. If you recite Buddha's name with your mouth, but your heart is not good, it will contrast with the Buddha's destiny, and you will not be able to get real benefits from Buddha's name! You should often read Gia Ngon Luc, then you will know all the benefits of the method clearly. In addition, A Letter to Everyone is a simple ritual and protocol for daily practice. Although the writing is short-sighted, the meaning is profound and should be used as a family heirloom forever. Other things have been said in detail in Gia Ngon Luc, but are not written in detail here.

tieu_de: 76. Letter replying to layperson X…
tom_tat: The Jade Emperor Sutra, also known as the Holy Nguyen Giac Chan Sutra, or simply called the Yellow Kinh, is a major classic of Taoism, praising the Jade Emperor and recounting his ancient stories.
noi_dung:
76. Letter replying to layperson X…

The Jade Emperor Sutra, also known as the Holy Nguyen Giac Chan Sutra, or simply called the Yellow Sutra, is a major classic of Taoism, praising the Jade Emperor and recounting his ancient stories.

People living in the world are precious in keeping their duties. All those who are crazy and crazy, often even pessimistic, often want to commit suicide, are all because they do not practice true conduct, want great happiness, everything is as they wish, talent, beauty, reputation are better than others. If in the previous life you were a monk and had the blessings of ignorance and had that desire fulfilled, then you would be arrogant, luxurious, lustful, and there would be nothing you wouldn't do. Such a disaster is ten thousand times worse than suicide! Fortunately, it hasn't been achieved yet, so it's not yet that fierce. If you want to get rid of that affliction, you should maintain your duty in everything, and don't give rise to any false thoughts that want to go beyond your duty!

Depending on one's fate, if one is someone else's servant, one must fully exhaust one's servanthood, not feel ashamed of it, and hold the heart of "I originally had no qualifications to be a servant, now that I can be a servant, I must fully exhaust one's servanthood", not being arrogant and contemptuous of others. Even if the owner knows me, I'm not happy. The owner doesn't know, so I'm not upset. I fulfill my duty, whether or not I care about you! The mind does not compare, the heart does not resent. As a servant like that, the master will respect him like a teacher and not dare to treat him like a servant. If because we skillfully exhaust our servant's role, others do not dare to consider us as servants or respect us as teachers, we still do not develop an arrogant mind, knowing that servants and teachers are both impersonators, and that we are truly happy to completely exhaust our roles. I'm just afraid that my conduct is not worthy of my reputation, no matter how people treat me. Even though the great men of ancient times were in dire straits and were unable to survive, they had no thoughts of sadness or resentment. Even though they were as noble as a prince, rich and dominating the world, they still maintained the attitude of a farmer worshiping in the fields. This is called "wealth and nobility cannot commit adultery, poverty cannot move, power cannot be subdued" (wealth and wealth cannot be indulgent, poverty cannot change [will], power cannot be subdued), so the gentleman is always calm and relaxed! Otherwise, the petty person will always have to worry!

He wanted to pray for Quang to cure his illness, but as for the words [he used] in this letter, it was true that he had to gradually observe them to understand what the words were, to understand what the letter was about. Therefore, Quang knows that he has great ambition and speaks loudly, but absolutely does not focus on doing his best. If you are at peace and do not brag, you will not state your biggest request, using these extremely difficult to recognize words, making others have to spend a lot of thought to read your letter, because you have found a way to solve your sadness! If he had a great position, I don't know how confusing and sophisticated all the criticism would be! Like Mr. Phung Mong Hoa's handwriting, when writing ten letters, there are nine of them that other people cannot recognize the entire handwriting, to the point that children die, grandchildren die, and grandchildren adopted to continue the family line also die, more than half of it is due to the writing. Don't consider it something strange or special!

Every word must be written in such a way that people will immediately understand it as soon as they see it, then the mind of a great gentleman must benefit others as well as himself. Mr. Phung sent a letter to Quang. Quang wasted a lot of effort and only received eight parts. Quang wrote back to him, saying: "Mr. Quang's letter can only be read in eight parts, but he still understands the meaning. If you are not very fluent in writing, a lot of trouble will happen! I hope from now on you will not use that style anymore to benefit everyone." Later, he wrote a letter to Quang, using the script Khai. Quang thought he had changed his habits. When I asked someone else, it turned out he still kept his old habits. He was so frustrated that he wanted to commit suicide, afraid that what Quang said he didn't think was right!

Previously, an officer from Phien Tri district, Son Tay province, surnamed Tuc, because the country was not at peace, went to Sun Yat-sen's mausoleum (Ton Van) to cut open his stomach, but was saved by others so he did not die. A disciple thought that because he felt sad for his country that he would commit suicide, he specifically advised him to go to Suzhou to take refuge. He stayed in Suzhou for many days, his wife and children also followed. One day, he took his daughter and servant with him, the daughter was ten years old, the servant was nearly thirty. He chatted with Quang, his daughter and the servant played around. He scolded her, but the girl didn't listen and immediately got angry and scolded her. They were quiet for a moment, then played around again. Quang understood that he only knew how to resent life, but had absolutely no talent to keep the world at peace. There's only one little girl at Quang's place and she can't even control her, let alone lead an army! Can't teach children how to train soldiers? Talking about this, I was afraid that what Quang said was true, so I gave a piece of evidence.

Like a real dragon, once it gets a drop of water, it can make it rain all over the world; Even if an earth dragon is soaked in water, it cannot escape the disaster of being buried!

Now send this article and previous drafts back so they don't get lost. Huu Trinh keeps her virginity, but still pays attention to medicine, worthy of being called a fool! Those actions of fear and concern for hunger and cold are all caused by the false mind of "enjoying blessings without knowing that they are blessed". If you think: Suppose we were born into a poor family, busy all year round with food and clothing but still found it difficult to satisfy our desires, would we not want to be human anymore?

Existence of selfishness and selfishness are not the same.

You ride a horse, I ride a donkey,

This is the poem's title for the painting Hanh Lac. In that painting, in the front is a person riding a horse, in the middle is a person riding a donkey, and in the back is a person pushing a cart. If Huu Trinh understands this idea, single-mindedly seeks rebirth in the West, will be cured of ignorance, and will develop right wisdom, then he is worthy to be called Hue Trinh. If not, it will become Si Trinh! If virginity is accompanied by ignorance, being born in the West is not easy! If you take this remedy, you will be very lucky!

As for his dream, it was his mind that appeared, and had nothing to do with Quang! Quang is an ordinary monk who only knows how to eat rice and porridge, so how can he appear in other people's dreams? Du Huu Phuong's doubts and what he said in the dream were consistent with what was written in the book Quang, that is, the Bodhisattva only taught him to have the right view. The sutra teaches: "Whatever incarnation one should manifest to save, immediately manifest that incarnation to preach the Dharma", mountains, rivers, trees, grass, bridges, wharves, roads, paths, people, horses, soldiers, generals, nothing can appear at will! If we say that it is not Bodhisattva's manifestation but it must be due to Light's manifestation, then mountains, rivers, trees, grass, bridges, wharfs, roads, alleys, people, horses, soldiers, and generals can also manifest dreams to people, is that reasonable? Don't be foolish enough to think it's Quang. If you foolishly think that Quang will become a "saint", then you and Quang will both be guilty of endless sins, remember!

His father's head shaking disease was a sign that he could not be cured, but by reciting Buddha's name, he could be cured. If you want him to be completely cured, there is a way. He, Hue Trinh and his wife, three people, sincerely chanted Quan Am to pray for help. If he is truly sincere, he will certainly be able to heal because father and son have an innate relationship. In the 10th year of the Republic of Korea (1921), Mr. Hoang Ham Chi and his wife became vegetarians. His eighty-one-year-old mother advised him to become a vegetarian, but he did not open his mouth. Serving vegetarian food, he did not swallow the food, only ate white rice. Quang taught them to repent on his mother's behalf. In less than a month, he became a vegetarian. Due to the innate connection, if one is sincere, one will certainly be touched by Buddhas and Bodhisattvas!

tieu_de: 78. Letter responding to layperson Trac Tri Lap
tom_tat: Humans and heaven and earth are called the Three Tai Tai, it is not a nonsense thing, but we must have contributed to participate and help the growth, then we will not be ashamed! noi_dung:
78. Letter responding to layperson Trac Tri Lap

Humans and heaven and earth are called the Three Tai Tai, it is not a nonsense thing, but we must have contributed to participate and help the growth, then we will not be ashamed! Otherwise, the flesh will go away and the body will run away, forever polluting heaven and earth. How can it be called Tam Tai? If you can grasp this idea and apply it to the teaching of children, you will be able to dedicate yourself and teach your talents, first using morality as the base, then literature as the tip. Always preach filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, shame, making them know the way of being human, raise their minds, move their thoughts, behave, and speak all pure goodness, forming the basis to be able to participate in the saints. The I Ching says: "If the butt is nourished properly, the saint's work will be wild" (teaching small children the right way, the merit [is equal to the merit] of a saint) is talking about this. If you can use this mind to teach others, your own education and virtue will become brighter and brighter, people will be inspired, without having to urge or reprimand them in the hope that they will follow. The world is not at peace, the husband has a responsibility. At present, the country is in chaos, the people are miserable, brothers of the same family are fighting and competing to destroy each other, the people cannot survive because their parents in the family are not well-taught, and the teachers in the school are not well-taught, to the point that those with talent get used to doing bad things, those without talent are willing to be stubborn enemies.

He kept his heart of "right origin, inner source" to do the work of cultivating talents, that is, having no position but holding power, not going to court to preach the Dharma, what could be more fun? As for reciting Buddha's name, are there any obstacles? Morning and afternoon, depending on strength. In addition, [at times] there is no need to use the mind, whenever it is convenient to recite, just have full sincere faith and earnest prayer and you will be reborn on your own. If you keep saying: "If you are busy plowing, it will be easy to recite Buddha's name", not knowing that when you are busy plowing, due to suffering, you will certainly not be able to recite. He thinks like that because he does not pay attention to self-reflection, it is the opinion of "standing on this mountain and seeing that mountain is higher", not the right wisdom to deeply understand the mind, to thoroughly understand the causes in the world. He should only "don't do evil things, keep good things" and use faith and prayer to recite the name to seek rebirth in the West. Using these things to practice yourself and teach others, even though you cannot achieve great things, you can also not be ashamed of being a human being, not ashamed of being a teacher, holding the heavens and trampling the earth!

Letter sent to layperson Ly Hue Trung discussing [handling] ashes to burn sutras and money for rebirth

(Year of the Republic 23 - 1934)

Although there is merit in burning [old and tattered] sutras, we do not dare to propose it, because there are many rough-minded people, and they often burn them mixed with votive paper ash. The votive paper ash is sold to an ash merchant. They will comb the paper ash to keep the tin pieces for sale. Is that no different from throwing the votive ash into the trash pile? Who would carefully use other objects to burn, then put the ashes in the river or sea? When Quang first became a monk, he saw [when the temple held a ceremony] releasing Mong Son119, burning a bank check, which included money for rebirth (Vang Sanh mantra was printed like a coin, so it was called Vang Sanh Tien). When burned, they burn it and hold it in their hands. When the fire burns to the point where their hands cannot hold it anymore, they throw it away, usually not completely burned, each sheet has many unburned words.

In the sixteenth year of Quang Tu's reign (1890), at Long Tuyen Pagoda in Beijing, in the morning, when he walked out of the temple door, he saw that in the pile of paper he had burned to send off the soul during the Diem Khau Release Ceremony at night, there was a stack of Vang Sanh money about two inches thick, only half burned. Quang picked it up and put it in the paper basket. If that ash is swept away by a servant, is it any different from being thrown in a pile of trash? Therefore, know that: No matter what method, people are needed

Mong Son Thi Thuc is a ritual of giving food to lonely souls. Mong Son now belongs to Danh Son district, Sichuan province. During the Song Dynasty, there was Master Real Estate living on this mountain, who was known to the world as Great Master Cam Lo. In order to offer sacrifices to lonely souls, the Master gathered the main points in the Yogacara Diem Khau ritual and the sutras on offering sacrifices to lonely souls in the Tantra Pitaka to compose the teachings of Mong Son Sacrifice. This ritual is often recited in pagodas in a simple way during the afternoon session, the offerings are usually just salted rice or porridge. In recent times, the magician Hung Tu proposed adding six additional teachings, so this new science of doubt was called Dai Mong Son Thi Thuc to distinguish it from the commonly used science of doubt of Mong Son. In Dai Mong Son Thi Thuc, you must set up an altar, worship a Buddha statue, display lots of incense, flowers, offerings, white rice, clear water, and invite a monk with good qualities to preach the Dharma. In front of the main altar, place the soul altar and worship the tablets of the spirits in the ten precepts. After offering incense, use a yellow cloth to wrap around the soul altar so that ghosts and spirits can gather there to worship, listen to the Dharma and eat food, without hindrance. The time for performing legal functions is usually between the hours of the Dog and the Pig.

Let your descendants cut off! In the end, there were those who believed and were not willing to let their parents become vegetarians. These exaggerated words are everywhere. use one thousand six or one thousand seven hundred dong to organize a Thuy Luc121 association at Bao Hoa Son, told Quang. If Quang approved of them making the Thuy Luc instrument, the two of them [each] would have to spend more than eight hundred dong, which is enough to see that the world's people mostly like bustling and ostentatious things, rather than sincerely praying for the deceased and saving lonely souls! Gold and silver paper should not be thrown away, but it is not certain how much should be burned. Need to know: This is something used to help lonely souls, but is not used by Buddhas, Bodhisattvas and people who are reborn. It is also thanks to the power of Buddha, the power of dharma, and the power of the mind that turns less into more. If everyone gets one leaflet, even if there are thousands, thousands of sheets, it will not be complete because the souls and ghosts are everywhere in space! tom_tat: Thuy Luc is a Dharma festival to give food to hungry ghosts as well as all living creatures on land and in water to save all ghosts. According to Thich Mon Chanh Thong, volume 4: "The name is Thuy Luc because of the meaning 'the fairies come to eat...
noi_dung:
Letter of introduction to use Tam Tinh soap made from vegetable fat

(Year of the Republic 18 - 1929)

Thuy Luc is a Dharma festival to give food to hungry ghosts as well as all living creatures on land and in water to save all ghosts. According to Thich Mon Chanh Thong, volume 4: "The name is Thuy Luc because of the meaning 'fairies come to eat in the water, ghosts come to eat on clean land".

The cause and effect of this dharma conference is because Tieu Dien (Emperor Luong Vu) dreamed of a monk teaching him to set up an association to popularize the worship of the spirits in the six realms and four realms of existence. The king then asked the monks to read all the scriptures, following the story of Anan meeting the demon Dien Nhien, establishing an equal food giving conference, and compiling a ritual. According to Buddha's Thong Ky, the first Water and Luc Dharma conference was held at Kim Son Pagoda in the fourth year of Thien Giam (505) of the Later Liang Dynasty. Later, this suspicion was lost. In the reign of Ham Thuan in the Tang Dynasty, the Dao Anh shaman of Phap Hai pagoda in Truong An was instructed by a stranger, found his doubts and organized and passed down this Dharma conference.

The recent massacre in this world [is truly] never heard of before; Considering the origin, most of it comes from killing and eating meat. If we want to save, if we don't promote cause and effect and retribution, making everyone develop the mindset of "people are like relatives, animals are just like us", abstain from killing and eat vegetarian food, there will be no way to achieve results! In addition to eating meat, anything that can lead to killing must be corrected. Like the killing of living beings due to the [processing] of soap, it is impossible to count all the numbers. Because only soap using [animal] fat can remove heat. Other fats do not have agglutination properties, or even though they have agglutination properties, they are all too expensive. Therefore, they all use beef fat to make it. Cows are animals that have great contributions to humans; Due to this, they were killed beyond measure, what a sad story!

A few years ago, layperson Chau Van Minh and a monk in Putuo invented a type of soap made from vegetable oil. Quang explained its origins and told the four groups of people, and was approved by almost all good believers. Unfortunately, the capital was not much, after only a few months it lost capital and had to be suspended. Later, the Nam Duong soap and candle factory added soap with vegetable oil. Due to high prices but low profits, it also stopped. Three or four years ago, Buddhists from far away often sent letters to Quang asking where they could buy them, wanting to buy them for use. There are also people who want to act as resellers. Quang often kept this story close to his heart, hoping that someone would develop the heart to "save lives and prevent killings" and make soap with vegetable fat to remove my secret worries, what luck would be better!

Last October, General Li (director) of China Industrial Chemical Society in Shanghai, Phuong Dich Tien, along with his mother and wife came to take refuge. Quang asked: "Do you make soap or not?" Answer: “Yes, I will!” Quang advised making soap using vegetable fats. He replied: "Yes", only saying: "Soap made from vegetable fat is quite expensive. If the price is high, people won't use it. Therefore, soap factories won't make it. If you obey the teacher, you will satisfy your wishes, but if you don't research many ways, it won't be possible. Between Spring and Summer next year, you will be able to make the product." In early March of this year, he came to see Quang and said: "For soap made from vegetable fat, the molds and containers are all well made, but the factory room is not enough for use. Currently under construction, it will be available for sale by mid-April." After hearing this, Quang couldn't help but feel happy.

Mencius said: "The person who makes arrows is only afraid of not being a merchant, but the man who makes arrows is only afraid of hurting others." It's the same thing as making a profit, but there's a big difference between compassion or cruelty, sin or blessing! I don't know how many lives this single action would have saved. It's true that "art wild children ton ho dao hi" (occupation is to increase the religion). I hope everyone in the same business as me uses this type of vegetable oil soap, then all the tallow soap factories will have to change to making vegetable oil soap so that everyone will take care of them. I will not change because the price of tallow soap is cheaper. Quang is old, his spirit is decreasing, his enemies are becoming more and more, after Thu will hide forever. Afraid that perhaps my fellow Buddhists in the provinces wouldn't know, I asked him to print out the price list so everyone would know.

tieu_de: 81. Letter to layperson Minh Quang
tom_tat: The Pure Land Dharma is the most ordinary but the most profound method in Buddhism. If one does not have enough wisdom in a previous life, it is truly difficult to have profound faith. Don't say Confucianism doesn't easily give rise to trust, even wise people...
noi_dung:
81. Letter to layperson Minh Quang

The Pure Land Dharma is the most ordinary but the most profound method in Buddhism. If one does not have enough wisdom in a previous life, it is truly difficult to have profound faith. Don't say that Confucianism is not easy to believe in, even intellectuals who are well-versed in Buddhism and Buddhism often rely on meanings in Buddhism and Buddhism to make inferences and judgments, so much so that the inconceivable dharma that "allows ordinary people who have not yet cut off their troubles to completely escape birth and death and enter sainthood right in the present life" not only refuse to practice it themselves but also refuse to teach others to practice it, because they do not know that this dharma is a special dharma in Buddhism, so they just take the meaning of the teachings. of Buddhism and Catholicism as the standard, that's why those mistakes were made. If they immediately knew this meaning at first, it would be of great benefit. Most intelligent people focus on "understanding the truth to enlighten the mind", not knowing that reciting Buddha's name is a shortcut to understanding the truth to enlighten the mind.

If you can recite the corresponding thoughts, you will understand the reason and enlighten the mind. Even though they haven't been able to do it yet, they rely on the Buddha's power to be reborn in the West. Compared to those who "understand the principles, realize the mind, but have not yet cut off the Troubles, they still continue to cycle through birth and death, with no time to escape", [the difference between] heaven and earth is not enough to compare the good and bad. What's more, once reborn, if you are close to Amitabha Buddha and the holy people, you will personally witness the Dharma of Non-Birth forbearance. How can you only understand the principle and enlighten the mind? The Pure Land Dharma is only truly benefited by those with superior ability and foolish husbands and foolish women, but those who are intelligent and knowledgeable in the sect are largely driven by great ambition and loud speech. They refuse to rely on the Buddha's magnetic power, but instead rely wholeheartedly on their own moral power, willing to let the foolish husband and foolish wife soon join the holy lineage! Perhaps in your village there is someone with such an opinion, so I will briefly explain the reason.

Since he wanted to take refuge, he now gave him the Dharma name Khe Quang. The Sanskrit word "Amitabha" is translated as Infinite Life, or also translated as Infinite Light. If you can recite Buddha's name single-mindedly, then you will take the Earthly Bodhisattva Fruit as the Core of the Earthly Mind. If the mind and mind can correspond, then the cause covers the ocean of effects, the result is the ultimate source of the cause, extremely ordinary but extremely magical. If you can believe and accept it, you are worthy of being called an eminent man. Quang, due to good karma, was born with eye disease, but luckily he was able to see the sky for more than seventy years. Now my eyes are extremely weak and I refuse to take on any hateful matters. Afraid that he would be swayed or persuaded by proponents of guidance from other sects, he especially summarized the two meanings, special and common, so as not to turn clever into clumsy, and the climb up would lead to downfall!

You should often look at the Five Pure Land Sutras and you will know that the Pure Land method is the method of Total Purification so that all Buddhas in the ten directions and three lifetimes can attain Buddhahood and transform sentient beings below. If you are still not convinced, you should often read the Pure Land Ten Essentials, all doubts will disappear, and the moon will shine with one mind. Although Van Sao's language is clumsy and simple, he has outlined a general overview of the causes of Zen and Pure Land, as well as things that are useful for morality in daily life, and can also help benefit oneself and others.

tieu_de: 82. Letter to layperson Tu Giac
tom_tat: Things in the world have a certain reason, but there is no certainty. You should use reason to decide things, use things to reason, so that it is in accordance with natural principles and human feelings. Mencius taught: "Men and women receive life without respect"122...
noi_dung:
82. Letter to layperson Tu Giac

(Year of the Republic 16 - 1927)

Things in the world have a certain reason, but there is no certainty. You should use reason to decide things, use things to reason, so that it is in accordance with natural principles and human feelings. Mencius taught: "Men and women receive life without their bodies as a ritual"122 (Men and women give and receive [things], do not touch each other, that is a ritual), [but also] said: "If a drowning sister-in-law does not save her, she is a wolf." At that time, of course, it is impossible to follow normal rituals to discuss! A filial child worships his parents without disobeying them. If parents develop poisonous boils, they must use needles, awls, knives, and scrapers to pry and cut them, and must use all their strength to squeeze out the pus until they see blood. This is also a place to show filial piety. If you are afraid of being desecrated or disobedient, your parents' lives will be over! But don't see people who do this to be considered filial, so that their parents don't get poisonous boils but still keep teasing and cutting like that, it will become a great disobedience, heaven will thunder and execute them.

A woman's menstruation is a problem for more than half of her life, occurring every few days, so why do she stop reciting Buddha's name? During normal times, one must be extremely clean and sincere. At that time, even though one's body cannot be completely clean, one should be even more sincere. Underwear must be padded with thick lining, so as not to let dirty blood flow into the Buddha hall. Whenever your hands touch the lower part of your body, you must wash it. If worshiping is not convenient, then worship less. As for reciting Buddha's name and chanting sutras, of course, using a sincere and respectful heart, the merit will not decrease compared to normal times. Because the Buddha is the great compassionate parent of all sentient beings, when that illness occurs, if we sincerely recite the Buddha's name, the Buddha will be even more compassionate!

Just like a fool is attached to the idea that "if the body is sick and unclean, it cannot recite Buddha's name", [so] if a child falls in the toilet, he cannot call his parents for help, perhaps that is good? People reciting Buddha's name should walk, stand, lie down, sit, and always think and remember. During normal times, in a clean place, or when your clothes and hat are neat, you can recite it out loud or silently. Only when sleeping, urinating, or bathing naked should you recite silently, not out loud. If you encounter an accident involving swords, water and fire, you should chant out loud in any place, in any state, because chanting out loud is more effective than chanting silently. If a woman gives birth to a child, she should recite it from the moment she gives birth until she goes into labor. Even though she is naked and unclean, she should still recite it out loud. At that time [is the time] related to life, like falling inside

This saying comes from the book Mencius, Thien Ly Number: "Men and women receive the same life, the ceremony is wild. The branch of the Tan Ninh courtyard is only for those who hold it, the power is wild." The book Four Books with Explanation explains: Men and women must follow the rules of respect and morality, and cannot directly touch objects with their hands, so that their skin does not touch each other, that is etiquette. But if the sister-in-law drowns and the brother-in-law saves her by using her hand to pull her up, that is the right to change.

Chau Thien is a term for Nei Dan in Taoism. In its original meaning, Chau Thien is the cyclical movement of heaven and earth. From this meaning, Translation scholars have assigned a number to each hexagram in the I Ching, called Chau Thien Number, for example, the Kun hexagram starts from the number 6, 6 times 6 is 36, that is the number of Yin. The Qian hexagram starts from the number 9, 6 times 9 equals 54, which is the number of Yang. From there, the Noi Dan scholars went further, saying that 9 and 6 combined to make 15 are the numbers of Nhat Khi (ie Yin and Yang unite). Therefore, they believe that the human body is a Small Heaven and Earth. An inhaled and exhaled breath is a cycle of Small Pearl Heaven like the circulation of Yin - Yang in the circle of heaven and earth. Breathing in and out 360 times is a Great Pearl. However, later, under the influence of Qigong, Dai Chau Thien and Tieu Chau Thien were understood differently. Dai Chau Thien and Tieu Chan Thien are the way to operate breathing along two channels: Nham and Doc, depending on the transportation path of Qi, it is called Dai or Tieu Chau Thien. Chau Thien Dai Dao was a popular Nei Dan sect in China at that time, pretending to be authentic Buddhism to attract followers. Because this fortune-telling spell was invented by later Taoists and attributed to Lao Tzu, Patriarch An Quang said "this spell is not Lao Tzu's".

Second Meditation is the second heaven in the Form Realm, the residence of those who have attained Second Meditation. First Thien Thien is the first heaven in the Realm of Color. This is the place where those who have attained First Zen after death are born, so they are called First Thien Thien. The gods in this heaven have left the evil things in the Desire Realm and are born to feel Joy and Bliss, so this heaven is also called the Land of Separation, Joy and Bliss. According to Cau Xa Luan, volume 8, volume 28 and Right Reasoning, volume 21, sentient beings in this heaven are divided into three types:

Great Brahma (Mahā-brahman): The residence of the Great Brahma King (Mahā-brahmaraja), the lord of this Saha world.

Brahma-pārisadya: The abode of all living beings governed and educated by the Great Brahma King.

Brahma-purohita: The ministers and guards of the Great Brahma King. According to the Long A Ham Sutra, volume 20, in addition to the three types of gods mentioned above, there is another type called Brahma-kāyika. Because this is the residence of those who practice pure conduct, it is also called Pham Gioi (pure realm) or Nhi Tinh Xu.

Tam Thien Thien is the third heaven in the Form Realm, also known as the Third Pure Land. Because the gods in this world are free from Joy in the Second Meditation but give birth to the concept of pure and wonderful Bliss, this heaven is also called the Land of Bliss and Wonderful Bliss, the thoughts corresponding to the two feelings of Bliss and Equanimity. This heaven consists of three small levels: Less Pure, Infinite Pure and Variable Pure.

The Four Zen Heavens (Caturdhyānabhūmi), also known as the Fourth Pure Heaven, the Fourth Pure Land, the Fourth Pure Land, the Pure Land of Birth, is the last heaven in the Form Realm, where those who attain the Four Zen are reborn after death. This heaven actually consists of eight small heavens: Vo Van Thien, Phuoc Sanh Thien, Quang Qua Thien, Vo Phien Thien, No Heat Thien, Thien Show Thien, Thien Kien Thien, Form Saves Wing Heaven. The consciousness of the gods in this world only corresponds to the two feelings of Being and Equanimity.

noi_dung:
88. Letter responding to layperson Luong Hue Dong

(Year of the Republic 21- 1932)

Man robe (patta), translated as Bat Tra, is one of the types of robes worn by the Sangha. “Man” means the robe is plain, without any fabric, meaning it does not consist of many small pieces of fabric sewn together. Normally, the Many Y is worn by novice monks and novice nuns, because they have not yet received full ordination and are not qualified to be an Offering Officer, so the robe is not cut into the shape of a field (blessed field of robe) like the robe of monks. In China, lay people also wear robes, but the robes are not clothed. Again, this type of robe leaves the whole fabric for sewing, only the edge of the robe, while the novice robe consists of two pieces of fabric sewn together, sewn into a stripe in the middle to distinguish it from the robes of monks and lay people. In the past, due to the narrow width of the fabric, sometimes the robe consisted of many small pieces of fabric (each piece was called a Thing) put together. As in the letter above, the Patriarch mentioned the type of Man robe consisting of five pieces for lay people, but to distinguish, those five pieces were of equal length, not cut into long pieces or short pieces sewn together like the robes of monks. Currently, except in some ashrams such as Fo Guang Shan, for example, lay people who have received the Five Precepts often wear robes when reciting, in other ashrams, only lay people who have received the Bodhisattva Precepts wear robes while reciting the precepts, not regularly during chanting sessions.

Nisīdana, often translated as Nun Su Dan, or Nun Dat Na, Ninh Su Na Nang, translated means husband's furniture, street furniture, sitting furniture, robe, reclining robe, etc. all mean things spread out on the ground for sitting or lying down with the purpose of avoiding insects from crawling up to bite and stinging the body, and to keep the three robes from getting dirty. Like the three robes, the sitting equipment only uses fading colors, that is, faded colors. The seat is usually sewn like a large blanket, using old fabric around the edges, sewn into two or three layers, or made from old robes. According to the law, the size of the seat is about 4 meters eight inches long and three meters six inches wide (Chinese measure). However, when Buddhism spread to South India, monks often used crouching tools to hang over their shoulders, such as when begging for alms or reciting the precepts. Monks in Sri Lanka and Thailand still hang them over their shoulders and then tie them with belts. When it was transmitted to China, the sitting instrument turned into a tool for worship. Before worshiping, the monk held the sitting instrument and held it up to the Buddha, bowed once, then unfolded the sitting instrument (called "zhan instrument"), placed it on the kneeling platform, finished worshiping, folded the sitting instrument again, raised it to the altar, and then squeezed it into his hand. Bach Truong Thanh Quy has very strict regulations on the ritual of "displaying tools" while worshiping, especially when performing major events such as Diem Khau, Thuy Luc, Trai Sang, and Transmission of Precepts. Here, the Patriarch intended to criticize the sitting instrument for being used for the wrong purpose, as well as advise Mr. Thai Tich Dinh not to be attached to necessarily wearing robes and paraphernalia while worshiping.

Pure Land Ten Essentials is the most important book in the Pure Land dharma. This edition adds several important books and essential essays. This is exactly what thousands of scriptures have discussed, everywhere pointing towards it. If I don't return here, I will definitely be like a poor child, not knowing my old hometown, not remembering my good father, doomed to drift in my hometown, wandering through the ditches. If you don't compare, don't discuss over and over again, just return with one mind, then you will know that your self-nature is inherently pure, is there any place to seek the appearance of returning and the appearance of purity? The ancients said: "There is no self-discipline, there is no return to convenience. In the past, the winds and moons of the past are fought over?" Original text "Common Buddha's Heart": Called that to distinguish it from Diligent Buddha's Heart. Diligent Buddha That means reciting Buddha for 24 hours. Anyone who is tired or exhausted can leave. When they feel better, they will join the crowd to recite Buddha's name again, but don't make excuses to avoid or be lazy. As for Universal Buddha That, the day is divided into six periods of reciting Buddha's name, with morning and evening sessions, and a set time for the masses to rest. When talking about Buddha That, we must celebrate Buddha's name for at least seven days (That means seven days, and does not mean a house or a lost room as in the word Entering That). If you only recite Buddha's name for a day or two, you cannot call it Buddha That! If it is only celebrated for three days or one day, the Chinese will call it Buddha three, or Buddha one, or just call Buddha Recitation Together.

No matter how many people the host invites, he still recites the Buddha's name as usual, just facing the Buddha, facing the tablet, and dedicating it three more times. Regardless of whether you pray or not, the chant is exactly the same. It's just that if you invite as many people as possible, you will receive merit from that many people! Currently, Buddha Recitation Hall has more than thirty people. If you lose your soul, you will make a paper tablet, which will be burned on the day the Buddha's death is complete. If you yourself set up a "long life and fortune" tablet, then make a wooden tablet and worship it permanently in the Buddha Recitation Hall, then add fifty dong. If you don't do it, each person will be charged ten dong. If fifteen people are one hundred and fifty dong; thirty people is three hundred dong. This is not because of Linh Nham that Buddha That is organized; but because his illness was serious, he did not hesitate to talk about this measure. Please encourage yourself, if you don't have the strength, don't force yourself!

Now I am sending you two books of the Five Pure Land Sutras, which you and your wife can receive and recite together, and can be used as sutras for regular recitation. Furthermore, last year Linh Nham underwent a major renovation. Now that the stele has been engraved and [the epitaph] has been drawn up, I'll send you a sheet. After reading it, you will know roughly about religious practice. What is the need to copy and collect what Quang arbitrarily said? Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc are enough to be models, why do we need to pray for more? As for the fake books of that pagan named X..., we should just ignore them and each follow our own path. If we join with those blind and eyeless people to argue black and white, how can they know that they are wrong? It will result in their own slander! For example, if a dog eats poop, it considers it delicious. If you tell him it's disgusting, he certainly won't believe it, and will criticize the person who just said it for not knowing whether it's good or bad! In today's life, people are completely in the dark, the higher their education, the more confused they become. In the past, Mr. Trinh and Mr. Chau were very broad and very high in education and character, but they strongly rejected the cause and effect of reincarnation, thinking that the Buddha used those stories to deceive foolish men and women! Those words are a great basis for promoting the destruction of filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame. Knowing this will make you even more focused on reciting Buddha's name and praying to be reborn in the West. Is today's educated person still worth talking about?

This is a tablet written "Buddhist Light blesses the benefactor, resolves the resentment, dedicates to transcending the resentment family" (Buddha Light watering, the tablet respects the benefactor... removes the resentment, dedicates the transcendence to the resentment family).

Recently, those who preach Avatamsaka and Dharma Forms mostly attack the Pure Land. Mr. He developed this great mind, which is quite rare, but it is not necessarily unmoved by the knowledge from the scriptures. If you are not converted, you are worthy of being called a true Buddhist. Once transferred, it will become easy to leave, difficult to choose, or like Mr. In the past, a shaman used Buddha's name to sell Ngu Huong beans149, used sutra preaching to open a bank, Buddha's name turned into rice mixed with sand, how could it be eaten? Therefore, know that: Without great good roots, you will not be able to deeply believe in this dharma! Telling him this is to make sure that before he takes a step, he knows for sure [the direction] of the compass. If not, you can pretend to be a great scholar, fearing that it will be difficult to reach the end of life and death. Reciting Amitabha can also be a refuge, reciting Quan Am can also be reborn in the West. As long as you keep your sincerity, you will be inspired. Why are you thinking so narrowly? Avalokiteshvara is the Dharma Prince of Amitabha Buddha. Assisting Amitabha Buddha in saving sentient beings is a matter within the same family, not that each temple is different!

tieu_de: 93. Letter responding to layperson Trinh Hue Hong
tom_tat: Nowadays, the world's religion is in decline. Practicing at home is better. There are many obstacles to becoming a monk. Children should not give birth to the idea of ​​becoming a monk. noi_dung:
93. Letter responding to layperson Trinh Hue Hong

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

Nowadays, the world's religion is in decline. Practicing at home is better. There are many obstacles to becoming a monk. Children should not give birth to the idea of ​​becoming a monk. In this life of the Tragedy, our ancestors did not know how to recite Buddha's name single-mindedly and seek rebirth in the West. They were foolish and wanted to practice Zen to clear their minds and realize their nature. Should know:

Five Fragrant Beans are a famous snack of South China, the most famous being the Five Fragrant Beans at Thanh Hoang Temple, Shanghai. This dish uses beans soaked in anise, cinnamon, salt, sugar, and some other flavors and then fried in butter.

What he is greedy for is not Zen but the written knowledge and knowledge. Even if he is greedy until he is old, it has nothing to do with Zen! Even if you can gain the benefit of truly enlightening your mind and seeing your nature through meditation, you are still very far from birth and death. Because, afflictions Or karma has not been stopped, enlightenment is enlightenment, birth and death are still birth and death. If it is said that by clearly understanding one's mind and seeing one's nature, one can immediately achieve no birth and death, then that is the mistaken admission of the man standing outside the door and the Zen fanatic! But in the present time, who is the one who understands the mind and sees the nature?

Pure Land Dharma completely relies on Buddha's power. Look carefully at Gia Ngon Luc and Van Sao. If you practice accordingly, you will definitely be able to be reborn in the West. Last fall, the Pure Land Ten Essentials series was printed; This is the most important book of the Pure Land dharma. At the end of the year, when the book "Buddhism Saves Kien Bien" was printed, [the printing house] still hadn't sent it. Wait until they do, they will send you a few packages. Practicing accordingly is even more stable and appropriate than being close to good knowledge. If you don't self-evaluate and go and interview all the great people in the Giang - Zhet region, it is very likely that in the end that belief will be destroyed by the high people, then Zen will become hopeless. Tinh does not believe, his future is unclear, where can he head?

Those who want to be close to good intellectuals today must first know the reasons for Zen and Purity. Otherwise, ten out of eight or nine people will have good knowledge destroy their Pure Land good roots and still be satisfied with humanity, thinking they have attained the Dharma, what a sad and lamentable thing! This year

Quang decided not to leave the customs. Next year, if the four mountain wills of Thanh Luong, Nga Mi, Cuu Hoa150, and Linh Nham have been completed, they will find a place where no one knows to live out their excess years. Please tell your parents these words, and moreover, actively teach your children, don't pamper them too much, making them accustomed to arrogance.

Jiuhua Mountain is located in the southwest of Qingyang district, Anhui province, occupying a very large area. The mountain was originally named Cuu Tu Son because this mountain range consists of nine peaks, looking from afar like nine children arranged in a circle leaning against each other to play. When Ly Bach went to visit this mountain, he felt that the nine mountains looked like nine lotus flowers floating in the clouds, so he wrote:

"At the top of Cuu Giang, longing for the Nine Flowers, the galaxy is over the green water, the stars are flowing in the nine rivers" (Once upon a time surfing the waves of the Cuu Giang, looking up at the nine distant mountains of flowers, the river sky and blue water, the nine-flowered pink lotus showed off its freshness). Therefore, the mountain was called Cuu Hoa from then on. From the fifth year of Long An (401) of the Eastern Jin Dynasty, monk Boi Do built the first pagoda here. Later, it is unclear in what year, Prince Kim Kieu Giac of Silla (one of the three ancient kingdoms of Korea), Kim Kieu Giac, came to retreat to this mountain. At the beginning of the reign of Chi Duc (756), Gia Cat Tiet came here, admired the virtue of Kim Kieu Giac and built a pagoda to make offerings. In the 19th year of Trinh Nguyen (803) of the Tang Dynasty, Kim Kieu Giac passed away at the age of 99, revealing his identity as the reincarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. From then on, Cuu Hoa became the ashram of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

tieu_de: 94. Letter to layperson Trieu Phung Chi
tom_tat: Yesterday, I received a letter from Mr. Truong Van Ly saying that the lay people have been reciting the Buddha's name quite urgently recently, but they still regret not being able to meet Bat Hue. Ignorance is the karma of ordinary people. Even if you encounter it, it will be useless. If you accept it according to Gia Ngon...
noi_dung:
94. Letter to layperson Trieu Phung Chi

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

Yesterday, I received a letter from Mr. Truong Van Ly saying that the lay people have been reciting the Buddha's name quite urgently recently, but they still regret not being able to meet Bat Hue. Non-Hue is the karma of ordinary people, even if we meet it, it will be useless. Following Gia Ngon Luc's practice will be much better than meeting face to face. Now sending to lay people Van Sao, [Pure Land] Ten Essentials, Thanh Hien Luc, one book each, Tan Luong Chung Strength, Chanh Tin Luc, one book each. If you have these books, you can practice on your own and teach others! A sixty-seven year old person does not need to study other scriptures, he should only recite Buddha's name single-mindedly to seek rebirth in the West, then he can rely on the Buddha's magnetic power to overcome his karma and be reborn. All other methods rely on self-reliance to attain the Truth in order to escape birth and death; The method of reciting the Buddha's name only requires full faith and prayer to be reborn in the Pure Land. The difficulty and ease between them is like heaven and abyss!

Please practice earnestly, and please make sure your relatives and friends share the same thoughts. Based on Can Chung Tan Luong, let's talk about the benefits of supporting recitation at the time of death, and the harm caused by destroying [mindfulness], making them all familiar with the recitation and hearing, so that when he is about to die, everyone can support him. Otherwise, everyone will definitely destroy [his mindfulness]. Quang is old, his vision is too weak; There are also three pressing Son Chi sets that cannot be delayed. Since the beginning of the month, I have refused everything, from now on I will not send any more letters. Van Sao is an introductory book to the Pure Land, Ten Essentials is a very profound and practical book, [Pure Land] Thanh Hien Luc is a shining example set by the ancients. If you have those books, what is lacking that requires you to use a letter to ask about the Dharma?

tieu_de: 95. Letter to layperson Tran Hue Cung
tom_tat: His wife had made up her mind to take refuge, and now gave her the Dharma name Hue Nha; Courtesy is right.
