noi_dung:
95. Letter to layperson Tran Hue Cung

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

His wife had made up her mind to take refuge, and now gave her the Dharma name Hue Nha; Courtesy is right. Being able to recite the Buddha's name single-mindedly without giving birth to false thoughts of blessings and retributions to heaven and earth in the next life is true wisdom based on Buddha's wisdom, so it is called Hue Nha. The third daughter's name is Phung Xuan, her dharma name is Tong Trinh; Tong is the master, Trinh (貞) is the chief. Spring is at the top of the year, Trinh is the end of Can Duc (the virtue of the Can hexagram). [In the I Ching, the section explaining] the Qian hexagram reads: "Can, yuan, hanh, benefit, virgin". Confucius explained: "If virginity is false, everything is impure" (Virgin is the core of things). This word Trinh has a wide and deep meaning, not just [meaning] a girl who maintains her body is a Trinh! All people, if all their actions are in general conformity, are called Trinh. If Phung Xuan can do his best to fulfill his duty, using the eight words "filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, politeness, righteousness, integrity, shame" to help his husband teach his children so that both husband and children can become good and good, then it will be true to the true meaning of the word Tong Trinh, it will be suitable for Spring as the first season of the year, it will be consistent with the virtue of Trinh of the Can hexagram, to become a model teacher for women, a mother who is proud of the miserable place, how glorious to describe her. okay? Please think wisely and tell her so!

tieu_de: 96. Letter responding to layperson Truong Thuan Nhat
tom_tat: Husband and wife command 151 Tran Don Phuc to practice filial piety and benevolence, and can wholeheartedly believe in Buddhism and cultivate pure karma, truly rare people in this life. Now that they want to take refuge and receive the Five Precepts, they must clearly understand the sect...
noi_dung:
96. Letter responding to layperson Truong Thuan Nhat

Husband and wife command 151 Tran Don Phuc to practice filial piety and benevolence, and can wholeheartedly believe in Buddhism and cultivate pure karma, truly rare people in this life. Now, if they want to take refuge and receive the Five Precepts, they must clearly understand the principles of the Pure Land dharma, so that they can escape birth and death and become saints in this very life. You must know: The Pure Land Dharma takes the faith and vow to recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West as its guiding principle. Ordinary people think this is a trivial matter, nothing strange, so they consider the meditation method in Zen to be the superior one, focusing on enlightenment, not focusing on faith and prayer for rebirth. The fancy name is Zen Pure Song Tu, but in essence it is completely no Zen, no Pure Land!

Why say that? Because we do not reach great enlightenment, we cannot call it "having Zen". Who is practicing Zen today who has truly reached the state of great enlightenment? Due to the focus on research, the solemnity of Western robes and reports are all placed on one's own mind, without the slightest notion of faith and prayer for rebirth. Although it is called chanting Buddha's name, it is actually against the religion of chanting Buddha's name! Or to say it in a lofty way is "reciting the True Form of the Buddha". Although the True Form is the root of all dharmas, how can ordinary people with heavy karma reach it? It seems like "referring to Buddhism" (attributing everything to Zen), but Zen can't rely on it, and Tinh can't rely on it either! Relying on self-reliance, even if one reaches the state of great enlightenment,

The call shows respect for others.

But because karma has not been cut off, it will not be possible to end birth and death! If you haven't reached the level of great enlightenment [great enlightenment], then there's no need to discuss it! Relying on Buddha's power, you only need to have full sincere faith, earnest prayer, and recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West. Due to insisting on Western Pure Land, Infinite Life, Infinite Light, everything is attributed to the self-mind, but the self-mind is only attached to the name, has not yet realized the truth, [so] the Buddha in the West because he does not feel will not be able to have the response, the Buddha in the self-mind is still in the cause, so he has no majestic virtue!

Those who want to be high and far away in the ordinary world often become clumsy, seek promotion and fall, but intellectuals who want to be praised by others as perfect, still refuse to say so, to the point that the Tathagata, out of great compassion, wants to make all living beings end birth and death in this life, but they are still the same as before and cannot be finished! This life is impossible, but in the future we may be able to do so, but we still have to reincarnate in the six paths more than the number from one mortal life to another. If you truly understand this benefit and harm, and carefully look at the Pure Land scriptures, you will know that this method of reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West cannot be surpassed by anything great. All the Buddhas in the ten directions and three generations have achieved Buddhahood, and below, there is no one who does not help but rely on this method to achieve success at the beginning and at the end!

Now, the dharma name given to Don Phuc is Hue Phuc, which means using the Pure Land dharma taught from the Buddha's wisdom to practice and teach others, so that everyone can restore their existing mind. His wife is Trinh Ham Chuong, whose dharma name is Hue Chuong, which means relying on the Pure Land dharma taught by the Buddha to practice on her own, teach others, and also educate her children and all women so that the teachings of two ladies Phi, three ladies Thai, and Vy De Hy are brilliantly illuminated in the present life. Therefore, the name is Hue Chuong. I often say: "Women hold more than half of the power to rule the country and bring peace to the world." That's because if a mother is kind, her children will be kind. In the womb, they will inherit the mother's temperament. When they are young, they will look at their mother's behavior and listen to their mother's words. They will be trained before going to school. When they go to school, they will try their best to apply each of those things to their behavior, so they are sages and good people. He said: "Teaching children is the foundation to rule the world, but teaching daughters is even more important!" Because there is no wise woman, there will be no good wife or mother; Therefore there are no sages either!

Now I not only teach the Pure Land dharma but also discuss this widely, because I hope everyone will know how to pay attention to their duties. Once this root is established, all worldly and extra-worldly principles are restored and clearly displayed. Now I send them two bags of Pure Land scriptures, please read them carefully. Of course, Quang does not need to say much about the benefits of practicing this method. Regardless of whether you have received the Five Precepts or not, you must strictly observe them, because the first four, i.e. Killing, Dao, Lust, and Vulture, are called Nature Precepts, meaning that if you do not hear the names of these four precepts, if you violate them, you will still be guilty of sin, but if you receive the precepts and continue to violate them, you will become a two-level [sin]. In addition to the crime that has already been committed, there is also the sin of breaking the precepts. Therefore, it is said: "Everyone should keep it strictly." Drinking alcohol is called Gia Precept (precepts have the effect of covering up). If you have not yet received the precepts, if you drink, you will not commit a sin. If you still drink after accepting the precepts, you will only be guilty of breaking the precepts. Please consider wisely and give this letter to their spouses to read.

Such as Nam Ngu Dai Son, Dai Huong Son in Shaanxi, Thien Truc Son in Zhejiang, etc. are places of clear inspiration, bustling incense and lights, but only Nam Hai Pho Tuo Son is truly the best because the name of this place is recorded in the Avatamsaka Sutra, year In the past, Thien Tai personally studied [here]". Hien Thang", why do you consider Samantabhadra Samantabhadra to be Bodhisattva Bodhisattva? Without knowing Samantabhadra's virtues, any place can be an ashram; therefore, regardless of whether the sutra clearly states or not [it says that a certain place is not a Bodhisattva's ashram]. If you stubbornly misquote the sutra, it will become a slander of the sutra. This is not arousing right faith but arousing wrong views in others, because of this they will doubt the sutra. So holy!

Please carefully read the original text of the preface, all doubts will be resolved by themselves. If you think it's not right, it's up to you to decide what you think, Quang won't ask anymore! Quang is old, his spiritual and mental strength are not enough, since November last winter, he has repeatedly published in semi-monthly newspapers such as Tan Than, etc., refusing all correspondence and asking for writing. From now on, please do not send any more letters. If you send them, you will definitely not reply.

tieu_de: 98. Letter responding to Australian layperson Tri Lang
tom_tat: The proverb says: "Rich men do not know the suffering of poor people, rich men do not know the suffering of old people" (Rich men do not know the suffering of the poor, healthy people do not know the suffering of the elderly). He thought that Quang's refusal was just to...
noi_dung:
98. Letter responding to Australian layperson Tri Lang

The proverb says: "Rich men do not know the suffering of poor people, rich men do not know the suffering of old people" (Rich men do not know the suffering of the poor, healthy people do not know the suffering of the elderly). Do you think that Quang's refusal was just to purify himself? He didn't know it was actually because both his spiritual and mental strength were not enough. Just reading the letters he sent and left to his relatives, three hundred Bodhisattvas, often lived there, preaching the Dharma. In the South, there is a place called Thang Phong Son, from ancient times until now, Bodhisattvas have lived there. Currently, there is a Bodhisattva named Phap Hue along with his relatives, Bodhisattvas who often live there and preach the Dharma... In the Northeast, there is a place called Thanh Luong Mountain, from ancient times to the present, Bodhisattvas have lived there. Currently, there is a Bodhisattva named Manjushri and his relatives, Bodhisattvas, including ten thousand people, who often live there, preaching Dharma... In the southwest, there is a place called Quang Minh Mountain, from ancient times to the present, Bodhisattvas live there. Currently, there is a Bodhisattva named Hien Thang and his relatives who are Bodhisattvas including three thousand people who often live there, preaching the Dharma.

Mr. Tu Vinh Nghiep accepts that the Southwest direction mentioned in the passage quoted above is the Southwest direction of China because in the scriptures it is said that in the Northeast direction there is Thanh Luong Son ashram of Mr. Manjushri (Wutai Mountain is located in the Northeast of China and is also called Thanh Luong). Because Nga Mi is located in the southwest of China, Mr. Tu accepted that Bodhisattva Hien Thang was Samantabhadra!

When writing a reply, you have to use both eyeglasses and hand-held glasses (magnifying glass) to see and write! The paper was so blindingly white that no words could be written. Samadhi of Buddha's name is not easy to achieve. If you are not self-reliant, you are likely to be influenced by demons. You must know: Rebirth in the Pure Land depends entirely on faith and prayer. If you have faith and vows, even if you have not yet attained samadhi, have not yet achieved one mind without confusion, you can still be reborn. Don't just take a single, undisturbed mind and achieve Buddha-recitation samadhi as your ambition and career, and then not devote yourself to faith, vows and pure recitation (reciting all six senses is

"pure mindfulness". When reciting Buddha's name, you often hear the sound of your own Buddha's name, which is the place to practice "taking in all six senses". Please pay attention). I'm afraid that if you have great ambition and speak loudly, you won't get real benefits because you won't pay attention to your faith and vows, won't be able to connect with the Buddha, and will still be a miserable being in this evil world of the Five Defilements!

Regarding Mr. Ngan Ich's Canh Sach155, as you said, we should ask someone to write beautiful handwriting in large, neat, careful letters, hang it on the wall in the yard to evoke the faith of everyone, that is really important. As for the fact that you asked to compose another Canh Sach article, aren't the things said in Van Sao worthy of being used as Canh Sach? The current times are extremely dangerous, we should advise everyone young and old in the house to recite namo Amitabha Buddha and namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva as a backup plan. Otherwise, when disaster strikes, you won't be able to escape, you won't be able to take precautions, so what can you do? You should speak this word to all who have understanding, so that those who hear it may sow good roots in the world. Don't send any more letters in the future. All the writing of the preface, the afterword, and the lies are all in one go and cannot be repeated!

tieu_de: 99. Letter responding to layperson Tieu Truong You in Kunming
tom_tat: Why are Feng Shui156's words worth taking as a basis? If it's true as they say, rich people will always be rich. Is it common to see children from noble families starve to death? The most powerful person in the realm
noi_dung:
99. Letter responding to layperson Tieu Truong You in Kunming

Why are Feng Shui156's words worth taking as a basis? If it's true as they say, rich people will always be rich. Is it common to see children from noble families starve to death? The most powerful person in the world

That is, the article "The Origin of Diseases" by Mr. Ngai Ich in Linh Phong Tong Luan.

Original text "Kham Du", Kham means to search, observe, Du means carriage, implying transportation, traveling throughout the territory. In a narrow sense, the word Du refers to the compass used in Feng Shui. Therefore, Kham Du means observing the land's appearance and using a compass to measure the land's orientation. Kham Du Thuat is another name for Feng Shui.

To choose good land and a good place to build a house, who is better than the emperor? Why do emperors often live short lives? From the Han Dynasty until now, no dynasty has existed for more than four hundred years. Poor people are full of suffering, but they want a good place to live and a good grave but can't get it. That's because they want to avoid suffering and create their own ways to suffer even more deeply! He only kept a good heart, spoke good words, did good deeds, single-mindedly recited Buddha's name, advised people one after another, following a Letter Sent Everywhere to encourage, then hidden karma was eliminated and good roots grew. Is it better for Quang to repent for you? Is it better to repent yourself if you run out of devotion and repentance yourself?

People who are about to die really need chanting support; People about to give birth also need to tell the mother to recite Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, and the caregivers nearby also loudly support the recitation, then surely they will not encounter difficult and painful births. Even if she is having difficulty giving birth and is about to die, teach the pregnant woman to recite to herself and the whole family or another place in the birthing room to recite together, and it will not take long before she will give birth peacefully. He wanted to turn misfortune into blessing, so he brought the stories in this A Letter to Everyone and told everyone that, compared to repairing houses and moving ancestral graves, they would be beneficial and not harmful. People in this world don't pray for a field of blessings in their hearts, they just pray for a field of blessings in the external environment, often burying their heavenly goodness to conspire to take away the good houses and lands of others, to the point that the family is destroyed, the dead, the descendants are extinct, all because they are bewitched by Feng Shui masters!

If the Feng Shui master knows that both misfortune and blessing are created by the mind, but also changed by the mind, [Feng Shui] will become a useful framework for life. Moreover, each Feng Shui expert has a different opinion. Although with the views of the ancients, people today may not completely agree, because they want to show that they have superior knowledge, but in fact, most of the time it is the intention of a petty person, wanting to rely on it to lie and steal reputation! Try looking at Feng Shui houses to see if anyone is very prosperous or not? They can plan for others, why not plan for themselves? Quang is old and his vision is extremely weak. From now on, don't send letters anymore. If you send them, you will definitely not reply!

tieu_de: 100. Letter responding to layperson Hoang Tung Binh in Tuong Am
tom_tat: Quang is a monk who only knows how to eat rice and porridge, always simple, never willing to praise others, and never expect others to praise himself. I don't want to... the first page of your essay...
noi_dung:
100. Letter responding to layperson Hoang Tung Binh in Tuong Am

Quang is a monk who only knows how to eat rice and porridge, always simple, never willing to praise others, and never expect others to praise himself. I don't want to hear the first page of your essay, because I don't have that status, so what could be more humiliating? Sickness is born from the body, the body is born from karma, you should repent even more painfully to eliminate karma. You must also abstain from eating and sleeping so that the disease will not get worse. No matter what illness you have, if you don't abstain from eating and sleeping, it will definitely be difficult to heal! Confucius said: "Parents only worry about that disability" (Parents only worry about that disability157) because sexual relations are the basis of all diseases. When your body is sick, why do you have to go to Ju Si Lam to follow the crowd to recite Buddha's name? It's best to just stay at home and meditate!

As for studying Buddhist principles with good intellectuals, while the body is seriously ill, one should only strive to practice with sincerity, reciting Buddha's name and reciting Quan Yin. At this time, you should not study, if you study a sutra it will become discursive. For example, if you are sick and receive a spirit pill, immediately take it attentively. Don't you first have to research what medicine this spirit pill is made of, what medicine goes into which meridians, and what disease it treats? Do you all hope to understand each thing clearly before taking the medicine? You don't know the reason for studying Explanation and Studying Practice, so you don't get real benefits!

The lists of pagans list hundreds and thousands, but if we consider their uses, they are generally nothing more than alchemy and luck! Even though they teach others to recite Buddha's sutras, it's all a superficial show off. Of course, they don't consider it a religion. If they want to attain their religion, they must be extremely urgent. At night, they go alone into the room, close the door and windows, and set up patrols outside, only allowing one person to enter the room. First, we must cast an extremely evil and tragic curse: If we cause harm to their sect, we will definitely receive such tragic consequences. After swearing alone, the person will be pointed at acupuncture points, either on the head, on the face, or in the body. If it is an acupuncture point in the body, you must remove your outer shirt and your underwear must be lifted up to show the point. In fact, such methods are all traps to deceive people, but all non-Buddhists [claim] that once a new person [commits to the religion] is initiated into the religion, "they will still be successful without cultivating!" If you leave secretly, teach it clearly to others, without giving a curse, give it away

Normally, the word "Disability" here is often understood by commentators to mean bad habits such as not keeping morality and decency; The Patriarch's own explanation of the word "Disability" here is to mean excessive sexual indulgence. The Patriarch explained this meaning very clearly in letter 141, the letter sent to lay people reciting the Buddha's name.

If others follow the religion by heart and abandon it, then the pagan religion will have no basis to exist!

There is no secret private teaching of Buddhism, nor does it force people to swear. If you believe, then practice accordingly; if you don't believe, then let that person go. He recited the Buddha's name but still wanted to join a pagan religion, meaning he was completely unaware of Buddhism and the right and wrong pagan religions. He only had faith based on others, which was not true faith. If you have true faith, you should just devote yourself to cultivating, why do you have to worry about the large number of non-Buddhists falling into the trap? If you have a serious illness due to bad karma, you should become a vegetarian and recite Buddha's name, and do something to save the previous generation's resentment. When it comes to transcendence, there is no need to invite the Sangha to do Buddhist work, just earnestly chant Buddha's name and Quan Yin's name yourself. Furthermore, don't ask: "Can just reciting a Buddha or a Bodhisattva be cured?" You must know: Reciting the Buddha's name is the most direct, quickest and most complete Dharma in Buddhism, its benefits surpass all Dharma methods! It is only the sincerity of the mind that makes the difference, not whether the Buddha Dharma is effective or not?

noi_dung:
101. Letter to layperson Truong Tinh Giang

(Year of the Republic 24 - 1935)

I've heard lay people reciting Buddha's name for a long time. I wonder if they pay attention to their faith and pray to be reborn in the West? In Buddhism, the methods are immeasurable, regardless of Great, Small, Powerful, True, all methods must use Precepts - Concentration - Hue to cut off greed - anger - delusion until all is left, only then can one be free from birth and death. This is as difficult as reaching heaven, it is not something ordinary people like us who are on the ground, full of obstacles and troubles, can hope to achieve. If you use sincere faith, earnestly pray, and pray to be reborn in the West, then regardless of whether your efforts are shallow or deep, whether your merit is great or small, you can rely on the Buddha's power to be reborn in the West. This is like sitting on a big ship crossing the sea, only by getting on the ship can you reach the other shore, it is thanks to the ship's power, not your own ability. The belief in reciting the Buddha's name and praying for rebirth in the West is the same, it is entirely Buddha's power, not one's own moral power.

As long as one is born in the West, birth and death are finished, afflictions do not arise. It is like a person who has been practicing in that place for a long time and has completely eliminated the afflictions and afflictions of birth and death. Therefore, reciting Buddha's name and deciding to pray to be born in the West

Phuong, you should not pray for blessings from heaven and people in the next life. You should not rely on those who leave their faith and vows and instruct others to recite Buddha's name and seek enlightenment. Reciting the Buddha's name is essentially taking in all six senses. While reciting the Buddha's name, listen carefully with your ears, that is the way to meditate on the six senses. Being able to listen carefully with one's heart and mind, the merit compared to "not listening, scattering thoughts" is very different. This Dharma can be used by people of high, middle, or low ability, and will benefit everyone. It is only beneficial, not bad. You should tell everyone who practices to practice according to this. I originally wanted to explain it in detail, but due to lack of time and fear of delaying his return, I only wrote a summary of the important meanings. Other things have been said thoroughly in Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc. Once you read it, you will know it all yourself.

102. Letter replying to Mr. Ly Thinh Dao in Hai Mon (seven letters)

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

Through the letter sent by Tran Hue Suong, we know that he is not yet in his teens, but quite faithful, chanting several volumes of the Diamond Sutra every day to repent and complete his karma, which is truly a great event in a person's life. But it needs to be sincere and respectful. If it's like the way he scribbles, the benefits that follow a frivolous mind will be greatly reduced. He wanted to take refuge again, and now gave him the Dharma name Hue Tai. His original name is Thong Tai. He is both intelligent and talented. If used properly, he can hope to become a saint, become a sage, and create merit and career; If used improperly, you will mistake yourself, wrong people, and fall into the three evil realms! Natural disasters and man-made disasters in modern times are mostly created by intelligent and talented people. If through wisdom, you can distinguish between evil and right, clearly understand cause and effect, follow the good, avoid the evil, you will become talented and attain virtue. If you have wisdom, talent will help the religion. Without wisdom, talent will go against virtue. Therefore, he was named Hue Tai.

You should look at the name and think of its meaning. While starting to think, you should often consider whether it is compatible with wisdom or not. If it matches, expand it. If it doesn't, destroy it immediately and don't let it sprout again! You must also maintain moral ethics, fulfill all duties, put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, keep good things, believe in reciting Buddha's name, and pray to be reborn in the West. Use these things to practice yourself and also teach others. The person who can do so is a true disciple of Buddha. What's more, at this time of trouble, everyone in the family, parents, brothers, sisters, wives, children, and servants, in addition to relatives, friends, and everyone they know, should advise them to often recite the holy name of Amitabha Buddha and Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva as a basis to "turn into peace in the face of danger, turn into good in the face of evil" in the present, to make a way so that in the future when their lifespan ends, they will forever leave the sea of suffering. birth and death. The method of reciting and its benefits are not easy to explain in detail in a moment.

I told Hue Suong to send Mr. Gia Ngon Luc and appropriate books, read them and you will know for yourself. If you want to truly benefit from Buddhism, you must practice it with utmost sincerity. Although reciting sutras and reciting Buddha's name are similar, the sincerity is different whether it is deep or shallow, frivolous or passionate, so the benefits are even greater! Everything in the world must be accomplished through sincerity, let alone reciting sutras, reciting Buddha's name, and wanting to use an ordinary human body to escape birth and death and ascend to the Buddha realm, but is it possible without sincerity?

Monks only focus on practice, why do they need to show off or take excessive pictures? Quang always did not like taking pictures. Recently, in the Phat Hoa San newspaper of the Hong Kong Buddhist Hoc Hoc Association, there was a photo of Quang published. A disciple sent him ten copies. Now he has sent him one. Furthermore, in the past, Mr. Truong Thuy Tang, who engraved and printed the Medicine Sutra in Yangzhou, sent him a package. Now he sent him five copies. Except for one copy he keeps for himself, the other four copies are given to those who seek refuge. Their "incense respect" money has been received in full.

You should tell them: Having taken refuge in Buddhism, follow the Pure Land method in Buddhism to practice, do not add to the methods of alchemy, fortune telling, etc. of pagans. This Dharma benefits most easily by relying on Buddha's power. In addition, [other dharmas] all rely on self-reliance, so they are as different from this dharma as the heavens and the abyss. Refining pills is a method to protect the body and energy, not a method to escape birth and death! Even the methods of meditation, studying teachings, and Tantra are not fundamental methods. If the Dharma does not work, it is like the wrong medicine for the disease. Only the Pure Land Dharma is suitable for all the three spiritual capacities (superior, medium, inferior), upper - middle - lower. Whether ordinary or holy, you should practice it. You should not listen to the sublime Zen and Esoteric Buddhism, then abandon this method and practice the other method, to the point that there will never be a day when you will never be able to escape birth and death!

Currently, we are in a difficult situation, no matter who we are, we should recite Buddha's name and Avalokiteshvara's name as a precaution. No matter the dangers such as swordsmen, water, fire, pestilence, pestilence, severe illness, family resentment, confrontation, etc., with sincere thoughts, it is certainly not impossible to overcome! Even when women give birth, they should even more sincerely recite the holy name of Avalokiteśvara clearly to ensure there is no suffering. At that time, you should not chant silently in your mind because you are using force to push the child out. If you chant silently, you may get sick, very important! Even though it was extremely difficult to give birth, even if you were about to lose your life, you could immediately give birth peacefully. You must know: If you accept the concept from a young age, there will be no difficulty in giving birth. Even though birth is not difficult, mindfulness still has great benefits. Don't dare to recite because you are naked and impure, or you will lose your benefits or suffer pain, or even both mother and child will die! The pregnant woman herself recites, the caregivers nearby also recite, and family members in other places can also recite for the pregnant woman. If everyone knew this, the world would not have difficult births and deaths from childbirth.

Mr. Liu Onfu is seventy-four years old, you should put down your whole body, single-mindedly recite Buddha's name, and pray to be born in the West. If not, if we make a mistake and miss it, I don't know how long it will take to encounter this method? Although other people are not too old, their lives are impermanent, and it is unlikely that they will live until old age before they die! See other things in the long letter, not detailed here. I hope everyone practices it and good luck!

Although there are many people with faith in this noble land, I am afraid that they may not truly practice Buddhism. You should tell them the difference between Buddhism and paganism. Outsiders focus on esoteric teachings, using alchemy and luck, and absolutely do not focus on maintaining morality and fulfilling all duties. There is also the story of "puu co giang len" (coi-coi prayer), although it also advises people to do good, but in the end it is a ghost spirit masquerading as an immortal or Buddha. If you don't understand the principles and mistakenly think that a true immortal or a true Buddha is descending on the altar, that is a big mistake. It's not that there hasn't been a single time when a true immortal has come down to the altar, but it's still rare to have one chance in a thousand times!

At the end of the Ming dynasty, Bodhisattva Giac Minh Dieu Hanh used his pen to teach Buddha Dharma. When he left, he taught [the masses] to give up praying for luck forever! Ten years ago, at Da Da Buddha Study Society in Hong Kong [Da Da Ha Bodhisattva's altar] was similar. These two are both true Bodhisattvas, but they are both forbidden to seek fortune, because ghosts and ghosts who do not have very high moral power keep talking nonsense, causing people to be deeply misled. Therefore, although the Bodhisattva descends, it is absolutely forbidden to pray for destiny! In my Van Sao series, it was mentioned before.

If there is anyone who refuses to give up his pagan practice and pursuit of luck, he should not be allowed to take refuge so that people will not say, "Buddhism is no different from paganism!"

The previous letter discussed the evil of praying for luck, people who study Buddhism should not participate in this matter. Most of the time, this is due to ghosts and ghosts, and over time it will eventually lead to failure. Although they do not fail, what they say is largely similar to people's views, often contradicting true morality. Don't use red paper to list [the name of the person seeking refuge]. Don't use red paper, old eyes can't see clearly, it's very laborious! In the future, if anyone comes to seek refuge, you should tell them: If you have ever followed a pagan religion and sought fortune, you should completely throw away the religions you practiced before. If not, it should not be introduced, so as not to consider paganism as Buddhism, causing people who are ignorant of evil and right to still consider evil as right. Now give the Dharma name to each person who takes refuge, please copy it and send it to them.

Furthermore, those who love their children in this world are harming them. Refusing to teach them to study hard, always allowing them to become habituated to arrogance, causes those with good talents to become stubborn, mediocre, and corrupt. The world is in chaos because of these people who don't know how to be the parents of others. Now I want my children to be good, so when they first understand, I immediately use the logic of cause and effect and retribution, the cycle of birth and death, and filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, shame to explain and tell them to practice, then my children will definitely be sages and good people. That glory is eternal and eternal.

[When] a child dies prematurely, life's habits will often give rise to resentment and laziness due to that situation. We must know that human life has complex causes and effects. If there is a cause, there must be an effect. If there is an effect, there certainly cannot be a cause. Knowing "cause first, effect later" will not give rise to resentment, knowing "virtue can feel the heavens", will not be so lazy that when faced with minor adversity, one becomes lazy in cultivating one's mind. For example, when the weather was just hot, then suddenly it was very cool, or when the weather was cool at first, then suddenly it was hot, this is a temporary change, not always like that. Just practice with all your heart, regardless of whether the current situation is favorable or unfavorable. If anyone can do that often, they will forever be blessed with many blessings. If because of the slightest discord you say "practicing is useless", then that is the view of an ignorant person! Even if nothing goes wrong in your whole life, it's difficult to reach the "happy" position

decree!"

If you can practice without being lazy, you will definitely give birth to a child with a long life and good virtue. If there is no question of good or bad, the only thing is to ensure that the child does not die prematurely. He will wipe out all the fat of the people, deposit that money in a foreign bank, and when one breath goes out and cannot be inhaled, [the money] completely goes to the hands of foreigners, [so] how fortunate is it that the beloved child does not die prematurely? If that good-for-nothing child died prematurely, it would be because of his great virtue, because if he did not die prematurely, it would make the people of the whole country miserable! If today all such people die prematurely, is our country such that there is no cure and is only waiting for destruction? You should only focus your mind on reciting Buddha's name to eliminate your karma and bring about good things.

The Luc of the group's order 158 has nothing to do with Son Chi. If it's a card on the tower, or a story, there will probably be a place where it needs to be used. Regarding images, the ancients of many generations did not worship images, and if they were sent, it would not be convenient to arrange them, because today's Linh Nham has absolutely no inheritance from the ancient Linh Nham, because after being burned down in the war, only a ruined tower remained, everything else was burned to the ground. What's more, the pagoda now follows the Pure Land dharma, the patriarch is a knowledgeable person in Zen Buddhism; Discussing on the aspect of pagodas and temples is not an inheritance, discussing on the dharma path is another temple. For example, a boat in the water, a car on land, and getting home are completely the same, but on the route, each thing is different. People today are not wealthy people, they can't say good things at all, they only like to hear sweet talk to the point of having no real benefit. Cong 159 is the best disciple of Master Han

The respectful calling of someone else's grandfather.

The Duke here is Hoang Tru (1605-1672). The monk belonged to the Lam Te sect and lived at the end of the Ming dynasty and the beginning of the Qing dynasty. He was from Thong Chau and Giang Nam. His dharma name was Ke Khoi and his dharma name was Thoai Ong. When he was young, his family suffered a stroke and was brought up by his grandmother. Although he studied hard, he did not crave fame and fortune. He admired Buddhism, liked Zen, and understood Buddhism. At the age of 25, the Master became a monk with Han Nguyet Phap Tang, diligently practiced and attained enlightenment. The Master understood the doctrines of hundreds of families, had profound education, and had a dignified character, which made the public admire him very much. The monk remembers the Ming Dynasty and often hopes for its restoration. When the Qing-Ming rebels rose up in the Ngo-Viet region, the Master repeatedly assisted, was once imprisoned, and was later rescued by a martyr. Every year on the day King Sung Trinh died, the monk wore mourning clothes, worshiped, and cried. For twenty-eight years, he kept the same rule. There are hundreds of famous disciples under the court. The monk passed away in the eleventh year of Kangxi, at the age of sixty-eight. The Master also left behind works such as Ngu Luc (100 volumes), Nam Nhac Ke Khoi Venerable Ngu Luc (10 volumes), Nam Nhac Lac Co, Linh Nham Ky Luoc.

Nguyet Tang160. Han Nguyet wants to be the most noble person ever, and is extremely fierce against his ancestor Thien Dong Mat161. Hoang Nhan, Uncle Duc, etc.

They are all people who despise their ancestors, only Tru Cong does not have that kind of habit, and is worthy of being a person who makes posterity admire and respect him.

Many times when you have a good dream, you are inspired by the urgency in the present. [Dreaming that] the great monastery is the Avatamsaka Dharma Assembly, but because it has not destroyed the Troubles, I only see the inferior appearance, not the superior appearance, but it is not easy to see that realm. As for the rich man giving him water to drink, it was Manjushri Bodhisattva giving him nectar162. You should always try hard

Han Nguyet Phap Tang (1573-1635) was a disciple of Mat Van Vien Ngo, lived at the end of the Ming Dynasty, and became a monk at the age of 15. In the fourth year of Thien Khai (1624), he went to Kim Tuc Pagoda, met with Mat Van, and was approved. The master was extremely intelligent, very eloquent, but he created heretical theories, composed the Five Tong Yuan series, severely criticized the Soo Dong sect, considered the other four sects to be fallen, did not understand the Zen sect, only the Lam Te sect grasped the essence of the Sixth Patriarch's coldness. The Master's treatise caused noisy debate among Zen sects at that time. Venerable Vien Ngo sent letters many times advising him to abandon that strange theory, but he did not listen. The monk passed away in the eighth year of Sung Trinh, at the age of 62. The work Ngu Tong Nguyen caused a debate that lasted until the Qing Dynasty, King Ung Chanh had to write Ngu Tri Gian Ma Bien Di Luc, outlining the mistakes in the above book and banned the circulation of Ngu Tong Nguyen, but because Han Nguyet's followers were still very large at that time, the book Ngu Tri Gian Ma Bien Di Luc was not included in the Tripitaka. Hoang Nhan and Uncle Duc are both disciples of Han Nguyet. Hoang Nhan is still extreme, destroying sects

Zen is several times different than Han Nguyet.

Mat Van Vien Ngo (1566-1642) was a monk of the Lam Te sect, who lived during the Ming Dynasty, and his posthumous title was Hue Dinh Zen Master. He was the son of a farmer. By chance, he read the Six Patriarchs Sutra and became interested in Zen. One day while stacking firewood, he suddenly woke up and became a monk with Mr. Huyen Huu Chanh Truyen at Long Tri pagoda. In the 30th year of Van Lich (1602), Mr. Chanh Truyen went to the capital and assigned the Master to be the director of Vu Mon pagoda. One day, while passing by Dong Quan mountain, he suddenly became enlightened. In the year Van Lich 39 (1611), Mr. Huyen Huu gave him his bowl and robe. He successively became the abbot of many famous Zen Buddhist monasteries. Because he was the abbot of Thien Dong Pagoda the longest, he was often called Thien Dong Mat. He is considered a person who has contributed to the revival of the Lam Te sect, with more than thirty thousand disciples. The monk passed away in the year Sung Trinh

15 at Huyen Thong Pagoda, aged 70.

Cam Lo (Amrta): Sometimes also transliterated as A Mat Ly Da, A Mat Lap Da, translated as Immortal, Immortal Dich, Thien Tuu, literally meaning immortal elixir, sacred wine of heaven. According to the Vedas, heaven has the sacred wine To Ma (Soma), if you drink it, you will live forever and will never grow old or die. It tastes as sweet as honey, so it is called Cam Lo (sweet dew). Buddhism uses the word "nectar" to describe the taste of the Buddha's dharma, which has the cool effect of nourishing the Dharmakaya of wisdom and eternal life for sentient beings. The word Cam Lo here refers to the dharma water, the water of wisdom that makes the person who drinks it destroy afflictions, and increases wisdom, not the elixir of heaven. In addition, Cam Lo is one of the three names of Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Life, Infinite Light, Infinite Cam Lo), so Amitabha Buddha is sometimes also called by the title Cam Lo King so as not to betray his kindness. Because ordinary people close to the ground are mostly subject to change, Tang Tu, when he was about to die, recited the poem: "Fighting on the edge, like a deep forest, like silver ice, Nhi Kim, Nhi Hau, Ngo Tri Tu Tu Phu" (Cautious and fearful, like entering a deep abyss, walking on thin ice, now, tomorrow, we know how to escape). Before the time of death, I was still afraid that something might happen to me, so I didn't dare to say such big words. Nowadays, those who like to talk loudly are all crazy people who do not make any effort at the grassroots level. The reason why a friend's tongue is not quick is due to bad karma. Chanting the Dharma Flower is of course good. Reciting Buddha and Quan Yin can also eliminate karma and increase wisdom. Don't be stubborn and think that only by chanting the Lotus Flower can you do it! If reciting the Buddha's name is truly sincere, it can still be supernatural and become a saint. Is it possible that only one has a sharp sense of truth?

noi_dung:
103. Letter responding to layperson Tri Lac

Rebirth does not depend on whether you are literate or illiterate, but only on whether you have faith or not! If you have faith and vows, you will surely be reborn; If you do not believe in your vow, you will definitely not be reborn. Your mother cannot recite sutras and mantras, so you should advise her to recite Buddha's name single-mindedly. You should be vegetarian, don't think that offering flesh and blood to your parents is showing filial piety. That is the superstition of people who do not know Buddhism. We already know that if we eat their meat, we will pay for it with our own lives in the future, so that kind of filial piety is causing our parents to be dissected by others forever and ever. That filial piety is the eternal filial piety that harms one's parents. Isn't that sad?

If you want your mother to be reborn, you should earnestly advise your brothers, sisters, concubines, and children to accompany your parents every day in reciting Buddha's name. If you don't gather together, you should tell them to recite often. If you are used to reciting, when your parents die, they will naturally know how to recite. We must also discuss in detail the benefits of supporting mindfulness and the harm caused by destroying [mindfulness] in order to benefit from supporting mindfulness and not incur the harm of being destroyed. Other things have been discussed in detail in A Letter to Everyone and the book General Strength Tan Luong. If not, please request from Hoang Hoa Xa.
