noi_dung:
104. Letter to layperson Ho Tac So

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

A few days ago, order 163 Cui Uncle Binh sent a letter, and also enclosed the letter you sent to him, asking Quang to send all kinds of books to you. Quang told someone to send it. You still have faith, but you have not yet met a wise person, so you still practice the pagan methods of alchemy and luck. They boast of "double cultivation of life"164, claiming to have obtained the true teachings of the Sixth Patriarch, but in reality it is only the method of preserving the body, without the fate of birth and death at all! They don't know the meaning of nature and life! But people do not know the Dharma, so they cannot distinguish between truth and falsehood, so it is difficult to avoid blindly following it. If their alchemy and luck methods are used properly, their blood will flow and their bodies will be healthy. If used incorrectly, the Qi will stagnate and not flow smoothly, causing great harm! There are quite a few people who participate in Dong Thien Xa to sit and practice the exercises to the point of becoming stupid, numb, losing body sensation, all because that method is not good, hoping to nourish the body ends up harming the body, isn't that sad?

If you look carefully at your illness, it is due to your constant desire for highness and luxury, so you often get sick because of Qi. This is one thing. Furthermore, due to the intelligence of nature, it is entangled with the habits of intelligent people and cannot be limited in matters of female beauty, and the fire of anger often flares up at the wrong time. For example, two axes cutting down a single tree together is extremely dangerous! In addition, using Dong Thien Xa's unwholesome meditation method creates more conditions for illness and suffering, so that all phenomena arise from it. If we now practice according to the method of "purifying the mind and attaining desire" (keeping the mind pure, reducing desires), reciting the Buddha's name, the accumulated karma will be destroyed over time, the good roots will grow, all insomnia, stuffy nose, muscle tremors, etc. will gradually disappear.

First of all, let's look at the practice method in the Gia Ngon Luc, a sentence "Namo Amitabha Buddha" that is constantly recited for a long time. Whenever thoughts of anger, lust, eagerness for victory, impulsiveness, etc.

The voice calling someone else's grandson. Diet (姪) is the child of an older brother or younger brother, if the child of

The older sister or younger sister will be called Sanh (甥).

The fortune-telling alchemists believe that they practice to preserve an indestructible body and have a long life, that is cultivating Life. At the same time cultivating to become an immortal and a saint, that is cultivating Nature. Therefore, they call themselves "two lives and two cultivators".

suddenly arose, and immediately thought: "I am a person reciting Buddha's name, should I have these thoughts?" As soon as the thoughts arise, they stop. For a long time, all the mentally draining and physically tiring thoughts cannot be awakened! Use the Buddha's inconceivable merits all day long to bless your body and mind. We guarantee that you will see great results in less than ten days. If you only occasionally recite a sentence or two and want to see results, you are lying to yourself and others. Even though you still have merit, if you want to rely on it to heal, it is definitely not possible! Everything must be based on sincerity. Is it possible to practice without sincerity and want to enjoy the benefits of healing illness and eliminating suffering?

Furthermore, if your habit energy is deep and thick, it is best to concentrate on reciting Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, because the Bodhisattva's heart is passionate about saving suffering. Now enclosed is a Letter to All, read it, you will know for yourself. Currently, Quang has something very urgent to do, so there is no need to send him letters in the future. If you have anything to discuss, you should send a letter to Uncle Binh, but you should not let Uncle Binh send letters to [Quang]. It's just that he knows the way and understands it a little more clearly than you guys!

tieu_de: 105. Letter to layperson Trang Hui Cu in Quan Chau
tom_tat: Nowadays, there are pagans all over the world. Because the Buddha Dharma is profound and mysterious, humans cannot know it, so they stole the name of the Buddha Dharma, but did not know the meaning, so they relied on the method of alchemy and luck to preserve the...
noi_dung:
105. Letter to layperson Trang Hui Cu in Quan Chau

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

Nowadays, there are pagans all over the world. Because the Buddha Dharma is profound and mysterious, humans cannot know it, so they stole the name of the Buddha Dharma, but did not know the meaning, so they considered the method of alchemy and luck to preserve the body as a method to help escape birth and death. Moreover, they do not know where life and death come from, so they blindly make up rumors, saying: "Practice the essence to transform Qi, practice Qi to transform Spirit, practice Divine ring Hu, and unite in one place to attain enlightenment." In fact, it is entirely possible to use consciousness to practice. It is absolutely impossible to dream of seeing the essence of Truth as It Is in the mind and yet still conceit: "The Six Patriarchs spread the Dharma in disorder, the Dharma returns to the family, the Sangha has no Dharma" (The Six Patriarchs spread the Dharma in disarray, the Dharma returned to the lay people, the Sangha has no Dharma). These words are not only spoken by mouth but also written into books, using falsehood to destroy the truth, using evil as truth, ignorant and unconscious people are fascinated by them.

Paganism can spread throughout the world thanks to two powerful dharmas:

One is esoteric, which means that if you receive true teachings from a wise master, you will still be successful without cultivating. Therefore, he said in a divine way: "If the mouse hears it, the mice will also become enlightened! The sparrows will hear it and the sparrows will also become enlightened!" Therefore, when preaching, we must stay in a secret room, whisper quietly, and send people to patrol outside, for fear of eavesdropping!

The second is to impose a strict ban, even if they are as close as father and son, husband and wife are not allowed to tell each other. If you say anything, you will be punished! Therefore, before being initiated into the religion, first force [the person] to swear: "If he betrays the religion in the future, he will suffer some terrible retribution!" After swearing, you can preach. Later, even though everyone knew it was wrong, because they were afraid of the god guarding their oath, they would rather die than dare to leave that religion to study Buddhism.

Suppose the pagans abandoned esotericism and made it public, allowing everyone to listen, and did not force others to swear oaths, then how many people in the world would accept their religion? Of course, they have no religion, stealing the name of the Buddha Dharma of life and death to practice alchemy, luck, and body preservation. Even if you can make your mind pure, it will still be nothing more than becoming an immortal! The position of an Immortal is still far below heaven, let alone [comparing the status of an Immortal with] the positions of Thanh Van, Duyen Giac, and Bodhisattva? Since you have taken refuge in Buddhism, you should thoroughly throw away the pagan dharmas you have practiced before and throw them out into the ocean of Indochina, single-mindedly reciting Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, so that this life and this opportunity to meet will not be wasted!

tieu_de: 106. Letter to physician Ma Tinh Tieu
tom_tat: The Buddha is the Great Physician, curing all diseases in the body and mind of living beings. Doctors in the world can only treat the body, even if the medical technique is superior, considering the results, it is of no benefit to the patient's consciousness....
noi_dung:
106. Letter to physician Ma Tinh Tieu

The Buddha is the Great Physician, curing all diseases in the body and mind of living beings. Doctors in the world can only treat the body. Even if their medical skills are superior, considering the results, they are of no benefit to the patient's consciousness. You have taken refuge in the Three Jewels, developed Bodhi mind, and cured people's illnesses, so while treating physical illnesses, you should also include ways to treat mental illnesses. Why say that? Most serious and dangerous diseases are caused by killing karma in previous lives or in this life, but sick people must stop eating and sleeping in order to heal quickly. If you want to reduce killing karma in the past life or in the present life, you must abstain from killing and eat a vegetarian diet. You also need to sincerely recite Buddha's name and Quan Yin, your illness will quickly heal, while cultivating virtue and sowing good roots. If the disease is caused by resentment karma, then other than this method, it will definitely be difficult to heal. That person and his parents, wife and children in the house may not be willing to follow suit because they are anxious to be cured. If you practice accordingly, you will plant good roots in this world. From now on, you will be able to have a righteous mind, and perhaps in the future, thanks to this, you will be able to escape birth and death, become a saint, and become a saint. For that person, it will be of great benefit to you.

As for cutting off lust, you should consider it the most important way to treat the disease. Regardless of internal or external symptoms, the disease has not been completely healed, so you should not get involved in sexual intercourse. Once infected with eating and sleeping, a mild illness will become serious, a serious illness can lead to immediate death, or not immediate death but becoming a cause that must die. Wanting to not die is very difficult! Even if he doesn't die, he will probably become a reduced person, disabled, and will certainly not be able to maintain his health. I don't know if it's because I'm not good at taking care of myself, so I'm shouting "doctors don't have real skills!" Regardless of whether male or female (for virgins and widows, you shouldn't say anything, but for others, you don't have to worry about it), you should be blunt, concise, and clearly state the pros and cons so that their illnesses can easily be healed, and thanks to that, your reputation can also be radiant. Usually, doctors only know how to treat diseases, not to mention taboos for the disease, let alone teach people to correct their mistakes and become good in order to cultivate virtue and accumulate blessings? That is the mentality of a street vendor who only wants to gain profit on the street, in the market, not the mentality of saving people, making the world live long, let alone being able to make people due to illness receive the unsurpassed benefits "when alive, join the sages, when lost, return to the Land of Ultimate Bliss"! The ancients said: "If you don't become a good minister, you must become a good doctor" (If you don't become a good prime minister, you will become a good doctor). Therefore, the doctor is called "the great leader of the country". In this world, a physician's status is extremely high. If he also uses Buddha Dharma, thanks to it to save sentient beings and practice the Bodhisattva path, it is truly the most important karma of all karma. Because when people are sick, they hear that a doctor who does not specialize in seeking benefit, has the desire to benefit others, and develops the Bodhi mind to tell them that they can cure the disease, can they not have the right faith to follow it?

If you want to build trust in others, you should not calculate how much or how little [the patient will] give thanks and then make distinctions. If rich people actively treat them, and poor people just treat them for the sake of it, over time people will despise them because of doctors' greed for profit. Even if they say things that benefit others, they won't believe them. You should also meet the father and say kindness, meet the child and say filial piety, the brother gives in, the younger brother is respectful, the husband is harmonious, the wife is obedient, the master is merciful, the servant is loyal, and the karma and retribution penetrates throughout the three lives (past, present, future), and the cycle of birth and death in the six realms. If you can talk to anyone, you don't have to worry about intentionally pretending to be careless and leisurely talking, causing the listener to gradually open up their mind and know that the cycle of birth and death is terrifying. Fortunately, there is a method to escape birth and death! A person who can do so can truly be called "using worldly dharma to practice Buddha dharma, using healing the body to cure illness of the mind!" Nowadays, we are in a difficult situation, natural disasters and man-made disasters frequently strike. Regardless of encountering disasters and misfortunes such as water, fire, swords, famine, pestilence, pests, locusts, drought, floods, family confrontations, etc., if you only sincerely and earnestly recite the name of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, you can certainly turn evil into good and misfortune into good fortune.

Furthermore, a woman who recites Avalokiteshvara when giving birth will certainly give birth peacefully, without suffering. Even if you haven't given birth for a long time or are about to die, if you recite it, you will immediately be able to give birth (must recite it out loud, don't recite it silently in your mind. Because at that time, you need to use force to expel the child. If you recite it silently, you will be injured and become sick. Those who care for the person around you should also recite it for that person. People in the family who are not in the delivery room should also recite it for you. Whether you are in the delivery room or outside, reciting it will be beneficial. During normal times when sleeping, When you rest, and when your clothes and hat are not neat, and you have not washed, rinsed your mouth, bathed, or urinated in an unclean place, you should recite the merits silently. Reciting the merits silently is the same [as reciting out loud]. Reciting out loud [during those times, in those places] is not according to etiquette, but it is not impossible to recite it at all!) Ignorant people consider this a scary thing, even if they are normally believers, they do not dare to teach others to recite it, considering it to be naked. pure, if you recite it you will be guilty. Not knowing that at that time the lives of both mother and child were involved, the Bodhisattva only focused on saving sentient beings. At that time, he only devoted his heart to it. Being naked and impure was an unavoidable matter. It could not be compared to doing something like that intentionally without respect! If you bear the thought, the child will be born immediately, not only without sin but also allowing both mother and child to sow good roots (this is seen from the sutras).

Medicine Master, it was not Quang who made up the story).

If in normal times we need to be extremely pious and clean, we cannot use that time [of childbirth] as a show, being arrogant and disrespectful would be a sin! Everyone who recites Buddha's name does not know this; Previously, Quang did not know about the mistakes in customs, so it was not mentioned at all in Van Sao. Later, because of his deep understanding, he often spoke to everyone. No one who followed it was immediately effective. This is a clue to benefit people.

tieu_de: 107. Letter responding to layperson Tran Hue Hoa (two letters)
tom_tat: Because Hue Hong delivered the letter, he knew that he already had enough people, and as soon as he heard the Buddha's teachings, he immediately had true faith. But those who study Buddhism must devote themselves to maintaining moral integrity, seriously fulfilling all duties, eliminating evil hearts, maintaining sincerity, and overthrowing...
noi_dung:
107. Letter responding to layperson Tran Hue Hoa (two letters)

(Year of the Republic 18 - 1929)

Because Hue Hong delivered the letter, he knew that he already had enough people, and as soon as he heard the Buddha's teachings, he immediately had true faith. But those who study Buddhism must be dedicated to maintaining moral integrity, seriously fulfilling all duties, eliminating evil hearts, maintaining sincerity, eliminating their own unruly desires to restore decency, not doing evil things, obeying good things, abstaining from killing, fasting, praying to recite the Buddha's name, using these things to practice themselves, and also teach others. Those who can do so will certainly in this life be able to join the saints and go straight to the Pure Land. Now the dharma name given to him is Hue Hoa, which means using wisdom to harmonize the body and mind, not allowing deviations in the views of Emptiness - Existence, greed - anger - ignorance, etc. He also uses Precepts - Concentration - Hue, compassion, joy and renunciation, etc. in harmony to serve as a basis for self-benefit, benefiting others, so as not to follow in the footsteps of the crazy people who are proud of their superiority in recent times, but also not to fall into the lowly, self-satisfied fools.

People live in a world of many dangers. If they breathe out without being able to inhale, they don't know what shape they will take. He was reincarnated as a human being, fortunately with a clear mind, filial piety and kindness, and his being was restored. If you are confused, it will be difficult to return! You must know: This is still the best news, if reincarnated into a different species, it will be even more dangerous. Therefore, know that: Sentient beings in the six paths are not the same or different, they all follow their karmic retribution, and are not born in a certain place. You have gone through that tragedy, your mind should decide to seek rebirth in the West, so that through this danger you will forever enjoy peace and joy. Pure Land Ten Essentials, Pure Land Saintly Sage Luc, Triet Ngo Ngu Luc have been requested. There are also recently printed books packed into six packages and sent out, please consider and accept them. Vegetarianism is due to not knowing that humans and animals reincarnate, giving birth to each other, killing each other, mistakenly thinking that humans should eat them, they [are born] for humans to eat. Only when he was reincarnated into that species did he realize that his previous calculations were wrong.

You have gone through such a dangerous time, of course you should try your best to study and become a vegetarian. If at a restaurant, it is difficult to be free [to eat vegetarian at will], then you should also develop a mind of non-forbearance, a mind of liberation, and eat a little less, which would be good. If you can be free, don't eat. Again, practice the Dharma

Pure Land is of course not about becoming a monk or not! The man above has an old mother, the man below has a wife and children, if he ignores it and does not ask for peace and happiness, he will commit a great sin towards both Buddha Dharma and worldly dharma, because he cannot fully express his gratitude and fulfill all his duties. Even if you practice, hard work can overcome your sins, so why can't you practice? The Sutra clearly teaches the pure karma of the Buddhas of the three worlds: The first is "to be filial and take care of parents, to serve the teacher, to be kind and not kill, to practice the Ten Good Karmas". This practice is praised by the Buddhas. There are dozens of times more lay people practicing now than forty years ago. Where have we ever heard that lay people don't practice well? You just follow what is said in my books Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc and practice. You will definitely be able to, along with your parents, wife and children, "be a saint in life and participate in the Lien Tri Hai Hoi" when you die. Only then will you know that I will not lie to you!

tieu_de: 108. Letter responding to layperson Trach Pham
tom_tat: The women who recite Buddha's name in the Jiang - Zhet region all believe in the unreasonable arguments of pagans, only know how to be respectful, chaste, and do not know how to reason with facts, so that blind theory causes harm in...
noi_dung:
108. Letter responding to layperson Trach Pham

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

The women reciting Buddha's name in the Jiang - Zhet region all believe in the unreasonable arguments of pagans, only know how to be respectful, chaste, and do not know how to reason with facts, so this blind theory causes harm in the world, causing people to be endlessly confused. Previously, Quang did not know about these heretical doctrines, so he did not mention them in Van Sao. Only later did I know clearly about that evil, so I often told everyone. If anyone has difficulty giving birth, follow that and recite it, then no one will immediately be able to give birth peacefully. People reciting Buddha's name when walking, standing, lying down, and sitting should all recite skillfully, but when sleeping, resting, when their hats and clothes are not neat, their hands are not washed, their mouth is not rinsed, at the same time as bathing, urinating, as well as when going to unclean places, they should recite silently in their mind, not out loud. Silently reciting merit still does not reduce it, but reciting it out loud is not according to etiquette.

If a woman encounters a childbirth, she should only recite Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva (do

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's vow of deep compassion does not mean not reciting Buddha's name, but only reciting Avalokiteśvara, do not misunderstand) because Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara's heart to save suffering is deep and heavy, but it must be recited clearly and completely, not silently in the mind. Chanting silently in your mind is weaker in comparison, and the sympathetic effect is also small. Furthermore, at that time, we had to forcefully push the child out; If you are using force to push the child out and chant silently, you will lose your qi and become sick. The pregnant woman herself should recite clearly out loud, the caretakers in the delivery room should also recite clearly, and family members in other rooms should also recite for the pregnant woman. Don't say "naked and impure, if you think about it, you'll be afraid of committing a sin!" You must know: Of course there is a certain principle, but the change is not just one! You should only rely on logic, don't reason with narrow logic. For example, if children accidentally fall into a toilet, water, or fire, they call their parents for help, and when their parents hear their voice, they immediately come to save them, but because their bodies are not clean and their clothes are not neat, they refuse to save them and let them die! The Bodhisattva's virtues are immeasurably ten thousand times deeper than those of his parents. When sentient beings who are suffering ask Him for help, [Bodhisattva] only has the thought of saving suffering, and has no idea of ​​measuring shape at all!

Moreover, at that time there was no other way, no way to show respect or cleanliness, but to be naked and impure! If you can [be respectful and clean] but don't do it, it will be a sin. If you can't show respect, you should only talk about it with sincerity in your heart, and don't talk about formality or formality. Bodhisattva has no suffering that he does not save, no disaster that he does not save, why would he abandon pregnant women? Although it is not mentioned clearly in the sutra, you should think about the Bodhisattva's mind of "saving suffering and hoping to end great suffering in human life to satisfy his compassion"! What's more, in the Medicine Buddha Sutra, the sutra passage in which the Buddha teaches pregnant women to chant the Medicine Buddha's name is as follows: "If there is a woman who is giving birth and is suffering extreme suffering, if she can wholeheartedly name, worship, and praise the Buddha (namely, the pregnant woman can do it, but worshiping, praising, respecting, and making offerings is the matter of family members, but the pregnant woman cannot do it), respectfully and make offerings to that Tathagata, all suffering will be eliminated" ("All suffering is eliminated" then There is no suffering! The benefit of the child being born is indescribable! The mother who recites the Buddha's name will receive such great benefits. Is it possible that the person who recites the Buddha's name will be completely lost as soon as he enters the mother's room? The child is born with a perfect body, correct appearance, everyone who sees it is happy, has intelligent roots, is peaceful and rarely gets sick, and his essence is not taken away by non-human beings. We can know that when giving birth, if we recite, not only will we be innocent, but both mother and child will be safe, will receive great benefits, and will plant great good roots. As long as the pregnant woman is like that, other people will know.

Mr. Ma Thuan Khanh in Hunan (his name is mentioned in Van Sao) is a Hui Hoi165 (Hui Hui people only have this one family), husband and wife.

Hoi Hoi, also known as Hui clan, Hohhot, is a common noun to refer to Muslims in China. Previously, this noun was used in a broader sense to refer to all of them, and all five children sent letters asking for refuge. In the fall of the 18th year of the Republic of China (1929), he sent a letter saying: His wife gave birth to five children, the first two were safe, the third was bleeding, the fourth and fifth were in even more danger. Now I will give birth soon. If I bleed again, I will probably lose my life. Please show me how to save her. Quang told them to sincerely recite Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Even though she was naked and impure while giving birth, don't think that's why she couldn't recite it! You need to recite it out loud, not silently. He asked to give the fetus a dharma name. The letter sent by Quang, he and his wife read it together, and his wife recited it immediately. The next day I was born, while I was still reciting, I was at peace without suffering! He immediately wrote a letter back saying that the matter was beyond his imagination. Bodhisattva can truly be said to be so compassionate and compassionate! From the fall of the 15th year of the Republic of China (1926) onwards, when Zeng Quang Van Sao finished printing, he did not keep any drafts of any document to avoid wasting money on printing. Because I recently learned deeply about this bad habit, I always talk about the pros and cons with everyone, hoping they will spread this to save the trouble and life of the pregnant woman and her child. Even if someone doesn't sympathize and thinks that Quang likes to talk about his birth mother, he doesn't regret anything. He only hopes to save this evil habit so that everyone can live with righteous faith!

tieu_de: 109. Letter responding to layperson Chau Duc Dai
tom_tat: The method of reciting the Buddha's name focuses on faith and vows. If you have faith and vows but are not of one mind, you can still be reborn. Having one mind but not having faith in one's vow, one still cannot be reborn! Most people in the world focus on single-mindedness, not paying attention to...
noi_dung:
109. Letter responding to layperson Chau Duc Dai

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

The method of reciting the Buddha's name focuses on faith and vows. If you have faith and vows but are not of one mind, you can still be reborn. Having one mind but not having faith in one's vow, one still cannot be reborn! Most people in the world focus on single-mindedness and do not pay attention to faith and vows, which means they have lost the most important thing. If the doubt arises that "I have not yet achieved one mind, I am afraid that I will not be reborn" then it is completely contrary to sincere faith and earnest vows are lost! This type of thinking seems to be good thinking, but in fact, if because of this we increase our faith and vows to reach one-pointedness, then it is a good way of thinking; But if they are not of one mind, Muslims and Muslim countries will be united. From the Qing Dynasty onwards, the word Hui Hui was used to refer specifically to Muslim minorities in China, such as the Uighurs (Uigur) in Xinjiang, the Dongxiang Hui people in Gansu, the Tanla people in Qinghai, the Huijiang people, and the Tujuet people living at the foot of the Tian Shan, for example. Hui people often originate from Central Asia such as Arabia or Iran, etc.

Often thinking that it is impossible to be reborn becomes a bad way of thinking, it is impossible not to know! If you want to be united in your mind, the most important thing is to have a heart that is passionate about life and death, the second thing is to be earnest and sincere, and the third thing is to sincerely recite it from your heart, and don't read it with your mouth. If you still cannot achieve unity, you should follow the method of Ten Niem Ky Numbers in Van Sao, and you will easily achieve unity.

tieu_de: 110. Letter responding to layperson Sa Dung Chi
tom_tat: As a child, the way to honor our parents is to try our best to practice Cultivation so that everyone, out of respect for us, will think of the one who gave birth to us, that is the most essential method. Often see people, after their father...
noi_dung:
110. Letter responding to layperson Sa Dung Chi

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

As a child, the way to honor our parents is to try our best to practice Cultivation so that everyone, out of respect for us, will think of the one who gave birth to us, that is the most essential method. We often see people in the world, after their parents have passed away, they go everywhere to look for people with reputation and status to write compliments, but do not focus on their own efforts to cultivate virtue and do benevolent deeds to make their parents famous. I often say: "Most people in life love fame and hate, especially want to show off for a while, not thinking about lifelong memories!" He believed in Buddhism, and his father also knew the meaning of "the mind is fully available, the mind creates, the mind does, the mind is". All funerals, burials, worshiping gods, entertaining guests, everything should follow the Buddha's regulations, no alcohol or meat should be used, so that the whole village can celebrate [following that good example].

Quang is old, his spirit, effort, and eyesight are not enough. Only composing sixteen verses166, one cannot write the Sanh Tay memoir. Please write it yourself, or ask another high-ranking person to write it. Lately, Quang has always refused to do pen and ink matters that others asked him to do, not because he didn't want to work hard for others, but because he couldn't handle it! In the letter, he did not mention his father's name at all, so in the first part he only had to leave two words blank, please add them. Fortunately, his father had already been reborn and his mother was still alive. Of course, he should have given advice in advance, so that he could die with all the illusory blessings and blessings of heaven and glory in the world. Taking the determination to be reborn to become a saint as his career ambition would be of great benefit. Everyone who does Buddhist work during the funeral should use Buddha's name as the main priority. If you recite sutras, worship, and do Water Luc ashram, you will get very little real benefit!

Please see the article "Praising the noble conduct of Mr. Sa Tuyet Phong" in the Praise section of An Quang Dharma Master Van Sao Tuc Bien, volume Ha.

tieu_de: 111. Letter responding to layperson Truong Hai Kieu in Nam Thong
tom_tat: At a time when the country's fortunes are in danger, when people have no right to live, when they encounter a future that cannot be contemplated, they are ordinary people who are close to the ground, full of good karma, unable to concentrate on studying Buddhism, but still want to live in...
noi_dung:
111. Letter responding to layperson Truong Hai Kieu in Nam Thong

(Year of the Republic 25 - 1936)

At a time when the country's fortunes are in danger, people have no reason to live, when faced with this unthinkable future, they are ordinary people who are close to the ground, full of Or karma, unable to concentrate on studying Buddhism, but still want to solve the great matter of birth and death in this life that cannot be resolved in hundreds of thousands of millions of millions of eons, but if we do not take the pursuit of rebirth in the Pure Land as our ambition and career, we are afraid that there will only be cause, and we cannot achieve the result! Light and self-quantity is a blind factor. When you first become a monk, you immediately take refuge in the Pure Land. Because of more than fifty years of experience, although I do not understand Buddha Dharma at all, I have certainly not been mistaken about the Pure Land Dharma because I have had the will from the beginning! For all those who are predestined, use [this method] to respectfully advise.

The ocean of birth and death is deep, the Bodhi path is far away, if you want to solve this great matter in this life, you will abandon one Pure Land dharma, not to mention not understanding all the dharmas, even if you do, you will not be able to fully enjoy the true benefits! Why is that? Because all dharma methods rely on self-reliance to cut off or attain Truth in order to end birth and death; As for the Pure Land dharma, if you have full faith and vows, recite the Buddha's name, and pray to be reborn in the West, you can immediately rely on the Buddha's power to be reborn in the West. Comparing the two dharmas, the difference between difficulty and ease is as great as heaven and abyss! What's more, at the beginning of this great tribulation, you still want to study the profound scriptures, not taking this dharma "once you transcend, you will go straight to the Tathagata's position" as your ambition. I'm afraid that your career will not be satisfied and will turn into a long-winded lament "out of ten people, nine are hesitant"!

Now the dharma name given to him is Hue Do, meaning to take refuge in the Pure Land dharma taught by the Buddha's wisdom to practice on his own, to teach others, in order to rely on Buddha's magnetic power to escape birth and death, so his name is Hue Do. He gave Quang eight dong, and Quang sent him eight dong of scriptures. If you are willing to read and recite these sutras and read the previous stories, you will be able to know that Quang's views are not mistaken! It is also important to know that today's chaos has reached its ultimate level, and there is no cure! The reason is all because the Confucian doctrine of rejecting cause and effect and reincarnation was planted eight or nine hundred years ago and has now exploded! Now, if we want to restore the human mind, if we do not clearly state the root of this disaster, even if we want to restore it, it will be difficult to do, because cause and effect is a great means for saints to rule the world, for Buddha to save sentient beings, and is the method to cure diseases both at the root and the tip. Quang is old, his spiritual and mental strength are not enough, from now on he should only practice according to the sent scriptures, no need to send letters anymore so that both sides will not waste their time and effort!

tieu_de: 112. Letter responding to layperson Dich Tri Thuan
tom_tat: Both your letter and Lien Phuong's letter have been received. He can recite the Lankavatara Sutra, it can be said that he had good roots in the past. The mind-pressing method is not limited to that place. If one can follow [the teachings of Bodhisattva] Great…
noi_dung:
112. Letter responding to layperson Dich Tri Thuan

(Year of the Republic of China 27 - 1938. This man's original name was Van Tuyen)

Both your letter and Lien Phuong's letter have been received. He can recite the Lankavatara Sutra, it can be said that he had good roots in the past. The mind-pressing method is not limited to that place. If one can follow [the teachings of the Bodhisattva] Maha Hui167 in the chapter of the Broken Flesh, seeing all living beings as parents, brothers, sisters, wives, children, and relatives, then that door will be wide open, no dharma cannot be entered! If you can truly enter this method (i.e. "think of all living things as your own flesh and blood, do not eat their flesh") even though you have not yet achieved the mind-impression method, compared to those who have attained the other mind-injection method but have not yet accepted this method, the difference in merit is like heaven and earth! Because, on the one hand, there is a misunderstanding but there is no great Bodhi mind, on the other hand, there is a true practice of the Bodhi path.

Besides, don't take my words as wrong. Even if you have not yet achieved the mind seal of the Buddha or Patriarch, but if you dedicate this merit to rebirth, once you are reborn, you will immediately go straight to [the position of] Non-regression, be close to Amitabha and the saints, and you will personally witness the mind of the Buddha and Patriarch. The beings of the End of Time want to end life and death, and do not take the faith and vow to recite Buddha's name and pray for rebirth in the West as their ambition and career, although they attain enlightenment like Ngu To Gioi (Ngu To is the name of the pagoda. Zen Master Su Gioi used to be the Abbot of Ngu To Pagoda in Hoang Mai, so the world calls him Ngu To Gioi), Thao Duong Thanh still only gets the results [in his later body he becomes] To Dong Pha, Tang Lo Cong168. The road of life and death is far away, life

This is because a disciple from Vinh Xuan district, Phuoc Kien province, who is doing business in Singapore, sent back sixteen hundred dong. It is estimated that this amount of money is enough for the printing and shipping costs, but it is not enough, we have to compensate a little more for that amount. This book is not about abstaining from killing, but it is actually an important book about abstaining from killing. People who care about letting others see that animals are filial, loyal, chaste, compassionate, etc. will certainly be moved, each fulfilling their own vocation, taking "maintaining moral integrity, fulfilling all duties, eliminating evil hearts, maintaining sincerity, not doing evil things, observing good things" in the hope of not being looked down upon by animals. If animals are like that, are we inferior to them? We must strive to do it diligently so as not to be ashamed! Regarding the profound principles of Buddhism, Mr. Tu Bach Pang191 does not distinguish between evil and right. In this book, only the good virtues of animals are recorded, which are of great benefit to life. Quang has written a preface, if you are willing to read it

Vat Do Nhu Try is a work that collects stories of love, compassion, and morality in the animal world such as crows that know how to retrieve prey and take care of their elderly mother, etc. This work is written by Tu.

Compiled by Khiem during the Qing Dynasty.

"Three-named letter" is a printing style with a fairly large font size, equivalent to font size 32

in current computer printouts.

Bach Phong is Tu Khiem's ​​given name. This man is also the author of the book Hai Nam Nhat Chuoc, and is very fond of Ouija boards. This man was mentioned by Patriarch An Quang in letter number 75, which is the letter responding to the layman Giang Canh Xuan, who will not expect [but naturally] study saints, sages, Buddha, and Patriarchs!

The letter dated the 7th was not received until yesterday afternoon by Muoi Six because it was in a place of war and traffic was interrupted. The Dharma names of the eighteen people seeking refuge are written separately on another piece of paper. Please divide them and send them. You should tell them to keep morality intact, fulfill all duties, abandon evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, not do evil deeds, observe good deeds, fast, recite Buddha's name, and pray to be born in the West. Don't pray for blessings in heaven and earth. If ordinary people have blessings, they will definitely create killing karma! Having created killing karma, it is difficult to avoid killing karma (retribution due to killing), not to mention that the blessed person only creates killing karma? Therefore, those who pray for blessings are praying for misfortune for both themselves and others! People who study Buddhism cannot help but know this meaning!

Mr. [Ly] Duc Minh asked everyone to recite Quan Yin, each person reciting ten thousand sentences, releasing one hundred thousand [lives] in the hope of eliminating the killings. This is also no greater merit; But you should often recite Quan Yin throughout your life. For everyone who joins the association, abstaining from killing and being vegetarian is the only radical measure. Otherwise, today, if you spend money to buy some animals to release, but every day you buy living creatures to kill yourself, or buy them from people who kill them to sell, it will still be one hot meal, a hundred cold meals. How can you eliminate the karma of killing in previous lives, both for yourself and the donor? Releasing animals is a way to promote abstinence from killing and vegetarianism; If we don't pay attention to abstaining from killing and being vegetarian, then the number of people who will be released will be limited, and the number of people who will be killed will be infinite!

On the twenty-eighth day of June, Quang sent letters to newspapers and magazines in Shanghai to publish advertisements advising people around the world to recite the Holy Name of Quan Yin, each newspaper published for ten days. I don't know if you have seen a copy of that advertisement attached to this letter because of the war. Tell Cao Ha Jing to print fifty thousand leaflets seven inches wide and distribute them to Buddhist agencies in the provinces. War has broken out, and it's difficult to do so right away! That essay is not only used during wartime but can be used at all times! When he talked about clearly stating the origin of war and the important way to destroy [war], Chau An Si said: "People who know cause and effect are the path of great control. People who do not know cause and effect are the way of great chaos" (People who know cause and effect are the way to achieve great peace. People who do not know cause and effect are the way of great chaos). Because, knowing cause and effect, we will act according to natural principles and speak according to people's hearts. Why is there such a thing as war?

If we despise the country's goods and value imported goods, and all the country's money is shipped abroad, that is a huge "not following the natural principles, not following the hearts of people", causing others to use our own money to make guns to attack us! Therefore, we know that: Those who like to use foreign goods cannot help but bear the crime of inviting others to attack us! From now on, let's earnestly correct our previous mistakes, learn from Gandhi192 (Gandhi) and not use foreign goods, then less money will be lost, and the country will be rich and strong. These words seem far-fetched, but they are actually extremely important!

You must know: A person who understands cause and effect, when starting his mind to do things, is only afraid of committing a sin. He will diligently practice the eight virtues of "filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, shame", consider the eight things "be kind to things, wisdom, right mind, sincerity, self-cultivation, family discipline, rule the country, peace of the world", even if it is an insect or an ants, he will not dare to kill. Those who do not know cause and effect kill their parents, boast about their achievements, and strongly propose to turn humans into animals, intending to make people in the whole world no different from animals, then their hearts will be at peace and happy! Cause and effect is a great means for saints to rule the world and for Buddha to save sentient beings. If we abandon cause and effect, then saints, Buddhas, and Bodhisattvas cannot show any other way! Currently, the chaos has reached the extreme. If we hope to save, we must focus on family education and cause and effect retribution. When children first understand and learn to speak, they will skillfully advise them on the principles of cause and effect and retribution, and gradually solidify them, so that they will deeply believe in cause and effect and retribution without the slightest error. That is the basis for achieving peace and cessation

Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (1869-1948) was an Indian politician and spiritual leader who guided the Indian people in a non-violent struggle for India's independence from Britain. He is often called Mahatma Gandhi. A lawyer graduate, he applied peaceful resistance to the struggle in South Africa. As the leader of the Indian National Congress, with the doctrine of non-violence, he united all elements with different political views, religions, and classes in Indian society to join forces to fight for the country's independence. However, when India gained independence, due to dissent and power struggles between Hindu and Muslim factions, Pakistan demanded separation from India. An ardent Hindu from the Mahsabha Hindu extremist group, Nathuram Godse, assassinated Gandhi because he believed he had weakly given in to Pakistan's demands for separation. Gandhi used to oppose British imports, so he guided a group of people to walk to the sea to get sea water to make salt when the British colonialists taxed salt, as well as turn away and spin and weave fabric themselves to avoid having to use fabric imported from England.

Except for the accident. Don't think it's a fantasy and then look down on it, you'll be very lucky!

tieu_de: 119. Letter responding to layperson Giang Dich Vien (four letters)
tom_tat: (At that time, he was not yet superstitious about fortune-telling. Reading these four letters, you will know the level of Mr. Giang's Buddhist teachings. The old man (ie Patriarch An Quang) advised and taught like that but still could not comprehend a few parts, then it is clear enough...
noi_dung:
119. Letter responding to layperson Giang Dich Vien (four letters)

(Year of the Republic 25 - 1936)

(At that time, he was not yet superstitious about fortune-telling. Reading these four letters, you will know Mr. Giang's level of Buddhism. The old man (ie Patriarch An Quang) advised and taught like that but still could not understand a few parts, it is clear enough [what Mr. Giang's level of Buddhism is]! The copyist wrote)

The things said in the letter are essential, but what needs attention from beginning to end is cause and effect, reincarnation and education in the family. Education in the family is the most important thing for mothers to teach their children. If when the children first understand, the mother immediately teaches cause and effect and the truth of being human, when they grow up they will know good and bad, will not be fascinated by the evil party or evil doctrine, and will become sages and good people. If you let your arrogance become a habit when you are young, when you grow up you will not be able to control yourself, you will turn to evil doctrines, and if you want to return to the right path, it will be difficult for a hundred people to get one! At the present time, if we do not use cause and effect as retribution as a specialized medicine to save the country and save the people, no matter what we do, it will still not be very effective! Because they don't pay attention to practice, they just use empty words to get things done. Cause and effect is the way to treat both the root and the tip. When ordinary people first develop their minds, the Tathagata who attains perfect enlightenment is not outside of cause and effect. The crazy person considers cause and effect as the Lesser Vehicle and then despises it, arbitrarily indulges in it, does evil without restraint, and casually speaks nonsense!

The Book of Lectures at Various Places Luc193 (A booklet recording sermons delivered at various places) is said to have already been printed. The power of vision is too weak, to write and reply to these two letters, one must use both a magnifying glass and a magnifying glass to see the blur; Therefore, it is impossible to interfere in [the review of] the book Giang Luc! [As for the position of] Head of Phat Quang Commune of Truong Su Tu, Quang only has a low reputation, but when it comes to lecturing, giving introductions, and writing afterwords, his strength is unbearable! The lady of the Truong family used the Tripitaka as a protective dharma gate to benefit the beings of the Buddha Light Society,

This is a book that collects lectures on Buddhism by Giang Dich Vien, recorded by layperson Thoi Chu Binh, and published by Tran Thu Dinh.

That merit caused her to be promoted to the lotus rank, and her grandson Than Tu was immediately cured of phlegm.

Now send to Than Tu and 194 Huu Trinh each a bag of Great Compassion incense ash. This ash has been blessed for more than three months. If it's less, recite fifty times a day, if it's more, seventy-five times. Stored in large biscuit boxes, each box is about more than ten pounds195. Calculation has recited the Great Compassion Mantra for sixty or seven thousand times. A bag of this ash can be used to mix water about two or three hundred times. The first time you mix it, you should use one-twentieth [of the amount of ash] in a large bowl, use boiling water to mix, stir, wait for the ash to settle, pour the water into a gourd or jar, drink three times a day. You should be vegetarian, and often recite the holy name "Namo Avalokiteshvara" and it will have miraculous effects. After the disease is completely healed, you should mix less, no need to drink one-twentieth like before. If you don't believe, if you don't have sincerity, it will be ineffective!

Rich people have many illnesses, one is because they don't bother to do anything, their blood vessels are not smooth; Second, because you eat a lot of flesh and blood dishes, if you encounter poisonous dishes, the disaster will be no small, you may lose your life! Even though the animal is not poisonous, because when it is killed, hatred coalesces, so [its meat] has a poisonous nature. Although it does not kill people immediately, the poison accumulates over time and will develop into scabies and disease. Mrs. Tram of the Truong family agreed to let Than Tu abstain from killing and become a vegetarian, and her phlegm illness would be cured immediately! The remaining ash should be worshiped below the Buddha altar or hung in a high, clean place, in case of unexpected need and arbitrarily used to help dangerous diseases, do not ignore it! The ash that has been used to mix water should be mixed with water and plastered on the roof to show respect. This is the "dried water of Great Compassion"196 that can be sent far away and can be kept for many years. In your place, if it's not an extremely dangerous disease, don't give it to me!

Love command: A call to a person's daughter to show respect.

A scale is a unit of weight measurement that has existed since ancient times. The quantity is not the same, each generation is different. During the Han Dynasty, one kilogram was only 200 grams. Through each generation, the weight gradually increased, until the Qing Dynasty, a pound was about 590 grams. Currently, Taiwan regulates a kilogram as 600 grams, in Mainland China it is 500 grams, and in Hong Kong it is 604.79 grams.

Patriarch An Quang often recites the Great Compassion mantra into water, called Great Compassion Water, or recites the mantra into rice for sick people to cook, called Great Compassion Sanskrit. To conveniently send it far away, the Patriarch recited a mantra in incense ashes, so that the recipient could mix the ashes with water and drink it, like drinking the Great Compassion Water.

Most of the servants do not know good or bad, work in rich houses or other people's houses, do not know how to cherish rice and other things, this is a matter of wasting blessings and wasting life, we don't know how many times we [do this] every day! Recently, I heard Mr. Cao Tung Kieu say: "There was a fairy who relied on other people's bodies to diagnose illness. A nanny belonging to a rich family, almost paralyzed, also came to ask for a medical examination. Before she arrived, the fairy said: 'You can't come! You wasted too much rice and food from your master, and soon your whole body will go crazy, become paralyzed and die!' So I told these words to [Huu] Trinh's two daughters. and his Chieu Nga so that they can cherish their owner's things, cultivate their own blessings, and be able to dedicate that merit to their rebirth.

A few days ago, Mr. Phi Pham Cuu came here and said that Hieu Nhuoc and his daughter San Vu died very miserably. Layperson Dich Vien advised their family to make super meritorious deeds, so he spent four hundred dong, gave two hundred dong to Quang to print alms books to give to them, and two hundred dong asked Linh Nham to visit Buddha's home. At that time, he immediately told Mr. Tran Thu Dinh of Hoang Hoa Xa to send a letter to Dich Vien saying that Quang had used up all the money of two hundred dong to send books to the Giang family so that he could give them away at his discretion. Which kind of books should be sent in large quantities and which kind should be sent in small amounts? Wait until Layman Giang sends a letter to send them. Using the Truong family's money to benefit the people of the Truong village is extremely fine, I don't know if the letter has been sent or not?

At night, Quang intended to set up a tablet for Hieu Nhuoc and San Vu each, with a total of one hundred dong for the two of them, and use one hundred dong to attack the Buddha. The next morning, when Mr. Phi goes up the mountain, he will talk. After breakfast the next morning, when I asked him, he had already left. He couldn't return for a day or two, so I had to just let him go. The tablet in Linh Nham, placed in the Buddha Recitation Hall, is secretly gathered by the Buddha's name throughout the year. Compared to other places worshiped in cold rooms, it is very different! Everyone donates thirty-five dong. You don't need to send it anymore, just use it to spend on Phat Quang Commune. Quang has the reputation of being a commune leader and cannot help but use other people's merits to do meritorious deeds on behalf of others.

The last letter and a small package of books have been received. Thirty-five dong was originally intended to be sent back to Phat Quang Society for use. Yesterday I received a letter and notice from the bank, only to find out that [the letters exchanged between] both sides were too late! In the afternoon, Mr. Thanh Duc Thanh arrived and said that Jiangsu had the worst water disaster in the country. This man is a student of Phung Mong Hoa and Vuong Au Nong. He has been in charge of medical examinations for many years and is quite famous. Quang then took those thirty-five dong, added five dong, making it forty dong, and gave it to Mr. Thanh. He asked whose name the receipt was on. Quang said: "What do you and I need between you and me?" He replied: "It must be left to the association to calculate the accounts." Quang said: "You can name Dich Vien or An Quang as you like!" The previous letter said that Phi Pham Cuu had gone to Linh Nham, had not met Quang, three days later he returned, stayed the night, asked early the next morning, he was gone! Everything has a cause and effect, it cannot be forced. Everything depends on fate, don't worry about it, worrying will make you tired, so it's better to depend on fate to be more liberated!

The Great Chant's explanation of Quan and Chi is not very appropriate. Master Duc Sam said: "It seems that lay people do not have a deep understanding of Tuc De in the Three Noble Truths and Jia Quan in the Three Quan."; So I immediately opened the first page of the book Giang Dien Luc that was printed the first time to read it. Although the things said [in that page] are moral and can lead others to victory, they are not completely compatible with the true meaning of Emptiness and Falsehood!

The Three Contemplations and the Three Truths are the essence of Buddhism. According to reason, it is called Truth, Truth is Reason. Speaking in terms of practice, it is called Tam Quan, Quan means practice. True Truth: One dharma is not established, Conventional Truth: All dharmas are complete! Contemplating the truth in the True Truth is called Emptiness Contemplation. Contemplating the principles of the Emperor is called Jia Contemplation. The Contemplation of Emptiness is the contemplation of True Suchness, Dharma Nature, "a dharma without establishment", this is the Emptiness "without both Emptiness and Existence". That is the form of Emptiness in the "Dhammas of Emptiness" of the Heart Sutra. Not only Emptiness of Form and Emptiness, but Bodhi and Nirvana are also empty. If there were any dharma that was emptiness, it would not be called True Emptiness. How can this emptiness of the Emptiness in the Three Contemplations be understood as "all things are not cared for or done"? The customs of Tuc De are not vulgar or elegant customs, but because they are created and laid out, they are called Tuc. Fake is not fake in Truth - Fake (real - fake), but is also the fake of creation and display. The contemplation aimed at contemplation of the conventional truth is called Pseudo-Contemplation because the nature of the True Truth is "not established in one dharma" but has the full six degrees of merit, ten thousand actions, and complete dharmas. This is the "Dharma" in the sentence "The Emptiness of all Dharmas" (the Emptiness of all Dharmas) of the Heart Sutra. How can we consider it as ordinary people? Ordinary people belong to the two truths of Suffering and Origin, also

Emptiness and Jia here belong to the perfect and wonderful morality of the Vien sect, the Second Vehicle does not even have a part, let alone ordinary people?

Furthermore, page thirty talks about relying on self-reliance, using self-reliance to cultivate the path, from the human world to being born in the heavens to the Formless Realm, calling it "transcending the three realms" (crossing the three realms vertically). This statement is also incomplete! Relying on self-reliance, one must completely cut off all the afflictions of Thought and Thought in the three worlds. Good roots can be cut off in this life, while dull roots must first cut off afflictions in the Desire Realm and be born in the Form Realm. Next, eliminating afflictions in the Form Realm, giving rise to the Formless Realm. Until you completely eliminate all afflictions in the Formless Realm, attain the True Truth of Nirvana, escape birth and death, and become a saint! The gods in the three worlds except the great Bodhisattvas of the Tushita Inner Monastery

(born in the Inner Court197 are all Dharmakaya great men) and the three saints belonging to the five Imperfect Heavens (Five Imperfect Heavens) which are No Trouble, No Heat, Good View, Good Manifestation, and Ultimate Form are all people in the six paths of reincarnation. One cannot consider being born in the Formless Realm Heaven as having escaped the three worlds! Uat Dau Lam Phat 198 practices Phi Phi Thien Concentration in the mountains, the birds make noise, unable to attain Concentration, moving to the seashore, big fish in the sea fight, unable to attain Concentration; Therefore, resentment arises, with the idea of ​​​​killing all birds and fish. Later, [he practiced] Concentration successfully, was born in the sky of Phi Phi Thought, lived eighty thousand great kalpas, and after running out of heavenly blessings, fell into a flying fox, went to the forest to eat birds, and went to the water to eat fish! Therefore, we must distinguish the difference between being born in heaven by following the Buddha's teachings and cultivating the passage or attaining Truth and being born in heaven by cultivating worldly blessings or practicing worldly meditation so that readers will not misunderstand! (The book Lectures on the Luc is entirely edited, collated, and circulated by Tran Thu Dinh)

tieu_de: 120. Letter replying to Master Hui Khong
tom_tat: The Inner Court is the Good Dharma Hall of the Tusita heaven, built by the great minister Lao Do Bat De, and is the seat of Bodhisattva Maitreya. All the Buddhas manifested in Sa Ba resided at Tusita Inner Monastery before being born...
noi_dung:
120. Letter replying to Master Hui Khong

(Year of the Republic 25 - 1936)

The Inner Court is the Good Dharma Hall of the Tusita heaven, built by the great minister Lao Do Bat De, and is the seat of Bodhisattva Maitreya. All the Buddhas manifested in Sa Ba resided in Tushita Inner Monastery before being born in the human world. The mortals cannot see it

received Tu Sui Inner Court.

Udraka Ramaputra, also transliterated as Udraka Ramaputra, or Upa Da La Ca La Ma Tu, is a famous immortal, achieving Concentration of Phi Non-Perception and attaining the Five Wisdoms. When the Buddha passed away and became a monk, he came to study with him. In the Nirvana Sutra, the Buddha told Mr. Tu Bat Da about the fate of Uat Dau Lam Phat: being reduced to being a flying fox after enjoying all the blessings of heaven.

Yesterday afternoon, when he received the Master's letter, about the Master's visit to Bao Quoc Pagoda, Quang completely forgot about it. Reading the letter sent by the Master, I see that I still rely on the knowledge of the Tong Mon as the main focus, and still do not completely trust the Pure Land dharma! Therefore, just the corresponding request causes a demonic state to arise. The Buddhist recitation method uses faith and prayer as a pioneer. If you don't have true faith and earnest prayer, don't say "if there is no correspondence, you cannot be reborn", even if there is correspondence, you cannot decide rebirth! Undisturbed single-mindedness and Buddha-reciting samadhi are not easy to achieve. If you have sincere faith and earnest vows, even if you have not received the corresponding results, you can still be reborn, let alone if you have already met the corresponding ones! The monk only knew how to ask for the corresponding thing, and with a little bit of corresponding aura, he felt joy and praise. That was also a non-corresponding phenomenon, that's why the strange appearance appeared! The most taboo of practitioners is that a little is enough. Having received a little bit was enough and then my heart became depraved, that is a certain reason! I hope you should only think with one mind, don't have doubts and fear that "If you don't correspond, you won't be able to be reborn!" All realms do not care, nor does it matter whether people die well or miserably; Except for reciting the Buddha's name, do not let any second thought arise. Only then can the decisive benefits of rebirth be achieved.

If you are too afraid of facing all kinds of obstacles when you die, you shouldn't have one; Therefore, I considered fasting for seven days, which is extremely dangerous. It's still not enough to eat enough food, so how can you be compatible when you're almost starving to death? If you still want to starve yourself to death, please go down the mountain to another place to do it. Linh Nham will definitely not accept this solution. The monk completely followed the path of false thoughts to seek accordingly. If you let go of all delusions, your illness will heal and your body will be at peace. Even though his lifespan has ended, he will still be mindful and clear, following the Buddha to be reborn. People reciting Buddha's name should not have any thoughts of [longing for] the next life, the next life. If the Master's rebirth mind is not single, he will definitely not be able to avoid being reborn in the six paths of this world!

tieu_de: 121. Letter to layperson Quach Phu Dinh
tom_tat: Yesterday I received the letter, knowing that the strict order had returned to the West on the twenty-eighth day of last month, I couldn't help but feel emotional and lament. Of course, in the previous life, the strict order had been cultivated, so in this life, making a career with nothing...
noi_dung:
121. Letter to layperson Quach Phu Dinh

(Year of the Republic 21 - 1932)

Yesterday I received the letter, knowing that the strict order had returned to the West on the twenty-eighth day of last month, I couldn't help but feel emotional and lament. Of course, in the previous life, the strict command had been cultivated, so in this life he made a career with nothing, was rich, lived beyond the age of "co hy" (seventy), had a full house with children and grandchildren, loved to do good without tiring, and protected the Three Jewels. If you have faith, you will be reborn in the West. If you don't have faith in your vows, you will probably be born in heaven, or be born in a rich family in the human world to enjoy great blessings. But worldly blessings are not permanent. You should tell your filial relatives to recite the Buddha's name wholeheartedly together, hoping that the person who has not yet been reborn will immediately be reborn. Once reborn, his dignity will increase. That is useful filial piety. Everyone should be less painful and recite the Buddha's name. Don't follow other people's teachings just to please the ears and eyes of others, not caring whether your parents' consciousness will benefit or not.

Moreover, when he was still alive, he believed in Buddhism, and now at his funeral, according to reason, you should follow his will when he was alive, and definitely not eat salty foods. Everyone who sacrifices to gods, worships spirits, and entertains guests uses vegetarian dishes. Compared to releasing living beings, the merit is even greater. If we don't use vegetarian food, after this funeral, too many lives will be lost. What if, because we showed filial piety, our parents had to commit murderous karma to countless lives?

In the 13th year of the Republic of China (1924), Mr. Chau Ngoc Son passed away (he used to be the General Governor of Luong Giang). His son, Tap Chi, knew Quang and sent Quang an obituary. Quang advises not to eat salty foods. Because he is a very famous official, if he uses salty food, it will inevitably "make father look good and turn into a burden for father!" The letter sent by Quang, Mr. Tap Chi was not decisive, telling those in charge of matters to discuss. Those who take care of business are all greedy for food and drink, and do not approve of vegetarian dishes. At the funeral ceremony in Tianjin, [funeral visitors] sat at more than four thousand tables. The following year, take the spirit back to Huan (Anhui): Go to Nanjing to hold a funeral ceremony, go to Wuhu (Anhui province) to hold a funeral ceremony, and return home to hold a funeral ceremony. The descendants of the eldest lineage held a funeral ceremony in Duong Chau. In just these five funeral ceremonies, the number of lives lost cannot be counted. After the burial, returning to Thien Tan, there was a fortune-teller, Mr. Ngoc Son came to the altar, painfully resenting his family for using salty food, saying that all the merit he had earned when he was a mandarin while still alive had been destroyed, but it was still not enough [to make up for that crime]!

Tap Chi was extremely regretful but couldn't help it. He wanted to set up a grand meeting in Thien Tan to atone for his mistakes. Having chosen a suitable land, when the war broke out in Phung Thien - Truc Le199, it still could not be done, only trying to tie up small relationships, so that those who came back could have a place to rest. The strict order has quite a predestined relationship with Quang, and the lay people also have a predestined relationship with Quang. At this time, Quang did not talk about pros and cons for lay people, it was a lack of friendship. Afraid that lay people might think that the matter is not important or urgent, they should fully cite Chau Tap Chi's story to prove it. When it comes to doing Buddhist work, you should consider reciting the Buddha's name as the first priority; Everything else is just a show to make it easier to see. During the morning and evening recitation session, Quang recited the name of the strict command to dedicate for twenty-one days. Because of his close friends, Quang always refused to follow secular rituals, only using Buddha's name to dedicate to express his friendship! (Oi Ou is the effect of ghosts, sometimes it is real, but Quang does not approve of Ouija, please don't misunderstand)

tieu_de: 122. Letter responding to layperson Trac Nhan
tom_tat: Receiving a letter of great joy and comfort. Being able to self-reflect like that is very rare in this life! If we can go straight forward without retreating, then the path of strict command, the path of Confucius - Manh, the path of Buddha, and the Patriarchs, can all be...
noi_dung:
122. Letter responding to layperson Trac Nhan

(Year of the Republic 16 - 1927)

Receiving a letter of great joy and comfort. Being able to self-reflect like that is very rare in this life! If we can move forward without retreating, then the path of strict commandment, the path of Confucius and Strong, the path of Buddha, and the Patriarchs can all be truly realized personally. But for sweet, crunchy, fatty, rich foods that cannot be given up yet, if one wishes to follow Confucian theory, it is still not a great emergency; But if you wish according to Buddhist theory, that is doing evil, not just evil intentions! In the 10th year of the Republic of China (1921), Quang came to Nanjing. Mr. Wei Mai Ton (a Han Lam mandarin, at that time sixty years old) said to Quang: "As for Buddhism, I also believe in Buddha's teachings, and I also recite the Buddha's name. I have also read the book Van Sao of my Master, but I am not yet a vegetarian!" Quang said: "Rich people find it difficult to forget their habits. If you want to become a vegetarian, please read carefully the article So Quyen Mo Lap

The Phung Thien Truc Le war happened twice, and history is often called Phung Truc Chien Su, or Truc Phung War. The first time lasted from April Twenty-eighth to May 5, 1922. The Sun Yat-sen faction allied with the warlords Duan Qirui and Truong Tac Sam at Phung Thien to destroy the forces of the warlords Cao Kun and Wu Peifu at Zhili. The war was very fierce because Cao Kun's side had seven divisions and five brigades. Both sides suffered heavy losses and had to rely on Western missionaries to mediate a truce. The second time occurred from the fifteenth day of September to the third day of November 1924, Truong Tac Sam brought fifty thousand troops from Phung Thien to Truc Le to take revenge for the previous defeat. noi_dung:
123. Letter responding to layperson Tran Hue Tan

(Year of the Republic 22 - 1933)

The course of practice should be set up according to the opportunity, the simpler the better. If you are all long-time practitioners, then you don't have to worry about following the Zen Mon Chant chant. If there are many beginners, no matter morning or night, they can recite the Amitabha Sutra, the Rebirth Mantra, and then recite the Buddha's name. It's the same in the morning and evening, and it's okay to recite like that during the day. If you don't recite sutras or mantras, you can start with verses praising Buddha. You must know: All exercises take Buddha's name as the main subject, and sutras and mantras are the guests! Knowing this meaning, we must base our assessment on the abilities of members of Cu Si Lam to adapt, but how can Quang define a separate program for everyone to follow? All forests in the world follow Zen Mon Nhat Tung, but Tay Phuong pagoda in Tu Khe commune, [city] Van Khe, chants the Amitabha Sutra morning and night; Therefore, don't judge based on attachment!

What cannot be just a little but must be [extremely] expanded is the sect consisting of three items: Faith - Prayer - Virtue. If we use the Zen way of consulting, "Who is the person reciting Buddha's name?" is to engage in Zen seeking enlightenment, completely losing the Pure Land teachings. This is the biggest, most important relationship. People often pretend to practice Pure Meditation, but focusing as much as possible on research will gain limited benefits (reciting to the extreme will also lead to enlightenment). They will lose infinite benefits, because if they do not focus on faith and prayer, they will not be able to touch the path and communicate with Buddha. Even if you personally see "who the person reciting the Buddha's name is", it will be difficult for the Buddha to receive you and lead you to rebirth in the West, because you do not have the faith to pray for rebirth! Since I have not cut off my troubles, I cannot rely on my own strength to escape birth and death. Those who like to talk loudly do not know this meaning. The Pure Land Dharma surpasses all other methods in that it relies on Buddha's power; Other methods rely on self-reliance. Can self-power be compared to Buddha's power? That is the most important key point in the Pure Land dharma!
