noi_dung:
124. Letter responding to layperson Tong Duc Trung asking whether burning sutras is meritorious or sinful

(Year of the Republic of China 20 - 1932. Attached is the original letter)

In the book index of the Buddhist Sutra of the Flowing Land of Shanghai Cong De Lam, on page eighty-three, there are eight uses of burning the Diamond Sutra written in vermilion. Duc Trung believes that the actions mentioned in this category are contrary to the Buddha's will, with little merit, many sins. He respectfully requests the great master to explain.

Buddhist scriptures should be kept and received, if you have never heard of them, burn them! Even if it is said that burning it will be beneficial for the soul and for the deceased who is being prayed for, it is still a public matter that cannot make up for the mistake, let alone it is useless! Why say so? Most of those who burn scriptures burn them in tools used to burn votive paper. The ashes are then sold and mixed with votive paper ash. Those who bought the ash brought it back and threw away all the paper ash, keeping only the votive ash. So can't the ash of the scriptures not be thrown into the trash? Is there anyone willing to pay the expense of setting up a separate container, lining the bottom with tin foil, placing the prayer in the middle, and covering the top with tin foil. Burn tin foil and the prayer will burn. Because the top is covered with tin foil, the ash of the prayer won't fly out. Wait until the fire has completely cooled down, collect the ash and put it in a new cloth bag, add clean sand or clean stone inside, and sew the bag closed. If a very trustworthy friend brings it to the sea, or to a big river, or to the deepest place, then he will not be guilty of being disrespectful. If I follow the normal way of burning votive paper and then sell paper ashes, I'm afraid I'll commit an immeasurable sin and get little work!

All Buddhist activities must be done with sincerity in order to have understanding. Those people who burn scriptures only know how to burn, have they ever thought about this? The Mahayana sutras all praise the merits of writing, receiving, maintaining, reading, and reciting, but we have never heard of the merits of burning sutras! If you really have merit, you should still not maintain this custom; Because it is very possible that ignorant people will focus on burning the sutras and not on receiving and maintaining them! Since the Diamond Sutra can be burned, can't other Mahayana sutras also be burned? Those who are rich but ignorant will surely create endless karma of burning! Buu Hue completely disapproved of this matter. Even though he heard people say it had a great impact, he still did not utter a single word of praise, for fear of creating an extremely bad reputation!

The world often writes the Vang Sanh mantra into a circle, engraves it, prints it, and names it Vang Sanh Tien. Many people burn [the money] to give it to the lonely soul. In the sixteenth year of Guangxu (1890), at Long Tuyen Pagoda in Beijing, early in the morning, Quang went out of the three-door gate and saw that in the pile of paper ash and gold and silver ash from the Diem Khau Release ceremony last night, there was a two-inch-thick stack of Vanh Sanh Tien papers, only half burned. If I hadn't seen it, the cleaning maid would have been swept into the trash too! Therefore, we know that: The error of burning the spell is nowhere to be found! There was a monk who released Mong Son, used checks and paper money to clip Vang Sanh money inside, arranged it in the shape of one big head and one small head, waiting until the exit.

Sanh200 will burn. [When the fire is] close, the hand will be thrown to the ground. There are often unburnt words in there. Even if it burns out and the ashes are completely thrown to the ground, is there no fault? This is what Bu Hue saw with his own eyes.

Therefore, knowing that: "Once a dharma has been established, hundreds of evils will arise" are true words! Everything must be taken care of so that over a long period of time there will be no bad things in order for it to be good and satisfactory. Even if there is merit in burning sutras, I'm afraid that if someone is not careful and cares for it, the matter of merit will turn into a matter of sin. What's more, isn't there really merit? Real Hue understands like that. For the wise man, all things are unobstructed, every dharma is perfect, but for the humble mind and little understanding of Bu Hui, that cannot be the case. What Buu Hue said was just an estimate based on Bu Hue's measurements as a standard!

Letter responding to layperson Kim Ich Binh (two letters)

If you want to take refuge in the Buddha Dharma, escape birth and death, and become a saint, you must try your best to fulfill all morality. If you cannot maintain moral morality, fulfill all duties, abandon evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, and observe good things, then you are fundamentally flawed and not in accordance with Buddha. How can the Buddha be willing to accept and guide you in order to overcome your karma and be reborn? Therefore, one must be filial to one's parents, respectful to elders, to brothers, sisters, husbands and wives, and to masters and servants, each of them must fulfill their own responsibilities and duties. If you fulfill all your responsibilities and duties that have been promoted, you are a sage.

Xuat Sanh is a term often used in Zen Lam: When the monks come to the hall to eat, the Hall Master or Abbot will take out a little rice (called "sanskrit") from his bowl and put it in a separate container (called Xuatnhatai or Sanhtai) to give to Dai Bang Kim Xi Dieu, the Khanh Da demons, Ha Loi Emperor Ghost Tu Mau, etc. The word "sanskrit" implies that this rice is used to feed the lives of ghosts and gods; Therefore, there is the word Exodus. The attendant will carry the rice outside the hall, place it on clean ground, in the shade, and recite the verse of Exodus. The reason why we have to give food to the ghosts and spirits is because when the Buddha conquered the ghosts of Khanh Da and the Demon Child Mother, he advised those ghosts and spirits not to eat the flesh and blood of living beings anymore, and promised that as long as the Buddha Dharma still existed, the Sangha would daily offer food to them to be full. For some unknown reason, Chinese Buddhism, especially in South China, adds the burning of paper money, gold and silver every time of Birth.

good people in the world. Good people who chant Buddha's name will easily feel Buddha. If you want to end life and death, you cannot help but pay attention to morality!

We should also rely on what the Pure Land scriptures teach to have faith, make vows, concentrate on reciting Buddha's name, and decide to be born in the West right in this life, without ever starting to wish for blessings and retributions in the next life. Buddha views all sentient beings as his only child. You should abstain from killing, be vegetarian, love the lives of animals, use this to practice yourself, and also teach others. Everyone in the family, parents, brothers, sisters, concubines, children, in addition to neighbors, villages, relatives, and friends, should tell them about the benefits of reciting Buddha's name: In this life, it eliminates disasters, increases blessings, and at the end of the day, the Buddha will take you to the West. Recently, the world has become extremely chaotic. Those who believe in Buddha and recite Buddha's name often encounter bad things that turn into good things. The current calamity cannot be avoided, even if prevented, it cannot be prevented! If you can sincerely recite Buddha's name, you will silently encounter no disasters! With such great benefits, how can we not let our parents, brothers, etc., neighbors, neighbors, etc., know about it? But if you want to influence others, you have to practice it yourself! If you yourself recite the Buddha's name, but when it comes to maintaining moral integrity, fulfilling all duties, thinking, and behaving in many ways, it will be difficult to sympathize!

Now the dharma name given to him is Tong Thanh. Tong (宗) is master, Thanh (誠) is truth. If you can be sincere in everything you do, then for a long time, everyone will look up to each other and do good things, that is called "the will of success, the gold and stone will open up" (sincerity reaches the extreme, even the golden stone will crack), let alone a fellow human being? You should often read the Amitabha Sutra and Commentary 201, Gia Ngon Luc, and Cam

Ung Thien Truc Lecture. Since childhood, I have taught my children to read Touch Thien. That essay should be read several times a day, at least once. Read throughout this life, read the book Truc Giang, follow it and you will be able to join the righteous gentleman.

Quang is old and should no longer send letters. If you want to see any books, please request them from Hoang Hoa Xa. Don't hesitate to send me a letter.

Amitabha Sutra Explanation is the work of Mr. Hoang Ham Chi (self-style Khanh Lan, dharma name Tri Hai), to annotate difficult words in the sutra and use the Bach Thoai style to "express" the meaning of sutras that were originally written in ancient texts so that people with little understanding of ancient texts can still understand the meaning of the scriptures. Mr. Hoang Tri Hai wrote many books on the Explanation of the Pure Land Sutras.

If you are willing to follow Gia Ngon Luc, Van Sao, etc., then why do you need another letter or two? Last winter, three prescriptions for opium withdrawal medicine were printed, extremely effective, and the prescription for malaria treatment didn't cost a penny and no one could be cured. Now enclosing three pages in the letter, please tell everyone so that the demon that causes malaria will not make things difficult for people anymore. What a great benefit!

Since you know how to feel ashamed and repent, why do you still act the same way, with no decrease in evil and no increase in goodness? There is nothing else! Because the mind is not sincere! If the mind is dominated by sincerity, would it be possible to know it but still try to commit it? Knowing that the mind still tries to commit a crime is because the mind actually does not have a sincere heart and decides to change its mistakes towards goodness! He himself wanted to be a sage and a good person so he could separate himself from evil habits. The person who cannot separate is because their mind is not determined; If you are superficial, careless, hesitant, and arrogant, it will be difficult to avoid returning to the old path!

From now on, don't send any more letters. You refuse to honestly overcome and eliminate your own privacy. Even if I tell you, what's the use? If you will diligently consider your own sins, why should I say more? The two words Tong Thanh cover it all! If a person's mind is not deluded, it certainly won't be so bad that it won't be able to correct its mistakes and move towards goodness. For example, if I really know who wants to harm me, even if he has many sweet and seductive words, I certainly won't let him deceive me and entrust my life. Being deceived is the person who doesn't know good or bad! There is someone with a huge confrontation that involves your life, so why are you still willing to let him deceive you? That's called "asking others to tell you a miraculous way to protect your life." What's the use? Therefore, I don't want to talk too much with you anymore!

noi_dung:
The letter replied to three lay people Tong Luc Tram, Tru Lien Tinh, and Truong Tu Tinh

(Year of the Republic 17 - 1928)

Life is so chaotic that it's unbearable to say! Considering the origin, the proximate cause is that in the last one hundred and ten years, all those who read books and become mandarins only know how to practice their careers202, seeking fame and fortune, not

Bachelor's degree is a way of studying only for the purpose of passing the exam to become a mandarin, focusing on practicing literature to suit the exam requirements such as books, mats, essays, poems, poems, etc., and not focusing on understanding the educational meaning of the sages to cultivate oneself.

Know how to promote cause and effect and educate the family. If we talk about distant causes, then it is truly due to the Trinh and Chau families destroying and rejecting cause and effect, retribution and the cycle of birth and death! Because I wasn't taught well by my family, I don't know why people are human, and I'm used to hearing that "death is annihilation, I don't have a before or after life!" So as soon as the European wind blew, I felt that the theory of "abandoning filial piety, abolishing morality, and not being ashamed" was very free and without hindrance, so I unanimously agreed to carry it out. [Creating] fundamental confusion for people cannot help but blame those on the Physics side. Quang said this with the utmost precision, the utmost certainty, and was not talking nonsense!

The plan at this time is to enthusiastically promote cause and effect retribution, birth and death, reincarnation and education in the family, but education in the family needs to pay even more attention to cause and effect retribution! Only when these two dharmas maintain each other can our future descendants soon live like animals! Otherwise, even with education, it will be difficult to keep them from being swayed by evil habits! When it comes to the methods of practicing reciting Buddha's name, Van Sao has enough mentioned. If I say it clearly, it will be a waste of pen and ink. Even if [in this letter] it is explained in detail, it is still the same things as Van Sao said.

Now I send to you Van Sao, An Si Toan Thu, Gia Ngon Luc, Amitabha Bach Thoai Explanation, Quan Yin Bon Accumulation, Thien Truc Induction

Lecture, Tho Khang Bao Giam, Touch Thien Vung Bien, Khue Pham203 etc. each part. If I had many books, I would get married, but because Van Sao and An Si Toan Thu have all been sent out, [the new books] haven't been printed yet. Gia Ngon Luc has already sent out all 10,000 copies. Twenty or thirty thousand copies have not been published yet, so he cannot send many. Because Gia Ngon Luc is divided into different topics, it is quite easy to read. I hope to use this for self-practice, use this to teach others, then I will definitely be able to become a saint and be able to escape birth and death!

If you want to practice Pure Karma, you must maintain moral integrity, fulfill all duties, abandon evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, observe good things, abstain from killing, be vegetarian, protect and cherish the lives of animals, believe in reciting Buddha's name, and seek rebirth in the West. Inside are parents, brothers, and sisters, outside are relatives, friends, neighbors, and villages

Use this for advice. Regardless of whether they believe or not, don't let them hear about it!

Since you want to take refuge, now give each of you a dharma name: Tong Luc Tram's dharma name is Hue Tram, Tru Lien Tinh's dharma name is Hue Tinh, Truong Tu Tinh's dharma name is Hue Trung. If you can eliminate delusions and be mindful with one mind, then it is called Tram (湛: quiet), Tinh, and Trung (澄: calm), these are all virtues that are inherent in the mind, not coming from the outside. If the mind is filled with dust, the existing virtues of Tram, Tinh, and Trung will be stirred up by delusion and turn into turbid, dirty, and impure appearances. In early March of next year, Quang will go to Shanghai again to complete the printing of the book. After the fall of next year, I will leave Putuo and travel all over the East, West, South, and North to escape the drudgery of receiving letters! Please don't go to Pho Da, just read Van Sao and Gia Ngon Luc carefully, it's much better than coming to meet Quang in person!

Reply letter to the Youth Buddhist Study Society of the Buddhist Association Vo

noi_dung:
Tich

(Year of the Republic 23 - 1934)

Yesterday, when I received your letter and research plan, I couldn't help but feel embarrassed. Quang is an ordinary monk, without any knowledge, only knows how to ask foolish husbands and wives to worship and recite to pray for rebirth, how can he be a teacher and guide for your commune? As for the simple, dependent origination program that was sent last time, I really didn't know about it. It was probably because the people in the temple saw that Quang refused everything. Moreover, it was not an urgent matter, so they had already given it to Binh Dinh Dong Tu204 to accept it! Quang is seventy years old, his mind is like an ignorant child, just waiting for his time to die; Besides reciting the Buddha's name, do you do anything else? Let alone dare to accept a noble position in your commune to investigate the meaning and principles of scriptures and books to study so that [everyone] can follow and practice?

However, [your commune] mistakenly sent the letter, so I could not help but explain my own understanding. When young people study Buddhism, they must maintain moral ethics and fulfill all duties (i.e., be truly filial, kind, loyal,

According to Dich Hoc, the two Binh Dinh stems in the Thien Stem belong to the Fire element. Therefore, people often call the god of fire the god Binh Dinh or Binh Dinh Dong Tu.

faith, propriety, righteousness, integrity, shame, etc.), put an end to evil thoughts, maintain sincerity, do not do evil things, obey good things, deeply believe in cause and effect and reincarnation, believe in reciting Buddha's name, and seek rebirth in the West. Use these things to practice yourself and teach others. Whenever you practice and still have enough energy, you will study all the Mahayana sutras and the teachings of the ancient Confucian and Thich monks of the past. We must understand and grasp the teachings and use them to propagate the Buddha's teachings and continue the teachings of Buddhas, Patriarchs, and saints. This is called "by practicing, you learn widely, by learning widely, you understand the core things". In this way, you will definitely join the ranks of the sages in this life, and when you die, you will be immediately reborn in the Pure Land.

If you don't focus on practicing with all your might, just hoping to know a lot and see a lot, you will inevitably become arrogant, despise everything, and deny cause and effect. Such a person's natural talent is indeed enough to inherit the previous person, paving the way for the next person to follow, but because the first step has never examined his own body and mind, from then on, he goes further and further, making mistakes, straying thousands of miles, and eventually becoming someone who destroys the teachings of Buddha, Patriarchs, and saints! That is the most pitiful story of intelligent people ever! Out of a hundred people, eight or ninety people have this problem, causing others to cry in pain! The light of learning is all around, but if you don't bring your seventy years of experience to your society, one day when you die, it will be like living in vain and dying in vain. Using this piece of paper to express your sincerity, perhaps it can help your commune in "inheriting the ancients, opening the way for the future". Thanks to this small contribution, Quang was born in the West, which was also achieved by the noble community. How grateful is that? Sincerely return the entrustment, if I send another letter, I will not reply.

From then on, knowing every day what is wrong, every day correcting your mistakes, you will become a saint and a sage. If you heal your body, your mind will gradually heal. Relying on the magnetic power of Avalokiteshvara and the wonderful meaning of the mantra, eating [Great Compassion rice] for a whole month will definitely have a strange effect. For his second brother, he should use sincerity to express his gratitude, so that his ancestors would have good and glorious descendants. Even if it's really several tens of thousands, it should be said to be only a few tens of thousands to avoid the risk of being suspected by petty people. The ancients had the notion that "even though it exists, it seems like it's not, what's true but seems like a lie", why do [journalists] forget everything and arrogantly show off empty prestige? From now on, don't do that anymore! Quang hasn't even reached the district level yet (Kayang district, Shaanxi province), how can he enroll in the district school?

I just hope I don't disgrace my parents, consider it a matter of honoring my parents. What's more, should people who study Buddhism be like children on the streets and markets who beg for praise from famous people to consider it filial piety?

The composition of the Dedication verse is very good. Those on the outside will certainly criticize it as far-fetched, but in fact it corresponds to the mind of the Great Being and is easy to sympathize with. Because people use cruelty, we use charity, like water extinguishes fire, but the sun melts ice. If we use the sentiments of sentient beings to seek reversal, it will go against the mind of the Great Being. Even though we have sympathy, it is only small! The verse is as follows: "May I try to recite and maintain the merits, that is, the Great Being's butt will be destroyed. Eliminate the self-sacrificing present karma. Increase the ego to overcome the good roots. Forever and ever, the Great Sage's mind will always exist, transform the world and practice the Great Sage's work. In the future, I will do many beneficial things, and all sentient beings will not be harmed!" (I pray that due to the merit of reciting this sublime recitation, the Great Being will be willing to help, eliminate the karma in the present or previous lives of me and others, and grow the superior good roots for myself and others. Always keep the heart of the Great Being, throughout all realms, always do the things of the Great Being, until the end of the future life to create benefits, so that all sentient beings will not be harmed).

noi_dung:
Letter responding to Mr. Phi Pham Cuu

A few days ago, your letter was delivered from the mountain, knowing that your heart was deeply devoted to religion, practiced carefully, and could not help but rejoice and admire, but due to being busy with business in Hu (Shanghai), you could not reply immediately! Yesterday, because I had to go to Hang's land, I was able to relax for a while, so I wrote roughly. “Loyalty to parents, serving elders, being kind-hearted and not killing, cultivating the Ten Good Karmas” is the main cause of Pure Karma of the Buddhas of the three worlds. He was filial to his parents, thrifty, and simple. He would not have accepted money unjustly. That behavior and mind were quite in line with Buddha's. If you still use faith and pray to recite the Buddha's name and pray to be reborn in the West, your wish will surely come true. As a human being, as a father to others, we should think about the ultimate source of the way to make our parents and children ultimately peaceful. Shouldn't we try our best to advise our parents and children to practice Pure Karma? This is an argument from the side of relatives, but all sentient beings are Buddhists, we already know, so why not let our brothers, sisters, relatives, neighbors, everyone we come in contact with know? If you want to take refuge in order to be reborn, don't you make a vow to practice the path of helping people depending on your fate?

Now the dharma name given to him is Hue Mau, which means using great wisdom to practice the Dharma to benefit others. The path of self-interest that you just mentioned is to tell everyone to urge morality, seriously fulfill all duties, abandon evil hearts, maintain sincerity, suppress one's own desires to restore decency, do not do evil things, observe good things, believe in reciting Buddha's name, and seek rebirth in the West. In Van Sao, it has been said many times, and now it is said again, for fear that it may not be paying attention, leading to the mistake of ignoring it. So, don't hesitate to say it again! Furthermore, the current world is in chaos, presenting unprecedented events. Considering the origin, it is generally due to not being taught well in the family and not explaining cause and effect and retribution! The world is not at peace, the lost husband and the lost wife have responsibilities! Pay attention to family education and cause and effect retribution, then talented people will naturally arise in large numbers, and the world will gradually become peaceful. I hope you will use these words to urgently advise everyone, that is the most important matter of "living in the mortal world, learning the way, even though you have not yet attained salvation, you can save others"! I hope you'll be very lucky if you're wise and consider it carefully. Other things have been said in detail in Van Sao, but we won't write them in detail here!

130. Letter responding to layperson Hue Dao

(ie Duong Han Cong)

He has received all the letters, the places he has been in have been cared for by good people, it is because of the Three Jewels family. The principles mentioned at the end of the letter are very good. The secret of "using humility to carry out sincere intentions" is fine if you discuss it on the upper level, but for all people of high, middle, and low ability when discussing, you should use wisdom and knowledge to determine the ultimate principle and contract. Wisdom and ways of doing things according to the Trinh and Chau styles have been mentioned so many times that we cannot rely on them!
